title: Assistant(e) chargé(e) de production (alternance)
descriptionHtml:
Crée du contenu qui fait vendre : scripts, tournages et vidéos face caméra, dès ton alternance.

À PROPOS DE SORIO

Sorio est une marque française de culottes et de maillots de bain menstruels, créée fin 2022, qui libère les femmes et les ados des contraintes des règles. Plus de 250 000 clientes, plus de 280 magasins en France, présente sur les grandes marketplaces et notée 4,6/5 par ses clientes.

TA MISSION

En alternance au sein du pôle créa, tu épaules le ou la chargé(e) de production et les fondateurs sur toute la chaîne de contenu. Tu écris des scripts, tu crées des vidéos et des photos où tu apparais, et tu fais de la veille pour trouver les prochains concepts à tester en ads.

TES RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Rédiger des scripts short-form (hook, problème, preuve, CTA)

  • Créer du contenu vidéo et photo face caméra

  • Aider à organiser les flux de production et les journées de tournage

  • Faire une veille TikTok / Instagram et réagir vite sur les tendances à adapter en ads

LE PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

  • Première expérience bienvenue, débutant(e) accepté(e), en alternance marketing, communication ou audiovisuel

  • Très à l'aise face caméra et avec la création de contenu

  • Forte culture TikTok / Instagram / UGC

  • CapCut, Canva, Notion, tournage smartphone et ChatGPT au quotidien

TON ÉTAT D'ESPRIT

  • Énergie et débrouillardise

  • Coachabilité : tu prends le feedback sans ego

  • Autonomie : tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire

POURQUOI CE POSTE

  • Apprendre la création publicitaire au contact direct des fondateurs

  • Voir ton contenu tourner en ads et mesurer son impact

  • Un pôle créa à construire, où tu as ta place pour proposer

  • Une perspective de CDI à l’issue de l’alternance

LES CONDITIONS

  • Contrat : alternance

  • Rémunération : selon la grille alternance

  • Localisation : entre Bayonne et Capbreton, 3 j sur site + 2 j de télétravail

  • Démarrage : décembre 2026

  • Avantages : prime annuelle, tickets restaurant, mutuelle

LE PROCESS

1. Entretien RH (30 min)

2. Test ou étude de cas

3. Rencontre avec les fondateurs

title: Associate Account Executive - DACH (German Speaking)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Think about your last hotel stay. Did you skip the front desk line with mobile check-in? Message the staff for extra pillows? Order a late-night snack with a tap on your phone? Then you’ve likely run into Canary in the wild.

Canary Technologies is the leading agentic AI platform for hotel and guest management, powering the digital infrastructure for more than 20,000 hotels in 125+ countries. The world's most renowned hospitality brands, including Marriott International, Four Seasons and Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, partner with us to increase revenue, improve operations and elevate the guest experience.

We’ve executed the largest deployment of autonomous AI systems in hospitality, building technology that fundamentally redefines how guests and hotels interact. It’s made us one of the top-funded hotel technology companies in the world, with nearly $200M raised to date.

Canary has been recognized as a 2024 and 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ company, Inc. 5000 fastest-growing company, and swept the 2026 HotelTechAwards, including Best Place to Work, #1 Guest Experience Platform, and the Hotelier’s Choice Award. We’re scaling our team to bring innovation to life faster than ever.

We're growing quickly, and we're looking for people who are passionate about their work, want to grow with us and are ready to take on more responsibility along the way. We value rigor and velocity in equal measure: high standards, fast pace, real ownership. If that's the environment you're looking for, this is the place for you.

Come join us! Let’s shape the future of hospitality together.


About the Role

Canary Technologies is looking for a German-speaking Associate Account Executive to join our growing team. This is the perfect role for someone with passion, drive, and the ability to own the entire sales process from prospecting through closing. As an Associate Account Executive at Canary, you will be responsible for generating new business, managing a robust pipeline, and building trusted relationships with hoteliers worldwide. With Canary’s rapid growth and strong reputation in the hospitality industry, there is a huge opportunity for impact and career growth.
What You’ll Do
  • Manage the full sales cycle from lead generation and prospecting to negotiation and closing.
  • Deliver against a revenue quota while maintaining a strong pipeline of opportunities.
  • Research and engage target accounts through multiple channels.
  • Effectively communicate Canary’s value proposition and tailor solutions to customer needs.
  • Leverage Salesforce for lead and pipeline management, and sales forecasting
  • Contribute to building and refining sales processes that enable Canary to scale globally.

    • What We’re Looking For
  • 2+ years of experience in a full-cycle sales role.
  • Fluent in German and English
  • Prior experience selling SaaS solutions; hospitality tech experience is a plus.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Experience using Salesforce and other tools like Salesloft and Outreach
  • Self-starter with the ability to thrive in a rapidly changing, high-growth environment.

    • Compensation

    Target cash compensation ranges from €50,000–€65,000, including a fixed annual salary and uncapped commission paid monthly.

    This role also includes a stock option grant, subject to board approval.

    Actual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's skill level, experience, and specific work location.

    Perks & Benefits

    We work hard to make Canary a fun, rewarding, and high-energy place to work. Here’s how we take care of our flock:

    Time Off

    • Unlimited PTO: Take the time you need to truly rest and recharge.
    • Holidays + Canary Days: Standard holidays plus monthly company-wide days off for a guaranteed long weekend.
    • Birthday Holiday: A dedicated day off to celebrate you!

    Travel & Office Flexibility

    • Office Exchange: A travel stipend to visit the team in person at our SF, NY, or Dallas hubs.
    • Canary Hotel Experience: Staying at a Canary hotel? We’ve got you covered with a credit toward your stay.
    • Preferred Hotels Discount: Enjoy a minimum 30% off the best available rate at select partner hotels globally.

    Growth & Community

    • Self Improvement Club: A monthly budget to help you smash your personal goals.
    • Professional Development: Level up your career with a dedicated learning stipend to fuel your skills and cross-functional connection.
    • Referral Program: Help us grow the flock and score a cash bonus for successful hires.
    Canary Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit, employ, train, compensate and promote talent regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other protected characteristic.

title: Associate Account Executive (Top Talent Sales Program - Lunar) DACH
descriptionHtml:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

Lunar Sales:

The Celonis Lunar Sales is a fast-track, 2-year development programme designed for ambitious professionals who want to accelerate their career at the intersection of AI, enterprise technology, and strategic sales.  If you have experience solving complex problems in a client-facing role, in management or strategy consulting or a leading industry strategy function and you are ready to bring that expertise into enterprise sales, this is your launchpad.

The Program immerses you in every stage of the customer sales journey, supported by motivating leaders who will help accelerate your growth beyond expectations. If you're an innovative thinker who thrives on overcoming challenges, our Top Talent Sales Program will provide strategic significance, arming you with the knowledge and tools to address complex problems, create meaningful change and excel as an Account Executive. 


The Role:

Fast-track your growth in enterprise sales through our exclusive top talent program. You will gain hands-on experience selling AI-driven business transformation, build relationships with industry leaders across Celonis verticals, including Automotive, Manufacturing, Banking, FSI,  Life Sciences, Consumer Goods, Retail, Energy and Public Sector and develop the leadership skills needed to drive real change for enterprise customers.

The program focuses on three key pillars 

Strategic Business Development & Executive Relationship Building 

  • Take full ownership of generating your own pipeline through cold outreach, persona identification, and first meetings, driving directly towards concrete KPI and revenue targets.
  • Collaborate with C-suite executives (CEO, CFO, COO, CDO/CIO) to address challenges and align with their strategic objectives. 

Tailored Solutions & Strategic Alignment 

  • Position Celonis Context Model and AI capabilities to address critical business needs, delivering measurable impact and expansion.
  • Align strategies with clients' long-term business goals to maximize platform adoption and success.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Join a highly collaborative cohort of peers featuring a great team who can tackle challenges together, a strong performance culture, and continuous shared learning experiences.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional teams, including Value Engineers, Service Consultants, Marketing, BDRs, and external partners.
  • Partner directly with a senior Account Executive in a dedicated 1:1 mentorship model to accelerate your professional growth.


The work you’ll do:

  • Understand the strategic and operational business needs of your target accounts and effectively communicate how Celonis and its AI-powered Process Intelligence Platform, will meet those to create real opportunities.
  • Responsible for delivering revenue in your allocated account patch by creating new business opportunities. 
  • Identify key stakeholder personas, cultivate strategic relationships, and build an internal network of champions to drive customer success and account expansion.
  • Engage cross Line-of-Business at C-level and below within your target organizations 
  • Become proficient in driving the sales process, following a structured, staged, programmatic flow through prospect, initial call, qualify, pitch to close.
  • Collaborate with Value Engineering or personally conduct comprehensive presentations and demonstrations tailored to specific use cases, including Celonis AI, Process Intelligence Graph and industry-specific solutions, showcasing the value of our platform.
  • Forge strong partnerships, particularly with leading consulting firms, tech partners, and the Big4.
  • Work closely with your team, which includes business development representatives, value engineers, partner managers, and marketing specialists, to ensure seamless collaboration and success. 
  • Stay current on AI trends, process automation, and digital transformation to position Celonis as the intelligent backbone of enterprise operations.

The qualifications you need:

  • Proven Track Record in Client-Facing Roles: You bring 2–3 years of professional experience from a top-tier management consultancy, corporate strategy/transformation function, or leading enterprise technology company. 
  • Strong Academic Foundation: You studied Business Economics, Engineering, Informatics, or a related discipline. A Master's degree is preferred, but exceptional graduates with solid foundational knowledge are encouraged to apply.
  • Sales Drive & Career Acceleration: You're ready to accelerate your career in sales. You have a genuine interest in applying your professional experience to a dynamic sales environment and are excited to build expertise in enterprise software solutions and client success.
  • Business Acumen & Process Intelligence Expertise: You have a sharp ability to quickly understand how companies operate, identify inefficiencies, and recognize where Process Intelligence and AI unlock real value and drive transformation.
  • AI-Forward Mindset: You're genuinely curious about AI and emerging technologies, driven to deepen your business acumen, and passionate about understanding business processes and KPIs—particularly in Finance, Supply Chain, or operations.
  • Industry Edge: You bring familiarity or hands-on experience in Manufacturing, Automotive, Consumer Goods, Retail, Financial Services, Telecommunications, or Utilities. This foundation helps you quickly grasp client contexts and add immediate value.
  • Communication Excellence: You communicate complex, strategic ideas with clarity and confidence in both English and German.
  • Analytical & Independent Thinker: You bring a forward-thinking mindset with analytical capabilities. You think strategically, operate independently, and are comfortable owning challenges and driving solutions.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

title: Associate Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
THIS IS AN ENTRY LEVEL POSITION

Hybrid: 2-3 days a week in London office (near Holborn Station)

LG Ad Solutions is a global leader in connected TV (CTV) and cross-screen advertising. We pride ourselves on delivering state-of-the-art advertising solutions that integrate seamlessly with today's ever-evolving digital media landscape.

The Opportunity

The Associate Account Manager supports the growth and success of client accounts by partnering closely with Account Managers, Sales, Operations, and Product teams. This role is responsible for helping execute campaigns, maintaining strong client relationships, monitoring performance, and ensuring seamless post-sale support.

title: Associate Director, Corporate Strategy & Development (all genders)
descriptionHtml:

As an Associate Director, Corporate Strategy & Development, you will be a senior member of a small, AI enabled team of highly driven and committed individuals, reporting to the Director Corporate Strategy & Development. This is a high-exposure role, acting as the strategic and analytical engine for our most important decisions in a team that reports directly to the Group CEO.

This role balances corporate development / M&A with corporate strategy. You lead projects across both areas as the day-to-day owner and guide a small number of more junior colleagues and internal functional experts. You operate with minimal direction and take projects from a vague problem statement to a CEO-ready recommendation. You also stay hands-on, personally building the models and analysis and preparing the executive-level outputs that drive investment and strategy decisions.

What you’ll do

  • M&A Strategy: Lead M&A projects end to end (owning small and mid-sized transactions independently and partnering with the Director on the largest, transformational deals), from target screening and valuation through due diligence, negotiation preparation, and post-deal integration. Run deal teams day to day, coordinate external advisors and act as the lead with target management teams or their advisors. You are not just a process manager but can form and defend a point of view on whether and why a deal makes strategic sense and present it directly to senior leadership.

  • Capital Allocation: Own and develop analytical frameworks and models to support strategic budget allocation and ROI analysis.
  • Business Unit Strategy: Act as a senior internal consultant, supporting our key business units across geographies on a project-by-project basis to develop their mid-term strategies and solve their most complex challenges.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience: 6+ years of high-performance experience from a top-tier Management Consulting firm, Investment Banking, or a comparable in-house Strategy / Corporate Development team. This includes leading projects or deal teams with minimal supervision.
  • Process and deal leadership: You have led complex, multi-stakeholder processes to a deadline, coordinating internal functions and external advisors and managing senior counterparties such as target or client management teams. This can come from running M&A transactions (in-house corporate development or advisory) or from leading strategy projects with transaction exposure, such as due diligence, carve-outs, partnerships or market entries. Direct M&A process experience is a strong plus; the ability to learn it quickly is essential.
  • Leadership and Influence: You have guided and developed more junior colleagues and influenced senior stakeholders, including through negotiation and building rapport with counterparties.
  • Toolkit: Exceptional qualitative and analytical problem-solving skills. You are hypothesis-driven and can own and structure complex analytical problems from end-to-end. You structure ambiguous problems and set direction for others, not just solve them yourself. You are utilizing AI tools to meaningfully improve your productivity. Ability to build applications with AI coding tools is a plus.
  • Financial Acumen: Expert-level financial modeling skills are required: you have built and defended complex models used for high-stakes investment or strategic decisions. Valuation experience is a plus. You are just as comfortable building analysis and models from scratch as you are managing processes and presenting recommendations to leadership.
  • DTC economics: You are comfortable working with typical DTC KPIs like CAC, AOR, AOV, CLV, retention and understand how cohort economics build a P&L over time. DTC marketing analytics experience is a plus but not required.
  • Communication: Proactive 360° communication and excellent ability to synthesize complex analysis into clear, concise storylines, presentationsand memos for an executive audience. 
  • How you work: You take ownership of outcomes and pressure-test your own conclusions before presenting them. You go deep into the analysis to get to the right answer, and know when it is good enough to decide.

descriptionHtml:
Über die TeGA-PLAN Heidemann GmbH

Die TeGA-PLAN Heidemann GmbH ist ein unabhängiges Ingenieurbüro für Technische Gebäudeausrüstung mit Sitz in Kiel. Mit rund 30 Kolleginnen und Kollegen planen und begleiten wir spannende und anspruchsvolle Bauprojekte – von der ersten Idee bis zur fertigen Umsetzung.

Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen in der Heizungs-, Lüftungs-, Sanitär- und Elektrotechnik sowie der Gebäudeautomation. Dabei sind unsere Projekte so vielfältig wie unser Team: Ob Forschungs- und Laborgebäude, Gesundheitseinrichtungen, Wohnungsbau, Büro- und Verwaltungsgebäude oder komplexe Industrieanlagen – wir entwickeln technische Lösungen für unterschiedlichste Anforderungen.

Was uns antreibt? Technik sinnvoll einsetzen, statt sie unnötig kompliziert zu machen. Wir legen Wert auf durchdachte, wirtschaftliche und energieeffiziente Lösungen und verfolgen dabei einen klaren Grundsatz: So viel Technik wie nötig, so wenig wie möglich.

Als unabhängiges Ingenieurbüro setzen wir auf fachliche Kompetenz, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein kollegiales Miteinander. Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was wir gemeinsam erreichen, sondern ganz besonders auch, wie wir miteinander arbeiten!

  • Du behältst den Überblick: Qualität, Termine und Kosten hast du im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Projekte fachgerecht und erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du weißt, wovon du sprichst: Ob Ingenieur, Techniker oder Meister – du hast eine passende Qualifikation im Bereich der Technischen Gebäudeausrüstung und kennst dich mit Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Sanitärtechnik aus.

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

Wir finden, dass gute Arbeit auch ein gutes Arbeitsumfeld verdient. Deshalb setzen wir auf Vertrauen, Flexibilität und ein Miteinander, bei dem sich alle wohlfühlen können.

  • Arbeiten, wie es zu deinem Leben passt: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice geben dir den Freiraum, den du brauchst.

  • Gut ausgestattet und mobil: Firmenwagen, Smartphone und Laptop gehören ebenso dazu wie die Möglichkeit zum Bike-Leasing und Zuschüsse für öffentliche Verkehrsmittel.

  • Gemeinsam wachsen: Wir unterstützen deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch Fortbildungen, gegenseitigen Wissensaustausch und die Erfahrung deiner Kolleginnen und Kollegen.

  • Wohlfühlen statt Kleiderordnung: Bei uns zählt, was du kannst, nicht was du trägst. Dich erwarten ein barrierefreies Büro, kostenlose Getränke und Snacks. Auch vierbeinige Begleiter sind willkommen.

  • Mehr als nur ein Arbeitsplatz: Mit Fitnessangeboten, Mitarbeitervorteilen und gemeinsamen Teamevents sorgen wir dafür, dass auch abseits der Projekte etwas geboten wird.

  • Ein Team, das zusammenhält: Kurze Wege, offene Türen, ein unkomplizierter Umgang miteinander und Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die sich gegenseitig unterstützen, gehören bei uns einfach dazu.

Deine Erfahrung ist uns etwas wert!

Bei uns erwartet dich ein Jahresgehalt zwischen 60.000 und 85.000 € brutto – abhängig von deiner Qualifikation, deiner Erfahrung und der Verantwortung, die du übernimmst. Was du mitbringst, zählt – und das soll sich auch in deinem Gehalt widerspiegeln.

Dein Start bei uns – gemeinsam von Anfang an!

Wir lassen dich nicht ins kalte Wasser springen. Du lernst unser Team, unsere Arbeitsweise und unsere spannenden Projekte in Kiel und Umgebung kennen. Dabei stehen dir erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen zur Seite, die dich bei deinem Einstieg unterstützen.

Schritt für Schritt übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine eigenen Baustellen und wirst Teil eines Teams, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und gemeinsam Lösungen findet.

Du erfüllst nicht jede Anforderung? Kein Problem! Für uns zählen nicht nur Zeugnisse und Lebensläufe, sondern vor allem deine Erfahrung, deine Persönlichkeit und die Lust, gemeinsam mit uns etwas zu bewegen. Wenn du glaubst, dass du zu uns passt, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

title: Broker Development Manager
descriptionHtml:

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

THE ROLE

Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission.

Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel.

A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success.

  • Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK:

ESSENTIAL

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry.

  • Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems.

  • A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives.

  • An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm.

  • Exceptional understanding of the commercial broker marketplace, competitor carriers, broker business models, and processes.

  • Ability to deliver a consultative sales process, aligning Flock’s value proposition with brokers’ current and future business needs.

  • Comfortable using AI in your daily work, from research and meeting prep to account analysis, and curious about where else it could help you win business.

PREFERABLE

  • Experience building networks of brokers in a Commercial Motor Fleet setting.

  • Have a broker distribution background with an active panel of brokers in the commercial insurance market.

WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary)

title: Business Development Associate
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

Proxima will sell fusion electricity in the late 2030s. Proxima's Business Development team finds and executes business opportunities on the way there: inorganic (acquisitions, minority stakes and joint ventures in businesses synergetic with Proxima) and organic (new product lines built from Proxima assets). You will own opportunities along our Business Development playbook, from market scan to a clear go/no-go from leadership, with an initial focus on inorganic deals. You will work directly with the Business Development Lead and the Head of Business Operations, within the CFO organization, and alongside engineering, finance, legal, and supply chain teams.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the front of the deal funnel: Build market reports, competitive landscapes, and company mappings that shape where Proxima invests.

  • Drive clear decisions: Build decision memos and business cases that lead to a go/no-go from the leadership team and board, pulling in our engineers to ground the analysis in technical reality.

  • Run deal workstreams: Lead expert calls, reference checks and data room screening.

  • Strengthen the function: Contribute roadmap and communication, and systematically deploy AI tools to speed up research, screening, and drafting.

  • Source new opportunities: Attend conferences and industry events, and feed new ideas into the pipeline, including organic ones over time.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Deal execution experience: 2-3 years in tier-1 strategy consulting, private equity, venture capital, or a fast-paced startup, ideally with exposure to industrials, energy, or advanced manufacturing.

title: CDI - Manager Context & Analytics Engineer - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Un agent ne vaut que ce que valent les données et les connaissances sur lesquelles il répond. Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents.

Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple.
  • Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage.
  • Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL.
  • Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès.
  • Construire des pipelines de connaissances pour le RAG : indexation, chunking, métadonnées, permissions.
  • Préparer le contexte exploitable par les agents : métadonnées, définitions, lineage et permissions.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous écrivez du SQL avec aisance et modélisez les données pour l’analyse.
  2. Des pipelines de données planifiés, testés et surveillés figurent à votre actif.
  3. Aux côtés des équipes métier, vous définissez les métriques et vérifiez que les données veulent bien dire ce que tout le monde croit y lire.
  4. La qualité des données, la documentation et les droits d’accès comptent pour vous.
  5. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Python pour le traitement de données.
  • Une plateforme de données cloud, comme BigQuery, Snowflake ou Databricks.
  • Une couche sémantique ou un metrics store.
  • La préparation de documents pour le RAG : chunking, indexation, métadonnées.
  • Des outils de data catalogue ou de lineage.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Dans un métier où deux tableaux de bord affichent parfois deux chiffres différents, ce poste consiste à rétablir la confiance : un chiffre juste, une définition partagée, une source identifiable. Ce travail, discret quand il réussit, conditionne tout ce que les autres archétypes construisent au-dessus.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets, avec les AI Engineers et l’appui de la communauté Context & Analytics Engineer, notamment le context engineering, c’est-à-dire le travail qui rend les données exploitables par les agents d’IA. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Context & Analytics Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.
  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).
  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.
  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.
  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.
  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 66 000€ à 75 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 10 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: Channel Partnerships Lead
descriptionHtml:
Want to join a team of passionate people who want to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer?

👋 About us

We're an AI Health Tech company in the UK and Europe, leading from the front in the AI Diagnostics space.

Our AI Platform, DERM, is the UK’s and Europe’s first autonomous Class III AI as a medical device, certified to the same safety standard as a pacemaker. Independently proven to perform at least as well as a face-to-face dermatologist assessment, our technology is giving millions of people access to a fast and accurate way to detect skin cancer, saving significant time and costs for global healthcare systems and improving outcomes for patients. DERM has been an integrated part of NHS dermatology pathways for over six years and is already in use in 25 NHS Trusts, and trusted by private health providers including Bupa and Vitality. It has assessed over 300,000 patients and found more than 25,000 cancers, validated by histopathology, the diagnostic gold standard.

We are fast growing, raised £15M in series B funding in 2025, and are scaling across Europe - with regulatory approvals underway in other regions. In June 2026, we launched DERM Zero, the world' s first Class III regulated medical device technology to deliver autonomous clinical grade skin cancer assessments from a smartphone, changing the way that people can access clinically validated skin cancer checks.

If working for one of Time Magazine World’s Top Health Tech Companies appeals then we’d like to hear from you. We are hiring across science, technology, product, operations and commercial.

Brief overview

We’re looking for a Channel Partnerships Lead to build a brand-new revenue channel: distributing DERM through globally scaled third-party technology platforms such as teleconsultation services, digital health marketplaces and primary-care tech providers.

You’ll own every partnership end to end, from identifying and qualifying partners through business case, negotiation and signed agreement, to live launch and ongoing growth. You’ll run a methodical, stage-gated process and work closely with our Clinical, Regulatory, Legal, Data Protection, Product and Engineering teams to make every partnership safe, compliant and technically deliverable.

Reporting to the Head of Commercial International, you’ll collaborate tightly and transparently with our direct sales teams across European markets. This is a chance to shape how DERM reaches millions more patients, and to build a repeatable revenue line from the ground up.

Responsibilities

  • Define and track success metrics for each partnership (e.g. attach rate, volume, revenue) and manage the commercial relationship post-launch.

  • Collaborate tightly and transparently with the direct sales team across markets to avoid channel conflict.

  • Represent Skin Analytics at industry events and partner forums to build our profile with health tech platforms.


Required Experience

  • Experience working within the regulatory, clinical and data protection constraints of medical device or health-data partnerships.

title: Chief Engineer, Air
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

UFORCE is looking for a Chief Engineer, Air to lead the engineering of our Western-facing air platforms and turn operational lessons from Ukraine into reliable, manufacturable products that global customers can test, deploy and reorder.

You’ll own the technical baseline across the air portfolio, initially focusing on Platform N and expanding to other platforms sold outside Ukraine. You’ll work closely with Ukrainian engineering teams to understand the wider Nemesis pipeline, translate field experience into product improvements and build a consistent view of configurations and engineering evidence across the portfolio.

This is a hands-on senior technical leadership role. You’ll stay close to the hardware and the field, build a small engineering team, and bring engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and commercial partners together to deliver products at pace without compromising technical rigor.

The role is based in the UK and involves regular travel to engineering teams, manufacturing sites, test ranges and customers. Reporting arrangements and travel expectations will be confirmed during the hiring process.

What you’ll do

  • Own the air portfolio’s technical baseline. Establish controlled requirements, configurations, bills of materials and test evidence, starting with Platform N and extending across Western and Ukrainian air platforms. Put clear ownership and practical change control in place.

  • Lead end-to-end systems engineering. Make and coordinate technical decisions across airframe, propulsion, power, avionics, flight control, communications, navigation, payload interfaces, software interfaces and ground systems, bringing in specialists where needed.

  • Improve reliability and performance. Establish a disciplined failure-reporting and corrective-action process, investigate priority field and test issues, and demonstrate improvements against agreed requirements through repeatable testing.

  • Turn operational lessons into product improvements. Work with Ukrainian engineering and field teams to understand what has worked, capture operator feedback and agree a prioritised design-change roadmap for Western variants.

  • Build for repeatable production. Lead design-for-manufacture reviews and partner with manufacturing teams to release production-ready engineering packages for US and allied sites.

  • Strengthen the supply chain and cost position. Work with supply-chain and compliance partners to assess component sourcing, qualification, capacity and critical supplier risks. Develop a unit-cost roadmap and evaluate where components and systems should be built across UFORCE locations.

  • Support go-to-market and customer delivery. Partner with Sales and Business Development on customer requirements, priority markets, product positioning and business cases. Provide technical input on configurations, capability claims, pricing, delivery and support assumptions.

  • Prepare for trials and launch. Establish technical readiness gates covering demonstrations, compliance evidence, production readiness and handover to field support. Communicate product capabilities and limitations honestly to customers and test authorities.

  • Set the direction and build the team. Work with founders, Ukrainian colleagues and global leadership to develop the air product roadmap. Hire and develop engineers, establish clear ownership and build the practices needed as the function grows.

Required Skill

  • Experience leading the design and development of a complete UAS, with personal ownership of system-level technical decisions and demonstrated flight or field outcomes.

  • Strong systems engineering judgement across airframe, propulsion, power, avionics, flight control, communications, navigation and software interfaces.

  • Experience taking an aerial or comparable electromechanical product from prototype into repeatable production, including design for manufacture, configuration control and production testing.

  • A track record of investigating field failures, identifying root causes and measurably improving reliability through verified corrective actions.

  • Practical experience with applicable NDAA / Blue UAS sourcing requirements, restricted components and export-control considerations, including qualification or re-sourcing decisions.

  • Understanding of how contested operating conditions, including GNSS denial, jamming and communications resilience, influence product requirements and testing.

  • Experience supporting customer trials, competitions or tenders and communicating technical capabilities, limitations and risks to customers or test authorities.

  • Experience hiring or developing engineers and leading multidisciplinary teams across organisational and geographic boundaries.

  • Sound judgement on cost, performance, production readiness and supplier trade-offs, with the ability to make decisions in an evolving startup environment.

  • A hands-on approach, clear communication and the ability to balance speed with appropriate engineering discipline.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to engineering teams, manufacturing sites, test ranges and customers.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience working with Ukrainian UAS teams, products or operators.

  • Experience with military or Ministry of Defence contracts.

  • Experience with military or civil airworthiness, qualification or certification.

  • Experience with payload integration or payload-release systems.

  • Experience coordinating engineering and manufacturing across multiple countries.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?

title: Chief Of Staff
descriptionHtml:
Hozah is scaling fast, and the CEO's time has become the bottleneck. We're looking for a Chief of Staff to multiply it: someone who works across every department, uses AI and clear structured thinking to find what is slowing the business down, and fixes it.

Above all, you get things over the line. In a growing business, good initiatives stall between departments, wait on decisions nobody owns and quietly lose momentum. You'll pick them up, clear the blockers, chase the decisions and drive each one to a finished, measured result, with urgency and without waiting to be asked.

This is not an executive assistant role and not a strategy-deck role. You'll own a portfolio of cross-functional initiatives and the leadership operating rhythm, and your influence will come from results and relationships, not borrowed authority.

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of cross-functional initiatives the CEO would otherwise drive personally, from diagnosis through to a finished, measured result.

  • Own the problems that sit between departments: find what is slowing the business down, size it in numbers and get it fixed with the team that owns it.

  • Own the leadership operating rhythm: the board pack, SLT agenda, KPI and OKR tracking, and the decision and action log.

  • Own the follow-through on strategic initiatives, tracking them to completion and raising slippage early with a recovery plan.

  • Own practical AI adoption across the business, building the shared workflows, tools and templates that remove manual work, and helping teams use them well.

  • Own the judgement calls the CEO shouldn't have to make: what you decide, what goes to the CEO and what gets dropped, with board, investor and people-sensitive information handled discreetly.

Who we're looking for

  • You've personally delivered cross-functional improvements end to end in the last two to three years, and can show the before and after in numbers, including at least one in a function you didn't run.

  • You build with AI and data, not just use them. Show us something you made yourself: a Claude or GPT workflow, a script, a SQL query, a model or an automation. Tell us what it replaced and how you checked it.

  • You take an ambiguous problem, break it down, question the data and come back with a recommendation, not a list of observations.

  • You've got senior people to change how their teams work without managing them, and stayed on good terms.

  • You've run or improved an executive cadence (board packs, leadership meetings, KPI or OKR tracking) and you make sure actions actually close.

  • You know what to decide, what to escalate and what to drop, and you handle confidential information carefully.

  • You read a P&L, unit economics and an operational dashboard without help, and you talk in numbers.

  • You'll take on the unglamorous work, challenge with evidence and give the credit to the team that owns the result.

  • You tell it straight, including what didn't work.

What We Offer

  • A newly created role with direct access to the CEO and regular exposure to the Board.

  • Real breadth: you'll work across every department of a fast-scaling tech business.

  • The chance to shape how a whole company uses AI.

  • Hybrid working: three days in our office next to East Croydon Station, two from home (and friendly office dogs).

title: Client Service Director
descriptionHtml:
Wat gebeurt er als je strategisch klantpartnerschap, technologie, dienstverlening en ontwikkeling samenbrengt in één rol? Dan krijg je een functie waarin je écht het verschil kunt maken voor de grootste retailklanten van Centric.

Als Client Service Director ben jij de drijvende kracht achter het succes van onze belangrijkste klantrelaties. Je begrijpt de business van de klant, denkt strategisch mee en zorgt dat ambities worden vertaald naar concrete resultaten. Je verbindt mensen, stuurt op kwaliteit en voortgang en houdt grip op zowel de dienstverlening als de financiële prestaties.

Wat jij doet

Als Client Service Director ben je verantwoordelijk voor het totale succes van jouw klantrelaties. Je bent de strategische gesprekspartner voor grote retailklanten en zorgt ervoor dat klantbehoeften, dienstverlening, projecten en commerciële doelstellingen samenkomen. Je overziet het geheel, verbindt de juiste mensen en neemt de regie wanneer dat nodig is. Van strategisch advies en klanttevredenheid tot operationele voortgang en financiële resultaten: jij zorgt voor samenhang, grip en resultaat.

  • Strategisch klantpartnerschap: je bouwt aan duurzame relaties met grote retailklanten en bent hun gesprekspartner op directie- en managementniveau. Je begrijpt hun strategie, uitdagingen en ambities en vertaalt deze naar concrete oplossingen en kansen.

  • Regie op dienstverlening: je bewaakt de kwaliteit, continuïteit en prestaties van de dienstverlening op het gebied van hardware en services. Je zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen en dat de dienstverlening aansluit op de verwachtingen van de klant.

  • Programmamanagement en projectregie: je houdt overzicht over meerdere projecten, programma’s en verbeterinitiatieven. Je bewaakt de samenhang, planning, voortgang, risico’s en resultaten en zorgt dat betrokken teams gezamenlijk naar hetzelfde doel werken.

  • Klanttevredenheid en escalatiemanagement: je signaleert knelpunten voordat ze escaleren, neemt de regie wanneer zaken vastlopen en zorgt voor duidelijke afspraken en opvolging. Je vertaalt klantfeedback naar structurele verbeteringen.

  • Samenwerking en stakeholdermanagement: je verbindt de klant met de verschillende teams binnen Centric, waaronder delivery, projectmanagement, techniek, commercie en finance. Je creëert duidelijkheid over prioriteiten, verantwoordelijkheden en resultaten en spreekt betrokkenen aan waar nodig.

  • Financiële verantwoordelijkheid en forecasting: je bewaakt de financiële performance van jouw accounts, waaronder omzet, marges, kosten en contractuele afspraken. Je borgt een actuele en betrouwbare forecast, analyseert afwijkingen en stuurt bij op basis van ontwikkelingen in de dienstverlening, projecten en klantbehoeften.

  • Commerciële ontwikkeling en groei: je signaleert kansen om de samenwerking uit te breiden met aanvullende hardware, services en oplossingen. Je vertaalt klantbehoeften naar concrete proposities en businesscases en werkt samen met commerciële collega's aan duurzame groei en rendement.

  • Continu verbeteren en vooruitkijken: je kijkt kritisch naar de samenwerking, processen en dienstverlening. Je initieert verbeteringen, adviseert over toekomstige behoeften en zorgt dat Centric zich blijft ontwikkelen als strategische partner van de klant.

Dit krijg je

title: Combustion Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital space vehicle that aims to eventually be refuellable in orbit - and potentially fly humans in the long run.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engine, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

We are seeking a talented Combustion Engineer to join our Future Project division. As a key member of our engineering team, you will be responsible for contributing to designing, analyzing, and optimizing combustion devices for cryogenic rocket engines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide support to global combustor fluidic system development through application of both theory and/or CFD.

  • Drive and/or contribute to injector design and optimisation against combustor requirements and design intent using theory and/or CFD.

  • Support definition of instrumentation for hot-fire testing and assist with post-test data interpretation and CFD/model correlation.

  • Reduce and analyse hot-fire test data to derive performance and combustion-stability metrics, and maintain associated data processing tools

  • Support design reviews with clear technical justification of analysis methods, assumptions, and margins.

What we would love to see from you

  • Minimum of a Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 3+ years of relevant/equivalent experience in combustion, propulsion, or reacting-flow engineering.

  • Solid foundation in bi-liquid rocket combustion processes.

  • Strong background in reacting-flow CFD (e.g. ANSYS, OpenFOAM, Converge) using RANS and/or LES

  • Strong scripting and data-analysis ability in Python or similar

  • Exposure to liquid rocket injector CFD.

  • Experience with combustion of cryogenic propellants.

  • Familiarity with combustion instability, thermoacoustics, or uncertainty quantification is beneficial.

  • Experience supporting or participating in hot-fire test campaigns is beneficial.

Skills and Behaviours

  • Structured and methodical approach to problem solving.

  • Demonstrated rigour: checks reference calculations, documents assumptions, and treats a discrepancy between prediction and test as a problem to be solved rather than dismissed.

  • Ability to work under technical uncertainty and iterate models as test data becomes available.

  • Clear written and verbal communication of assumptions, methods, and conclusions.

  • Comfort working in cross-disciplinary teams across thermo-mechanical, systems, and test engineering.

  • Strong analytical rigor and attention to detail.

  • Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company's core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence, and Teamwork.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

descriptionHtml:

Treibe Projekte eigenständig voran, teste neue Ideen und profitiere von Trainings, während du den Erfolg unseres Unternehmens direkt mitgestaltest.

Dein Start bei uns

  • In unserem ersten Call besprechen wir gemeinsam, welches Startdatum am besten für dich passt. Je früher du dich bewirbst, desto besser!

title: Complaints Team Leader - Claims
descriptionHtml:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

Purpose of the role

Claims complaints at an insurer are where things get real — the customer is already in distress, the stakes are higher, and poor handling has direct regulatory consequences.

As Team Leader for Claims Complaints, you'll own the day-to-day running of a team of case handlers, balancing hands-on case work with genuine people leadership. You'll ensure complaints are investigated thoroughly, resolved fairly, and handled in line with DISP and Consumer Duty — and you'll be accountable for the standard your team sets.

You'll report to the Complaints Manager and work closely with the Customer Support & FOS Team Leader to keep standards consistent across the wider function.

What you will be doing

Team Leadership

  • Manage day-to-day operations across case assignment, workload distribution, and queue management

  • Hold regular 1-2-1s, set development plans, and drive continuous improvement in your team

  • Escalate complex, sensitive, or high-risk cases to the Complaints Manager promptly

  • Monitor KPIs and identify areas for improvement

Quality & Compliance

  • Sign off Final Response Letters, ensuring they are clear, fair, and evidence a full investigation

  • Keep complaints logged, acknowledged, and progressed within DISP timescales

  • Apply Consumer Duty and vulnerable customer standards consistently across all case handling

Collaboration

  • Work with Claims Technical, Underwriting, and Legal & Regulatory Affairs on coverage, avoidance, or legal risk complaints

  • Partner with the Customer Support & FOS Team Leader to maintain consistent standards across the function

  • Contribute to QA reviews, training needs analysis, and complaint trend improvements

What you will need to be successful

Essential

  • Experience handling motor insurance claims or complaints within an FCA-regulated environment.

  • Working knowledge of DISP and Consumer Duty as they apply to complaint handling.

  • Experience leading a team, or clear readiness to step into a first-line leadership role.

  • You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to be an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

Desirable:

  • Cert CII or working towards a financial services qualification.

  • Experience of ShareDo, Snowflake, or Looker, or equivalent case management and MI tools.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

Equal opportunities 🌈

We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Consultant Presales & Solutions (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du verstehst Prozesse schneller als andere und willst Kunden mit einer Lösung überzeugen, die wirklich passt? Dann verbinde bei uns Beratung, Technik und Vertrieb in einer Rolle.

Wer wir sind

docu-fix digitalisiert den sozialwirtschaftlichen Mittelstand. Wir automatisieren Prozesse rund um Dokumente: Scan-Dienstleistungen, Dokumentenmanagement (u. a. DocuWare), Workflows und E-Signatur. Unsere Kunden sind unter anderem Träger der Sozialwirtschaft, Rechenzentren und öffentliche Verkehrsbetriebe.

Unsere Kunden sparen mit uns bis zu 80 % ihrer Prozesskosten – mit einer Lösung, die EU-konform ist. Wir wachsen stark, und unser Vertrieb liefert immer mehr qualifizierte Termine. Damit aus diesen Terminen Projekte werden, suchen wir dich.

Was du machst

  • Du übernimmst die Termine, die unser Inside Sales vereinbart, und führst sie bis zum Abschluss.

  • Du nimmst Prozesse auf. Im Erstgespräch und im Workshop fragst du so lange nach, bis klar ist, wo beim Kunden Zeit und Geld liegen bleiben.

  • Du zeigst die Lösung. In der Demo sieht der Kunde seinen eigenen Rechnungseingang, seine Personalakte oder seinen Vertragsprozess – nicht eine Standardpräsentation.

  • Du entwirfst das Lösungskonzept: welche Bausteine aus Scan, DocuWare, Workflow, Schnittstellen und E-Signatur zusammenpassen und was sie bringen.

  • Du kalkulierst den Aufwand, schreibst das Angebot gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb und vertrittst es vor Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung und Fachabteilung.

  • Du übergibst gewonnene Projekte sauber dokumentiert an unser Team Technischer Service & Implementierung und bleibst für den Kunden ansprechbar.

  • Du baust Wiederverwendbares auf: Demo-Umgebungen, Lösungsvorlagen und Referenzszenarien für unsere Zielbranchen.

Worauf du dich einstellst

  • Wir verkaufen kein Standardprodukt. Jeder Kunde hat andere Systeme, andere Abläufe und andere Vorgaben – du baust daraus eine Lösung, die trägt.

  • Du sprichst mit Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung und Buchhaltung. Die eine will Zahlen, die andere Architektur, die dritte einen Alltag, der funktioniert.

  • Du stehst zwischen Vertrieb und Technik. Du versprichst nur, was unser Implementierungsteam liefern kann.

  • Du arbeitest an mehreren Kunden gleichzeitig und hältst Fristen für Angebote und Ausschreibungen.

  • Du bist bei Kunden vor Ort und online unterwegs.

Wen wir suchen

  • Du hast Erfahrung in Presales, Consulting, Business Analyse oder der Einführung von Unternehmenssoftware.

  • Du denkst in Prozessen. Du verstehst, wie ein Rechnungseingang, eine Freigabe oder eine Aktenführung abläuft, und siehst, wo es hakt.

  • Du erklärst Technik so, dass eine Geschäftsführung entscheidet und eine IT-Leitung zustimmt.

  • Du bist technisch fit: Schnittstellen, Cloud und On-Premises, Berechtigungen und Datenmodelle sind dir vertraut. Programmieren musst du nicht.

  • Du schreibst Konzepte und Angebote, die man ohne Rückfrage versteht.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, verbindlich und gern im Team mit Vertrieb und Technik.

  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch, weil Workshops, Konzepte und Angebote auf Deutsch laufen.

Hilft, ist aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit DocuWare oder anderen DMS-, ECM- oder Workflow-Systemen

  • Kenntnis der Sozialwirtschaft, des öffentlichen Sektors oder von ERP- und Finanzbuchhaltungssystemen

  • Erfahrung mit E-Rechnung, E-Signatur oder revisionssicherer Archivierung

title: Content Marketing Lead
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

About the Role

As Content Lead at Dex, you'll write and publish everything that carries our name.

You'll own Dex's channels: the website, social, email, our events programme and blog. You'll take a content strategy that already exists and turn it into a steady, high-quality output.

This is a job for someone who writes fast and well, and who thinks past the draft. The copy is half of it. The other half is knowing where a piece needs to land, what it needs to look like to get found, and what it should do to the reader once it does.

You'll work closely with Marketing, Growth, Design and Product.

You'll have real autonomy and very little bureaucracy.

What You'll Do

  • Own the channels. The publishing calendar across site, social, email and the blog is yours. You decide what runs, when, and in what order.

  • Write across every format. LinkedIn and X posts, campaign and event emails, landing pages, product and lifecycle copy, event pages and follow-ups, articles and explainers. A 90-word page and a 1,500-word argument in the same afternoon, both sounding like us.

  • Think in distribution, not just drafts. Every piece gets planned around where it will be read: why a piece lands on Hacker News and dies on LinkedIn, which newsletters and communities our audience already trusts.

  • Write for search and AI answers. We have a GEO and SEO spec built with our search partner: answer-first structure, extractable formatting, clean internal linking, author entity pages. You'll write to it and help us improve it.

  • Carry the events programme. Copy and collateral for our event series, before, during and after, and the follow-up sequences that turn attendance into something.

  • Work the numbers. Track performance and report back on the metrics that matter across our owned blog and organic social media channels.

  • Use AI properly. Research, outlining, structuring, first passes, repurposing, quality checks. We'll give you all the Claude tokens you can use. We will not ship anything that sounds like AI wrote it, and we'll ask you how you draw that line.

  • Guard the voice. You'll be the most frequent user of our tone of voice and audience research, and the person most responsible for whether it holds up in public.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years writing in-house or at an agency, ideally for a technical or developer audience, ideally in a start-up where you had to build the process as well as the output

  • Genuine range across formats and lengths, evidenced by a portfolio of published work

  • A real view on distribution: where our audience discovers, consumes and shares things, and what a piece needs to look like to survive that journey

  • Working knowledge of SEO and how AI search surfaces content, enough to write to a spec and challenge it

  • Fluent with AI tools across research, outlining and iteration, with judgement about where the machine stops and you start

  • Commercial literacy. You can connect a piece of content to an outcome and look beyond vanity metrics

  • Editorial judgement under your own steam. You can take a rough steer and come back with something better than the brief

  • A proactive communicator who works well without supervision and asks for what they need

Nice to Have

  • Any technical background, formal or self-taught

  • You've run a newsletter, blog or publication of your own

  • Experience marketing to engineers, developers or another audience that punishes fluff

  • Experience with content for events and communities

  • Basic design or motion skills, enough to get a social asset out without waiting

What this role isn't

Not a strategy job. The strategy exists and you're here to execute it, though you'll influence it constantly and we expect you to argue with it.

Not a pure writing job. Publishing, sequencing, formatting, distribution and measurement are all yours.

What We Offer

  • Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

  • Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

  • Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

  • Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

  • Gym membership & wellness benefits

  • Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

  • Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

  • MacBook Pro + team kit

  • "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support


Interview process

We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:

  1. We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback.

  2. A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

  3. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

  4. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

  5. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.

descriptionHtml:

Carwow Group is driven by a passion for getting people into cars. But not just any car, the right car. That’s why we are building the go-to destination for car-changing. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia, doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with over 1.1 billion annual views, sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.
