title: Finance and Strategy Senior Associate
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Finance team shapes the company's future by directing capital to high-impact investments, developing robust financial strategies, and ensuring we deliver long-term value while pursuing our ambitious mission.

We're looking for a Finance & Strategy Senior Associate to join our London team. In this role, you'll work with partners across Deliveroo to ensure we are making efficient, data-driven decisions that evaluate the effectiveness of our products and unlock new avenues for growth.

Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Finance & Strategy team. We accelerate the growth of our business by implementing new opportunities and solutions, partnering across the company to improve the profitability and scalability of our business model.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Consumer Product Impact: Evaluate the effectiveness of high-impact consumer products at scale and develop creative growth strategies.

  • Strategic Modelling: Build custom financial models tailored to specific business needs to improve high-stakes strategic decision-making.

  • Framework Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to develop new investment decision-making frameworks and processes in a fast-paced environment.

  • KPI Analysis: Track and analyse key business and financial KPIs, uncovering trends to assess risks and future opportunities.

  • Operational Scaling: Lead special projects to automate and scale reporting tools, investment frameworks, and cost-tracking methodologies.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Strategic Finance Background: Significant experience in strategic finance, corporate finance, or investment banking, ideally within the high-growth technology sector.

  • Advanced Modelling Skills: High proficiency in Excel with a proven ability to build robust financial models and perform complex analyses.

  • Data Fluency: Proficiency in SQL (or a strong willingness to learn) to manipulate large data sets and uncover hidden insights.

  • Commercial Mindset: Strong understanding of budget management and the ability to partner with cross-functional teams to drive operational value.

  • Adaptability: Proven ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, evolving environment that values autonomy and ownership.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Finance Transformation Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
Join Qonto as a Finance Transformation Project Manager, based in Paris, and take full ownership of high-impact, cross-functional initiatives — from analyzing current gaps to selecting providers, implementing new processes, and driving adoption across Finance. Your work will directly shape how Qonto’s Finance functions at scale.

You will work closely with your Finance Transformation peers and Core Finance, Strategic Finance, Product and Tech teams. You will be in the details of our processes and tools, while keeping the big picture in sight.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Own your projects end to end: frame the scope, build the plan, governance and risk tracking, and coordinate the delivery.

  • Diagnose our current processes and tools: in relation to your project scope, map the flows end to end, use data to find pain points and compliance risks, and turn them into a prioritized roadmap within your project plan.

  • Choose the right solution: define requirements, run build-or-buy analysis, run RFPs or assess our existing tools when relevant, and recommend the best option, whether that means improving what we have, building in-house or selecting a new solution.

  • Build and roll out hands-on: work shoulder to shoulder with the business teams, Product Owners and system experts on configuration, integrations and testing, then drive adoption across the teams concerned.

  • Steer cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority: run the project rituals, anticipate risks, arbitrate trade-offs and keep leadership updated on progress and blockers.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Project leadership: you have led finance transformation or systems projects end to end (framing, delivery, adoption) for 6+ years, and you drive Finance and Tech teams within your project scope without hierarchy.

  • Hands-on and systems-minded: you map processes yourself, analyze data and test solutions with Tech instead of only writing specs. You are comfortable with finance tools and data flows (ERP, purchase-to-pay or procurement tools such as Coupa).

  • Finance process know-how: you can map finance flows from purchasing to payment and accounting, spot dependencies and design pragmatic, compliant solutions.

  • Structured problem-solving: you diagnose with data, run tool selections or RFPs, and turn recommendations into changes that stick.

  • Clear communication & stakeholder management: you are able to influence across teams and present complex topics simply to any audience.

  • Qonto fit: you connect with our culture and with how we work: autonomy, customer satisfaction at the core, and collaboration across teams. You are fluent in English (French is a plus).

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Cross-functional exposure: work closely with teams across Finance, Product, Tech and Growth, giving you a 360° view of how finance operates in a fintech at scale.

  • A high-impact roadmap: participate in the transformation our current processes, tools and people into a best-in-class Finance function ready for our next stages of development.

  • A playbook to build: help create and refine our finance transformation playbook, challenge existing processes and shape how we work.

  • How we work: a data-driven, hands-on culture, with high autonomy and access to senior leaders when needed.

  • Tools we use: our Finance stack includes SAP ERP Cloud, Coupa, Kyriba, Amelkis, and Anaplan.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Marie Pouzin, Head of Finance Transformation. Marie has led multiple successful finance transformation projects across very different environments (audit, large corporation, small start-up, scale-up). She combines a strategic vision with a hands-on approach, so you get both the guidance and the support you need to make a real impact.

title: Financial Crime Investigator
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role:

  • We’re hiring new financial crime investigators due to continued business growth.

  • You’ll conduct important financial crime screening checks and investigations into new applicants and existing customers.

  • You will use screening tools to match customer data against PEPs & Sanctions lists and use your initiative to determine the risks associated with the application/ customer.

  • You will review customer profile information and transactional activity to identify financial crime risks, and take appropriate action on the account..

  • You will submit internal Suspicious Activity Reports in instances where suspicious activity has been identified. 

  • As the business grows you may be required to take on additional tasks to support the Financial Crime Team.

  • You’ll work in the office 3 days per week.

  • You'll work 40 hours per week. This means you'll work Monday to Friday, from 9am to 6pm, with a one hour lunch break.

  • You'll also work one full weekend (Saturday and Sunday), once every 4 weeks, and have two weekdays off in lieu.

Your team’s objectives

  • Protect our customers and society, by preventing fraud and financial crime.

  • Comply with financial crime regulations and company policy.

  • Minimise customer and applicant friction through skilled and timely decisions.

  • Identify opportunities for product and process improvement.

How you’ll impact those objectives

  • You’ll support new application checks and existing customer monitoring.

  • You’ll investigate potential Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) and Sanctions matches, and assist with onboarding reviews.

  • You’ll monitor activity and transactions on customer accounts.

  • You will help mitigate risk by escalating Financial crime concerns that you have identified during your reviews.

What do you need to succeed in this role?

  • Ability to collaborate effectively within a diverse team.

  • Have an analytical mindset with a good attention to detail.

  • Strong decision-making skills, and excellent writing skills to document decisions. 

  • Can effectively communicate with customers, applicants and senior management, when necessary.

  • Proficient time management skills, comfortable meeting targets and deadlines.

  • Previous financial crime experience is advantageous, particularly around screening and KYC.

  • Experience in identifying opportunities for process improvements and implementing solutions, including the use of automation and AI technologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in financial crime prevention.

  • Demonstrated ability to leverage data, machine learning, and AI to develop and optimise strategies for fraud and financial crime detection and prevention.

The interview process

We’re not a corporation so we try our best to get things moving as quickly as possible. For this role we’d expect:

1) A 15 minute Cognitive Assessment

2) A 30 minute call with a member of the Talent team

3) An onsite Interview and Assessment with the Financial Crime Team Leader/Manager

4) Video Interview with the Head of Fraud and Financial Crime

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

title: First Line Manager (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
We're building a sales team that wins, and we're looking for the leaders who'll make it happen.

As a First Line Manager at Lio, you're a true player-coach. You build, coach and lead a team of 6–8 Account Executives, and when a big deal is on the line, you're right there in the room helping close it. You don't chase a quota of your own. You own your team's number, and the goal is ambitious: hit the target together, then double it.


What you'll do

  • Lead your team to its number. You help your team hit its target and build the pipeline and habits that let it grow from there.

  • Be there when deals need you. You join calls, visit customers on site and help close seven-figure opportunities. When the usual playbook isn't enough, you get creative.

  • Know what's real in your forecast. You're curious about every deal and look into it yourself, so you and your team always know where you stand.

  • Take ownership. If a deal stalls, you reach out to the champion yourself. If it needs a workshop, you're happy to run it. You do what the deal needs.

  • Help your reps grow. You make coaching, training and deal reviews part of the team's week, and nothing motivates you more than seeing your AEs succeed.

  • Bring our way of selling to life. You know the product well and sell in an inquisitive, consultative and educative way, so your team learns it from you.


Who you are

  • You've carried a quota, closed complex B2B or enterprise deals, and still enjoy selling.

  • You've led a sales team, had a first management experience, or feel ready to take that step. Many of our future managers start as AEs at Lio, get to know how we sell, and then grow into leadership.

  • You're entrepreneurial and find creative ways to reach a goal.

  • You like to check things for yourself and ask good questions, including of your own team.

  • You love learning and are excited to adapt to how we sell rather than bringing a ready-made playbook.

  • Building a team excites you more than your own quota.


This might not be the right fit if…

  • you'd prefer to focus purely on people management and step away from deals.

  • you'd rather stick to one proven playbook than adapt it.

  • you'd rather keep your own quota than build a team.

  • you prefer to rely on your team's forecast without digging into it.


Why now

Our Go-To-Market team will grow significantly over the next year. You'd join early enough to shape how we lead sales, at a point where you can already see it working. Together with our sales leadership, you'll build your team and help define what great sales management looks like at Lio.

If you're hungry to build a team that outperforms every target, to turn good reps into great ones, and to win the biggest deals together, we want to hear from you.

title: Forward Deployed Strategist
descriptionHtml:
About NearformNearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart. 

We're on a mission to reinvent how our clients work

Most companies are bolting AI onto old processes and hoping for the best. We think that's the wrong way round.

Nearform is on an exciting journey with AI, and we're building a new team to lead it. The team brings together two worlds that rarely meet: the business thinking of a strategy firm and the engineering depth of a company that builds and ships real products. That puts us in a small group of firms that can do both. We work out what should change and we build it.

The Role

Our clients don't all start in the same place. Some know something has to change but have no idea where to start. Others have a clear picture of the future and are ready to build. Most are somewhere in between.

Your job is to work out where each client really is and shape the right solution for them. That could mean helping a leadership team choose which process to tackle first. It could also mean turning a rough idea into something our engineers can build.

This isn't a traditional management consulting role

You won't be writing a strategy deck that sits on a shelf. This is  hands-on work, close to the technology, and focused on results you can see.

Primary Responsibilities:

  •  Get on the ground. Sit with the teams doing the work, whether they're checking customers against sanctions lists or pulling together month-end reports. Learn how it really happens, including the workarounds, the judgement calls and the steps nobody wrote down.
  • Spot the opportunity. Find where AI and automation can change the game, and where a person still needs to make the call.

title: Founding ML Engineer (Spectrum)
descriptionHtml:
Software engineers and AI agents alike suffer from the same problem: finding that one person or place that will answer their tough, specific question. Many solutions promise to solve this with similarity search in vector databases. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning. 

Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. We aim to revolutionize the semantic layer space for software-building organizations and move beyond specs that fall out of sync with code, introducing a living spec – one that’s extracted from the whole system and used to keep it aligned. Spectrum is meant to be the single source of truth for all product and architectural knowledge.

Spectrum is a resident of JetBrains' startup incubator, with startup speed and autonomy, and backed by 25 years of developer tooling expertise. We are looking for a top-class ML Engineer who will help us shape the future of software development. You will own our AI and ML engineering stack and help define the research agenda for our team. Your technical vision and design decisions will directly shape the product and determine its success.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing and building the ML/LLM solution for data ingestion, knowledge extraction, retrieval, and subsequent reasoning.
  • Creating the datasets, metrics, and pipelines that drive measurable improvements across the system.
  • Architecting and improving agents for context retrieval, knowledge extraction, and data alignment, which includes prompt engineering, model selection, and inference optimization.
  • Establishing MLOps practices, including orchestration, observability, and experiment tracking.
  • Collaborating with the engineering team on system design and with JetBrains Research on the research agenda.
  • Defining hiring criteria, growing the ML team, and shaping the ML team culture.

We expect you to have:

  • A proven track record as an ML/AI Lead.
  • At least five years of experience in ML/AI systems, with at least two years focused on LLMs and generative AI.
  • A deep understanding of the LLM ecosystem, including model architectures and fine-tuning approaches.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Prompt engineering and LLM pipeline design, including evaluation.
    • Agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangSmith, smolagents, or an equivalent.
    • Vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.
    • Deploying and scaling LLM-powered applications using APIs (e.g. OpenAI or Anthropic) or open-source models.
  • Strong Python skills – Kotlin knowledge would be a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Proficiency in English, both written and verbal. 

Our ideal candidate would have:

  • Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or graph-based reasoning.
  • Experience in early-stage startups – you enjoy the zero-to-one phase.
  • The ability to think strategically about product-led AI, beyond just training models in isolation.
  • A background in code analysis, developer tools, or software engineering research.
  • Experience with multi-agent systems or complex agentic workflows.
  • Actively contributed to relevant open-source projects or publications.

What we offer

  • A competitive salary and JetBrains benefits.
  • A generous runway and corporate resources with startup autonomy.

Qualifikation

title: Full-Stack Engineer - Data, Infrastructure & AI
descriptionHtml:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. These founding roles will shape both the product and the way we build it.

About the role

You will be a full-stack engineer, shipping customer features across the interface, application services and database. Your particular strength will be the data and infrastructure that make those features dependable: how records are stored, how imports and background jobs run, and how information moves between Agent F and a customer’s other tools. You will help build and operate the whole product, with deeper ownership of this foundation.

This is hands-on full-stack engineering. A typical piece of work could involve extending a data model, implementing an application service, connecting it to a screen, testing it against a real database and following the release into production. You will also investigate slow reports, failed imports and jobs that stop halfway through, then improve the system so it handles those situations reliably.

That foundation also supports our AI work. As we add document extraction, connected customer knowledge and software that takes actions for customers, you will build the services and data access those features need. The immediate priority is dependable software that customers can use, with more capable automation developed around specific tasks.

What you will build and improve

  • Application services and customer features. Build the logic and application programming interfaces (APIs) that connect records, business rules and screens. Take features through implementation, testing, release and production support.

  • The database foundation. Design clear data models, enforce relationships and transaction boundaries, and improve slow queries. Manage schema changes through reviewed migrations, preserve financial history and keep each customer’s data isolated.

  • Imports and integrations. Connect accounting tools, business systems and spreadsheets to a consistent model. Validate incoming records, handle changing source formats, and check that imported totals and reports agree with the source.

  • Reliable background processing. Build scheduled jobs and workers that process work outside a user request. Handle retries without creating duplicates, resume interrupted runs, and make progress and failures visible to the team.

  • Performance and recovery. Diagnose expensive queries, processing bottlenecks and partial failures. Test changes against real databases, plan for growing workloads, and build procedures to recover processing safely with the platform engineer.

  • Practical AI automation. Add features such as extracting invoice fields or preparing an order from approved business data. Give models access through controlled services, check the result and require approval where needed. Develop connected customer knowledge when a feature needs those relationships, and measure whether it improves the result.

For example, a large customer import stops halfway through and the same records arrive again on the next run. You would make processing resume safely, prevent duplicate records, verify the resulting totals and expose the job’s status in the product. You would also investigate whether database queries or worker capacity caused the failure and ship the necessary fix.

What you bring

You have seven or more years of software engineering experience, including substantial ownership of production applications and data systems. You have designed relational data models, built services and processing pipelines, and stayed responsible for them after release. You are comfortable delivering across the stack and using AI tools in your daily work.

You can explain how you diagnosed a slow query, recovered a failed job or shipped a database change safely. You understand what happens when two requests arrive at once, a dependency becomes unavailable or a process restarts halfway through its work. You can follow a problem from a source record through the application to the result a customer sees.

Core experience

  • Full-stack development with TypeScript, Node.js, React and PostgreSQL, or closely comparable technologies.

  • Relational data modelling, SQL, query optimisation, indexes, transactions and reviewed database migrations.

  • Application services and APIs, including permissions, validation and handling concurrent requests.

  • Data imports, integrations and background jobs, including queues, safe retries and recovery from partial failures.

  • Production debugging, service monitoring and performance work on systems used by real customers.

  • Automated tests against real databases and other service dependencies.

  • Practical use of AI in software, with an understanding of how to check outputs and control access to customer data.

  • Daily use of AI coding agents, with direct responsibility for code review and verification.

  • A computer science or computer engineering degree, or equivalent practical depth.

Useful additional experience

Financial or operational systems where correctness and traceability matter; larger data migrations; cloud storage and container-based workloads. Experience putting document extraction or features using large language models (LLMs) into production would be valuable. Knowledge graphs, which connect related company records, and privately hosted or adapted models are useful as we develop that part of the product.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would take ownership of an existing service or data flow, understand how it runs in production and ship a customer-facing improvement through it. You would address a concrete reliability or performance problem, such as a slow report, a fragile integration or a job that cannot recover cleanly after interruption.

We would look for working features, faster and more predictable processing, fewer failed or manually repaired jobs, and useful tests and monitoring. An early automation feature could follow where the data and services are ready and its benefit can be measured.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in a dependable application backbone: processing completes, records reconcile and customers can trust the results. When a job fails or figures disagree, you take ownership of the investigation and recovery. Missing transactions, duplicate entries or unexplained balance differences can be financial emergencies even while every service appears available. You assess the impact, contain affected processing, trace the cause and verify the repaired result before treating the incident as resolved.

Customer commitments shape how we work. You are willing to interrupt planned work, respond promptly and stay engaged when an urgent issue puts a service-level agreement (SLA), onboarding commitment or financial deadline at risk. That requires flexibility beyond normal working hours as part of agreed on-call coverage and coordinated incident response. You keep people informed and see the issue through to a verified recovery or an explicit handover. Afterwards, you improve the system so the same emergency becomes less likely.

How you will work

This is a senior founding role in a small team. You will own the application and data infrastructure for your work, and carry a full share of customer feature delivery. You will collaborate across infrastructure, operations and product design to deliver complete customer outcomes. You will use coding agents to implement changes and remain responsible for reviewing, testing and operating the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole product and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and in-person in Berlin. German is not required.

title: Fullstack Developer .NET
descriptionHtml:
Bij OrtaX, onderdeel van Centric, werk je aan software die gemeenten ondersteunt bij het efficiënt, betrouwbaar en transparant uitvoeren van het WOZ-proces. Onze ambitie gaat verder dan alleen het onderhouden van bestaande software. We ontwikkelen OrtaX continu door en investeren daarbij in nieuwe technologie, data, automatisering en een toekomstbestendige architectuur.

Als Fullstack Developer speel je daarin een belangrijke rol. Je werkt aan zowel de frontend als backend van OrtaX, bouwt nieuwe functionaliteit en helpt tegelijkertijd de bestaande applicatie stap voor stap te moderniseren.

1. Wat ga je doen?

Als Fullstack Developer werk je samen met developers, analisten en andere specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van OrtaX.Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • ontwikkelen van nieuwe functionaliteit in C#/.NET;

  • ontwikkelen van moderne gebruikersinterfaces en webfunctionaliteit;

  • werken aan frontendfunctionaliteit met met één van de grote frontend frameworks;

  • ontwerpen en verbeteren van API's en integraties;

  • werken met databases en data-intensieve functionaliteit;

  • schrijven van onderhoudbare, testbare en kwalitatief goede code;

  • bijdragen aan CI/CD, automated testing en DevOps;

  • oplossen van technische vraagstukken die frontend, backend en data met elkaar verbinden;

  • meedenken over architectuur en technische keuzes;

  • stap voor stap moderniseren van bestaande onderdelen van OrtaX.

Je werkt aan een volwassen product waarin continu de afweging wordt gemaakt tussen vandaag waarde leveren en bouwen aan de architectuur van morgen.

2. De technische uitdaging

OrtaX heeft een bestaand softwarelandschap én een duidelijke moderniseringsopgave. Binnen het ontwikkelproces worden onder andere Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, pipelines, testing, SonarQube en Oracle gebruikt. Dat betekent dat je niet alleen bezig bent met: “Hoe bouw ik deze feature?” maar ook met vragen als: “Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat wat we vandaag bouwen ook past bij waar we technisch naartoe willen?” Voor een developer die graag verder kijkt dan alleen zijn of haar eigen user story is hier dus veel te doen.

Bij OrtaX gebruiken we AI als een belangrijk hulpmiddel bij het ontwikkelproces. Daarbij geloven wij ook dat de developer verantwoordelijk is dat we goede code en een duidelijke architectuur opleveren. Ook op lange termijn willen we beschikken over een goed onderhoudbaar product. Daarbij is AI inmiddels een essentieel hulpmiddel, maar niet zonder input van de developer.

3. Wie zoeken we?

We zoeken vooral een developer die nieuwsgierig is en zich prettig voelt aan meerdere kanten van de applicatie. Je:

  • hebt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in bijvoorbeeld Software Engineering, Informatica, Computer Science of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • hebt ervaring met C# en .NET;

  • hebt ervaring met, of interesse in, moderne frontendontwikkeling;

  • hebt bij voorkeur gewerkt met één van de grote frontend frameworks;

  • begrijpt principes rondom API's, databases en softwarearchitectuur;

  • schrijft graag code die niet alleen werkt, maar ook begrijpelijk en onderhoudbaar is;

  • bent gewend om samen te werken in een Agile/Scrum-omgeving;

  • denkt analytisch en vindt het leuk om complexe problemen terug te brengen tot een pragmatische oplossing;

  • durft bestaande oplossingen ter discussie te stellen, maar begrijpt ook dat software stap voor stap moet kunnen veranderen;

  • communiceert makkelijk met developers, analisten en andere collega's.

Je hoeft niet op ieder onderdeel expert te zijn. We vinden het belangrijker dat je technisch sterk bent, graag leert en bereid bent je zowel aan de frontend- als backendkant verder te ontwikkelen.

4. Waarom OrtaX?

OrtaX ondersteunt gemeenten en samenwerkingsverbanden bij het WOZ-proces en richt zich op consistente, uitlegbare waarderingen en slimme automatisering. Daarbij wordt geïnvesteerd in technologieën zoals data-analyse, AI, automatisering en integratie.

Je werkt daardoor aan software waarvan de toepassing heel concreet is. Tegelijkertijd kom je in een omgeving waarin technisch nog veel te ontwikkelen en te moderniseren valt.

Je krijgt dus de combinatie van een volwassen product én de technische veranderopgave die normaal gesproken vooral bij een nieuw product hoort.

5. Wat bieden we jou?

Het salaris ligt tussen € 4700,- en € 5500,- per maand (daarnaast ontvang je een variabele beloning, vaste 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld), afhankelijk van je rol, competentieprofiel en ervaring.  Verder bieden we je uitstekende voorwaarden, waaronder: 

  • deelname aan een goede pensioenregeling 

  • 27 vakantiedagen (gebaseerd op een fulltime contract) 

  • mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen 

  • Hybride werken vanuit huis en het kantoor in Amsterdam (uiteraard ben je welkom om elke dag op kantoor te werken) 

  • reiskostenvergoeding voor je dagelijkse woon-werkverkeer en evt. zakelijke reizen 

  • mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen met een trainingsprogramma en wekelijkse onderzoeks- en kennisbijeenkomsten 

  • je start met een jaarcontract, daarna is er uitzicht op een vast contract, omdat we streven naar een langdurige samenwerking 

  • een prettige werkomgeving met enthousiaste en leuke collega's! 

6. Over OrtaX

OrtaX ondersteunt gemeenten en samenwerkingsverbanden bij het efficiënt, betrouwbaar en transparant uitvoeren van het WOZ-proces. De ambitie is om taxateurs te ondersteunen met slimme automatisering en tegelijk te investeren in nieuwe technologie, procesautomatisering en integratie.

Daarbij werken we niet alleen aan wat OrtaX vandaag nodig heeft, maar ook aan hoe het product er technisch morgen uit moet zien.

Wil jij daar als Fullstack Developer aan meebouwen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

You’ll work closely with internal Engineering, Product and Sales stakeholders to seamlessly integrate prospective customer data with our services, supporting them to create an optimized and accurate product discovery demo.

Du hast Dein Abitur mit sehr guten Leistungen abgeschlossen oder befindest Dich zwischen Bachelor und Master.

Analytisches Denkvermögen, Hands-on-Mentalität und unternehmerisches Gespür.

Reife, Eigenverantwortung und Lust, schnell zu lernen, auch wenn vieles neu ist.

Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Warum wir?

Unser Ziel: ein faires, datengetriebenes Wertgutachten für jede Immobilie in Deutschland. Bei Certa ersetzen wir das klassische Sachverständigenwesen durch eine KI-gestützte Bewertungsplattform, die schneller, präziser und transparenter ist als alles, was der Markt heute kennt.

Du planst ein Gap Year zwischen Schule und Studium oder zwischen Bachelor und Master und willst diese Zeit nicht mit Backpacking-Klischees, sondern mit echter Verantwortung füllen? Bei Certa bekommst Du eine Rolle, die Du in einem Jahr nirgendwo sonst bekommst.

Das Office der Geschäftsführung arbeitet direkt mit den beiden Gründern und Geschäftsführern (Alexander Rausch & Matthias Mertens) an den Top-Themen, die Certa als Unternehmen entscheidend voranbringen. Trotz der Nähe zur Geschäftsführung leben wir eine entrepreneuriale, pragmatische Arbeitskultur: kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen, hohe Umsetzungstiefe.

Ein Gap Year bei Certa ist kein Praktikum mit Abstrichen, sondern eine vollwertige Rolle mit eigenen Verantwortungsbereichen. Du bekommst Zeit, in mehrere Themen tief reinzukommen, eigene Projekte aufzubauen und mit der Zeit echte Ownership zu übernehmen.

Ein Jahr, das Dich prägt: Du lernst in 12 Monaten mehr über Wirtschaft, Technologie und Unternehmensführung als in den ersten zwei Studienjahren.

Direkte Linie zu den Gründern: Du arbeitest täglich mit den beiden Gründern und Geschäftsführern. Keine Layer, keine Politik, keine Slide-Schlachten.

Spielwiese für KI-Enthusiasten: Bei uns ist KI kein Buzzword, sondern Arbeitsalltag. Du bekommst Zugang zu allen relevanten Tools und Modellen.

Echte Verantwortung: Du arbeitest an Themen, die wirklich zählen, nicht an Beschäftigungstherapie.

Faire Vergütung: Anders als bei vielen Gap-Year-Programmen wirst Du bei uns als vollwertiges Teammitglied bezahlt.

Perspektive über das Gap Year hinaus: Werkstudentenstelle während des Studiums, langfristige Mentorship und ein klarer Einstiegspfad nach dem Abschluss.

title: General Manager, League of Legends
descriptionHtml:
Fnatic League of Legends holds one of the richest histories and legacies in the game, from its inception to the present day. As General Manager, you will lead one of the premier teams in Fnatic’s portfolio, with a critical role in continually raising the bar and adding to that legacy of success.

In 2027 we go into a rebuild, and we are looking for an exciting new General Manager to lead that effort. You will shape the squad, the staff and the environment around them, and set the direction for the years that follow.

You'll report to the Chief Gaming Officer.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the sporting performance and delivery of results of Fnatic League of Legends, shaping a team capable of sustained success

  • Lead recruitment and selection of League of Legends athletes, coaches and performance staff, and execute changes as necessary, including benching and transfers

  • With the coaching staff, establish a high performance culture through defining key values and expectations that the team should represent and follow

  • Manage team performance and behaviours, ensuring standards are upheld through appropriate recognition and disciplinary actions

  • Create an elite-tier performance environment with the practice approach, facilities, scheduling and team operations required to win at the highest level

  • Establish a platform and team culture that makes Fnatic a home players and staff aspire to be at and want to stay at, through player care and player experience worthy of their ambition

  • Establish a clear team structure and processes, and continually optimise them in collaboration with senior Esports management

  • Manage the League of Legends team budget, allocating resources effectively to deliver competitive success whilst supporting revenue generating activities

  • Oversee player contracts and obligations, monitoring the delivery of player obligations towards Fnatic, Riot Games and our partners

  • Champion a data and science led approach across recruitment, performance and decision-making, building on Fnatic's analytics capability and the tools that support it

  • Nurture relationships with title stakeholders on League of Legends specific topics, including Riot Games, tournament organisers, teams and player representatives, protecting the team’s interests throughout

  • Be a proactive ambassador for Fnatic across media, community and partner activities, including but not limited to interviews, content, community, and fan meetings

  • Ensure Fnatic brand, content and partnership strategies can be activated through player insights and access, and that the wider business is integrated with, and understood by, our League of Legends division

  • Lead on ad-hoc sporting projects as defined by CGO

We’re looking for:

  • Leadership experience within professional gaming or sports, with genuine accountability for results

  • Passion for esports and a strong understanding of the League of Legends scene

  • Competitive instinct and knowledge of what it takes to win

  • People management experience, including coaches and world-class athletes

  • Ability to inspire and educate the current and next generation of professional gamers, with a readiness to walk the extra mile for players when needed

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the confidence to represent Fnatic publicly and build trusted relationships with players, staff and fans

  • Commercial literacy, comfortable holding a budget and producing business cases

  • Proven ability to work with talent and people from diverse cultures and backgrounds

  • Excellent written and verbal English, other languages desirable

  • Based in Berlin, or willing to relocate


Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: #AlwaysFnatic

At Fnatic, we believe that a diverse mix of voices leads to better discussions, decisions, and outcomes for everyone. We strive to recruit and nurture an inclusive workforce who feel empowered every day to forge the future as part of the Black and Orange squad.

We know that applying for jobs can be daunting - but be assured that at Fnatic:

  • Who you are, and how you identify has no impact on our selection process

  • We understand no candidate will tick 100% of what our job descriptions are seeking, so if you’re missing a point here or there, we still want to hear from you

  • We're happy to consider reasonable adjustments where needed to fully participate in Fnatic’s recruitment experience - just let us know.

About us

Fnatic is a global esports performance brand headquartered in London, laser-focused on seeking out, levelling up and amplifying gamers and creators. Our history is unparalleled. Founded in 2004, we are the most successful esports brand of the last decade, winning more than 200 championships across 30 different games.

Today, driven by our ability to advance esports performance, Fnatic is the channel through which the most forward-thinking brands communicate with young people. We deliver industry-leading content, experiences and activations globally with bases in Berlin, Belgrade, Tokyo among others. Our pros and creators generate hundreds of millions of watch hours, showcasing our global partners to an audience of millions of fans across our social platforms.

Forging the future is in our DNA. We pioneered the intersection of street culture and esports with merch collaborations, and continue to lead the industry with the quality of our pro wear and fan apparel. After launching in 2016, our award-winning esports equipment (comprising mice, keyboards, headsets and pads) has sold to hundreds of thousands of gaming enthusiasts who want to play better.

Gaming is the place where music, fashion, sport and technology come together, and Fnatic is leading the charge.

title: Generalist, Fellowships
descriptionHtml:
You make sure each fellowship cohort runs smoothly, from acceptance to the last day, so that fellows and Research Managers can focus on research.

  • Salary: £68,250–£95,500 per year. We may be able to pay more for exceptional candidates.

  • Location: London, at our office at LISA

  • Hours: Full time

  • Visa: We can sponsor a Skilled Worker visa, but approval isn't guaranteed.

Why work at Pivotal

Pivotal finds people who can work on the biggest risks from advanced AI and gets them working on them. Since 2024, 135 fellows have taken part in our fellowships, and alumni now work at METR, Apollo Research, UK AISI and GovAI. We have grown from 2 staff in 2024 to 10 today, and we plan to reach at least 16 in 2027. Read more about us at pivotal-research.org, and about what it is like to work here.

What you might own

There are many areas worth owning at Pivotal that shape how good and productive a fellow’s time with us is. In 2027 we expect about 170 fellows across our fellowships, often with multiple cohorts on site at the same time. You help each of them have an excellent experience.

Which areas you own depends on your strengths and interests. It might be the systems behind each cohort, our events, how we collect and act on fellow feedback, and sometimes new areas will arise. You’ll likely work on several projects and areas at the same time, and these will change as Pivotal grows.

  • Fellow logistics. Onboarding, travel, letters for visas, desks and equipment, and stipend payments with our finance provider.

  • Events. Socials, speaker events, retreats and closing weeks, including the room and AV setup.

  • Fellow experience. Collect feedback during each cohort and fix problems quickly.

  • Records and tools. Keep fellow records and fellowship tools up to date, and automate work that repeats every cohort.

  • Other cohort needs. Take on whatever the cohort needs, with good judgement about what matters most.

Who does well in this role

  • You are organised and reliable: things you own get done, and people know their status.

  • You have run events or operations for a program, a team or an organisation.

  • You understand why a task matters, and you suggest better ways to do it.

  • You are friendly and calm with fellows, also under pressure.

  • You use AI tools to automate repetitive work.

  • You care about reducing catastrophic risks.

We don’t expect anyone to be strong in all of this. If the role excites you, please apply, even if you match only part of what we describe here.

How we hire

We review applications as they come in, so applying early helps. The process has these stages:

  • Written application. A short form and your CV. It takes about 30 minutes.

  • Automated video interview. About 10 minutes. You record short answers to a few questions, at a time that suits you.

  • Work task. About 2 hours, based on real work in this role. We pay you for this time. You may use AI tools, as you would in the job. Tell us which ones you used and how.

  • Personal interview. About 45 minutes. We discuss your work task and how you would approach the role. With your consent, we record it so that more of the team can review it.

  • Work trial and references. Up to three paid days working with us at our office in London. We also speak to two referees, after asking you.

If you need an adjustment at any stage, such as extra time, tell us and we will arrange it. If you have questions, email ----- £68,250 – £95,500

title: Global Sales Director, Energy & AI
descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you’ll fit in

You’ll lead sales leaders and teams across Liberalised and Regulated Flexibility, Field & Assets, and Agentic Customer Service. Each area has different buyers, sales cycles, regulatory environments, and product maturity. Your job is to give each team clear direction while making the right choices for Kraken as a whole.

You’ll partner with General Managers and colleagues across Product, Engineering, Delivery, Marketing, Partnerships, Legal, and Finance. Together, you’ll bring customers a joined-up experience and make sure what we sell is commercially sound and deliverable.

🚀 What you’ll own

  • Build a global go-to-market strategy with clear priorities for products, markets, customer segments, and routes to market.

  • Decide where we have the strongest opportunity to win, where to invest, and where to pause or stop.

  • Turn the strategy into practical plans for target accounts, pipeline, team capacity, partnerships, and performance.

  • Balance near-term revenue with the customer proof points and capabilities we need for lasting growth.

Lead and develop the team

  • Lead and coach sales leaders and their teams, setting clear expectations while giving them the space to make decisions.

  • Build a culture of ownership, trust, high standards, and mutual support. Help people raise risks early and learn from wins and losses.

  • Identify gaps in skills, capacity, succession, and hiring, and build the team needed to deliver the plan.

Own commercial performance

  • Be accountable for results across the portfolio, including revenue quality, margin, sales productivity, customer commitments, and the cost of growth.

  • Set clear commercial principles, pricing discipline, and approval boundaries so teams can negotiate confidently and protect Kraken’s value.

  • Look beyond headline contract value. Assess commitments, delivery and implementation effort, partner costs, product dependencies, and potential for expansion.

  • Lead or support strategic bids and complex negotiations when you can improve the outcome, while keeping the opportunity owner accountable.

  • Work with Legal and Finance on deal structures and risks, making decisions within your remit and escalating when needed.

Build a reliable sales operation

  • Establish a consistent rhythm for pipeline reviews, forecasting, deal inspection, account planning, and performance discussions.

  • Produce clear, evidence-based forecasts that distinguish pipeline from likely outcomes and committed business, including risks and revenue timing.

  • Challenge assumptions, spot slippage early, and agree practical next steps with the relevant leaders.

  • Use customer relationship management data to improve visibility and decisions, and connect pipeline plans to targets, capacity, and investment.

Bring teams together around customers

  • Bring customer demand, market insight, and competitive context into product and investment decisions.

  • Make sure sales commitments reflect what we can deliver. Where dependencies block an opportunity, make the impact clear and follow through on decisions and ownership.

  • Help teams make trade-offs between bespoke customer work and scalable products, and coordinate account ownership across the portfolio.

  • Build strong relationships across regions and time zones, communicate decisions clearly, and travel for customers, team development, and important commercial discussions.

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party

  • Significant senior sales leadership experience in the energy sector, ideally selling enterprise software or technology to utilities, energy retailers, networks, generators, asset owners, or related organizations.

  • A strong understanding of energy customers, their operating models and buying environments, and the problems technology can help them solve.

  • Experience leading and developing sales leaders or multidisciplinary sales teams across more than one product, market, or region.

  • A track record of setting a go-to-market strategy, making clear choices about where to focus, and turning it into a credible pipeline and contracted growth.

  • Strong commercial judgment, including enterprise pricing, negotiation, deal economics, contracting, margin, and long-term customer value.

  • Forecasting discipline: you can inspect a pipeline, explain what’s real, and act early when a deal or target is at risk.

  • Confidence with senior customer executives and complex deals, alongside a commitment to helping your team own its relationships.

  • Experience building supportive, accountable teams, coaching people, and addressing performance issues.

  • The ability to bring teams together across a matrix, resolve competing priorities, and make reasoned decisions when products and information are evolving.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to move between strategy and practical deal detail.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Experience selling agentic AI enterprise software or translating AI capabilities into credible customer value and responsible implementation plans.

  • Experience leading teams across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific, or working across multiple time zones and regulatory environments.

  • Knowledge of energy flexibility, distributed energy resources, demand response, virtual power plants, field service, or mobile workforce management.

  • Experience building partnerships and routes to market, including managing ownership across partner-led or multi-party opportunities.

title: Global Trainee Program - Outperformer Software Business Track (HILTI)
descriptionHtml:
4PS is part of the Hilti Group, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via Hilti Careerpage

Construction technology is being reinvented. Be part of it.

Construction is one of the world's largest industries, and one of its least digitized. That is changing fast. At Hilti, we are not only developing software products - we are building and growing digital businesses around them. Hilti is at the centre of that shift, with a growing portfolio of software products that connect jobsites, offices, teams, and tools across the entire construction lifecycle. We are looking for ambitious, internationally mobile early-career talents with a global mindset who are excited about technology but see their future in business and leadership rather than in a purely technical software career.

The Software & Digital Business Track of Hilti's Outperformer Program is a two-year accelerated development program that prepares you for a commercial, international leadership career in our software and digital businesses. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.

What You'll do

The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.

The program places you inside one of two business units:

Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). You will work directly with customers, product teams, and business leadership across Europe and beyond.

Fastening & Protection Solutions: Where design & engineering software for structural connections (e.g. PROFIS Engineering Suite), MEP supports and passive fire protection systems are developed and brought to market across a global customer base of structural and mechanical engineers.


For the Construction Software business unit, the program is structured to provide a balanced foundation in customer and market exposure, software product understanding, and business experience, while giving you the opportunity to work with at least two software products during the program:

  • ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month sales assignment, developing direct customer insight and understanding the business challenges addressed by our software solutions.
  • ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each across product and business teams, including exposure to an international project.

​For the Fastening & Protection Solution business unit, the program provides exposure to product management , software development, exposure to customers and start-ups and international project experience:

  • ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month product management assignment, building product understanding and market insight.
  • ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each, involving international projects that broaden your business perspective and global exposure.

You will have a dedicated senior mentor from the start, direct exposure to executive leadership, and a peer cohort of Global Trainees across all Hilti business tracks globally.

What You’ll Bring

You are close to graduating or have recently completed a Master's degree - your degree is likely to be in construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering with a focus on construction, Computer Science, or also Business study programs with an affinity for Software and construction. What matters more than your degree subject is the combination of traits below:

  • Global mobility - you are willing and able to relocate internationally, multiple times. A global thinker who is keen for diverse cultural experiences.
  • Digital and AI orientation - you think natively in digital workflows, comfortable with software tools, and know the power and potential of AI.
  • Language - you are fluent in English and/or German, Dutch, French, Spanish or Italian. 
  • Commercial instinct - you are drawn to how businesses grow, how customers make decisions, and how products create.
  • Low ego, high drive - you take the work seriously and yourself lightly. You seek feedback, move fast, and are energised by ambiguity rather than unsettled by it.
  • You are at the start of your career and have maximum three years of junior work experience.

What’s In It for You

​​Show us what you can do, and in return, we promise you the experience of a lifetime. We offer you a transformative journey filled with learning, growth, and invaluable experiences that will shape your perspective and personal and professional development. On top of that, you’ll also take part in some fascinating courses and events:

  • Introductory Global Summit: Experience 4 days at our global headquarters in Liechtenstein, featuring the presence of our Executive Board and Global Senior Leadership. The summit offers a comprehensive overview of our business, while fostering soft skill development and meaningful collaboration with fellow program participants.
  • Social Project Summit: 7 days dedicated to building a better future, with contribution to a hands-on, high-impact community project. This experience offers the chance to immerse yourself in a different culture while actively improving living conditions for those in need.
  • Leadership Summit: An enriching learning journey in partnership with a renowned business school, featuring online modules and collaborative projects with fellow program participants. The experience concludes with a 5-day on-campus summit to deepen insights and to foster business and leadership skills.

Why Hilti

Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

Learn more about our recruitment process: https://careers.hilti.group/en/candidate-interview-preparation/

Commitment to Inclusion

​​At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

​Exciting software journey: You will dive into the fast-paced world of our construction software business, gaining exposure to innovative digital solutions that are transforming one of the world's largest industries.
​
​Global cross-team collaboration: You will work with colleagues worldwide and get guidance from a dedicated mentor as you grow in your career.

​We hire for a career, not for a position. If you are looking for long-term career prospects and opportunities to grow, this is the perfect start.​

​Are you ready to jumpstart your career? Our hiring process is designed to help you showcase your skills and experience. The process has multiple steps and requires a longer period of time:

  • It all starts with your application and a video interview.
  • Get connected with our HR team in an online interview.
  • Get ready to flex your problem-solving muscles with our online Business Case Round.
  • Impress our Business Line Managers with your presentation skills and insights during the next round.
  • And, if you make it to the end, you'll receive an invitation to our Assessment Center.

​Exciting, right? Let's get started!

4PS is part of the Hilti Group, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via Hilti Careerpage

​The Assessment Center will take place in Liechtenstein at Hilti Headquarter on December 1st and 2nd, 2026. Applications will be reviewed in the order they’re received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible since there are limited spots for the Assessment Center!​

Learn more about our recruitment process:

Candidate Interview Preparation

title: Graduate AI Transformation Lead
descriptionHtml:
TLDR: We’re looking for top 1%, high agency, AI-forward graduates to join the first graduate cohort at Resonance as AI Transformation Leads. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital, to deploy AI into the economy and rebuild businesses for the AI era. You’ll work at the frontier and solve real problems in an environment that champions ownership, autonomy and innovation at pace.

Who we are

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. Our mission is to close the AI diffusion gap and rebuild businesses for the AI era. We're looking to hire Europe’s elite AI talent.

Why now

We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Foundation models are advancing far faster than organisations can absorb them; the bottleneck is embedding AI deeply into the core processes of a company to drive an inflection in pace and create organisational advantage. Europe is falling behind on AI, and we exist to help its businesses build real, defensible advantage from it rather than simply adopting it.

The role

As a Graduate AI Transformation Lead, you’ll work on client teams from your first month, alongside experienced AI Transformation Leads and AI engineers, with real responsibility from day one. You’ll analyse how a business works, where time and money go, and where AI fundamentally changes the economics. You’ll build the models, business cases and story a leadership team will act on, and prototype new workflows yourself with Claude Code or similar. You’ll work side by side with engineers to define what gets built, test it with the people who will use it, and help the client’s teams adopt it. As one of our first graduate cohort, you’ll also help shape our graduate programme and how Resonance trains and grows.

Your first year: Structured training in AI, consulting and the industries we work in, with coaching from Senior AI Transformation Leads and the founding team. You’ll be on a client team from your first month, in a small team where you know everyone by name. Nobody expects you to know it all when you start: asking for help early is part of the job. You’ll start as a Junior Transformation Lead and typically move up a level within 18–24 months.

What we’re looking for: You have extreme agency, operate with urgency, and have consistently been among the very top performers of your peers. You’re finishing an undergraduate or master’s degree in a technical subject, such as engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics or another natural science, or a quantitative subject such as economics, or you graduated in one in the last two years, with top results from a top university. You structure problems clearly and are comfortable with numbers. You use AI every day and have built something with it, whether a project, a tool or an automation, and you’re curious about how businesses actually work. You can show you make things happen through internships, a society you led, a company you started or something you built. An internship in consulting, banking, private equity or a startup is a plus. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway.

What we offer: Competitive total compensation plus equity. Real client work from your first month, learning from people who have shipped 30+ AI products and embedded AI into 50+ businesses. Every engagement ends with AI running in production and results you can measure. A team built to be one of the most talent-dense in Europe, and a chance to help close Europe’s AI gap, moving European businesses to the right side of the productivity chasm.

Logistics: London, 3+ days a week in the office or at client sites, mostly in the UK and Europe. English is our working language. We can sponsor visas for eligible candidates. Start date Summer 2027 (dates to be confirmed). We also offer Summer 2027 internships for students in the penultimate year of their degree.

Apply

Send your CV with your grades and a short note on something you've analysed or built with AI.

We hire people from every background and judge them on what they've built. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

Resonance is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. If you need adjustments at any stage, tell us and we'll make them.

title: GRC Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Remote from the UK, Germany, Austria, Poland, Montenegro or Serbia.

At Secfix, we’re at the forefront of automating security compliance in Europe. We help companies get and stay ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, and SOC 2 fast and easy and reduce hundreds of hours of manual work.

Secfix is run by a 100% remote team with hubs in Munich, Berlin and London. We’re a high-performing team looking for passionate, execution-focused, owners to help us automate security and compliance for modern companies and become the European compliance automation leader.

We’ve just raised our $12M Series A and are backed by top VCs, including Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital.

About the Role

We're hiring a GRC Specialist (Governance, Risk and Compliance) to strengthen our compliance function as Secfix scales into more frameworks, mid-market customers, and a growing compliance team.

This role sits at the intersection of compliance delivery, content, and team support. You'll own the compliance knowledge that lives inside our platform, run internal audits, support our customer success team, and act as the compliance voice for customers, auditors, and product.

You'll work closely with our co-founder & CISO and our CS Lead. This is a high-impact role with real influence on how Secfix delivers compliance: both as a service to customers and as content inside our app.

What You'll Do:

You will own one of the most important pillars of Secfix: the quality and breadth of our compliance offering. We don't (and can't afford to) micro-manage. We've built strong foundations and will give you full context on what works. You can test new approaches, but at the end of the day, you have full ownership of how you deliver results (with a strong support network from within and outside the company). You will:

  • Build and maintain compliance frameworks in the Secfix platform (ISO 27001, TISAX, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS 2, DORA, ISO 27017/27018, ISO 42001, C5, and more as we expand)

  • Own internal audits for our customers end to end, from kickoff through to the final report they take into their external audit

  • Keep several audits moving at once and keep every one on schedule

  • Implement ISO 27001 and adjacent frameworks end-to-end for customers

  • Own the quality of compliance content in the platform (including creating policies, automated checks, evidence templates, Compliance enable playbooks for our CSMs, security awareness trainings and more)

  • Close framework gaps and incorporate auditor feedback into both team practice and platform improvements

  • Partner with product and engineering to translate compliance gaps into structured product work

  • Collaborate closely with CS, Product, and Founders to align compliance, customer, and roadmap priorities

  • Deepen relationships with our existing certification partners and train auditors on the Secfix platform so they can confidently use it during customer audits

To be qualified for this role, you must have the following:

  • English (fluent) is a must for this role

  • 3+ years of hands‑on information security and GRC experience

  • Led at least 1 successful ISO 27001 certification projects as an implementer and/or auditor at a startup or mid-market company

  • You have run at least 2 internal audits before.

  • Hands on experience with a GRC platform like Secfix, or similar GRC platforms

  • Real depth in at least one framework beyond ISO 27001 (TISAX, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS2, or similar).

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to break down ambiguous initiatives into concrete deliverables, prioritizes ruthlessly, and ships

  • Excellent written communication, especially in producing clear, precise compliance content for diverse audiences (auditors, founders, engineers)

  • Strong ownership mindset: operates as an individual contributor without waiting for direction

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on technical experience.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience mentoring or coaching colleagues in a compliance, audit, or GRC context

  • Experience in a startup environment is a plus

  • A PECB ISO 27001 Lead Auditor certification or a direct equivalent

Interview Process:

  • Screening call with Talent team

  • Take-home Assessment

  • 1.5hr Assessment review and interview with our CS Lead and CEO

  • 45 min - Final Founder Interview with Co-Founders (CTO & CISO)

What we offer

  • Remote Work: 100% remote work with a virtual office in Gather.

  • Competitive Salary: Industry-competitive local salaries. We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this philosophy with GitLab.

  • Equity: Generous equity package – we’re all owners of Secfix and beneficiaries of our collective success.

  • Mentorship: We are backed by top VCs and accelerators and have direct access to world-class mentors.

  • Development Budget: €1,000 annual personal development budget.

  • Home office Budget: Home office budget and access to co-working spaces.

  • Holidays: 26 days holiday + local public holidays.

  • Health Insurance: Comprehensive health coverage.

  • Annual Retreat: Annual retreat to build connections and inspire ideas (this year we’re headed to Milan!).

  • Company Events: Company-wide events to build relationships and have some fun!

  • Tech Equipment: Latest tech equipment (MacBook, monitors, headphones).
