title: Group Financial Accountant
descriptionHtml:
About CircuitHub

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

Remote within the UK, or from our offices in London or Cambridge if you prefer.

The opportunity

CircuitHub is trying to solve a difficult problem: why can software engineers iterate almost instantly while hardware engineers can still wait weeks or months to manufacture a new design?

The company was founded by engineers who had experienced that frustration first-hand. What began as software to make ordering electronics easier has evolved into a much more ambitious manufacturing platform, combining software, robotics and automation to redesign the production process itself.

Today CircuitHub operates an automated electronics manufacturing platform serving hardware businesses across areas including robotics, autonomous systems and other advanced technology applications. Its proprietary Grid system is a factory-scale robotic assembly platform designed for rapid, high-mix electronics production.

The business is now scaling quickly. CircuitHub has raised $45 million to expand manufacturing capacity in both the US and Europe, building on operations in Massachusetts and its growing UK presence. Cambridge is becoming an increasingly important hub alongside London and the company's distributed team.

That growth creates a corresponding need to strengthen the operating infrastructure behind the company. Finance is one of the areas where CircuitHub has deliberately remained lean for longer than it probably should have.

Context: where finance is today

The finance team is led by a Finance Director and Management Accountant, both experienced, qualified accountants. This role brings dedicated financial accounting and technical reporting capability into the team, taking ownership of the books, the audit and the technical questions that come with a growing international group.

CircuitHub uses NetSuite to operate its inter-company financial model across the UK and US. A significant amount of day-to-day UK finance activity is outsourced, while the internal team takes greater ownership of the larger US operation, group reporting and consolidation. This role will be the main point of contact for the outsourced firm, reviewing their work and making sure it meets the standard the group needs, while also working across the US side and the wider mechanics of an international business.

Just as importantly, CircuitHub is thinking carefully about what the next generation of finance roles should look like. AI and automation are already being deployed across the company, including in areas where repetitive finance work can be made considerably more efficient.

That makes strong technical accountants even more important. CircuitHub needs people who understand the numbers well enough to judge whether automated output is right, and who can use technology to improve how finance works without weakening control.

That combination of technical accounting, real ownership and a technology-enabled way of working is a central part of the opportunity.

The mandate

The Group Financial Accountant will take ownership of CircuitHub’s financial accounting across the UK and US. That means understanding how the books are put together, running a reliable close and being the person the Finance Director, the auditors and the outsourced accounting firm rely on for accurate, well-supported numbers.

Alongside the core accounts, the role will lead on technical accounting as the business scales. CircuitHub is investing heavily in manufacturing capacity and moving towards more flexible commercial models, which raises questions around revenue recognition, capitalisation and intercompany that need a clear owner.

The candidate must be willing to get their hands dirty to get a full appreciation of the sales cycle & work with the Finance Director to improve our systems and controls to improve our collection cycle, reducing DSO & further automation for our credit offering.

The candidate should have a good technical understanding in accounting that can lead to developing financial operations without complicating or delaying the reporting process. Developing our systems to improve the speed and efficiency of areas such as revenue recognition, R&D capitalisation & the consolidation process.

What you will work on

The precise balance will evolve with the candidate, but the remit is expected to include:

  • Financial accounting and close. Own month-end, including journals, accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations, with a clear understanding of how the accounts fit together.

  • Audit and statutory reporting. Act as the first point of contact for the auditors, manage their requests and prepare supporting schedules under UK GAAP and IFRS.

  • Technical accounting. Lead projects such as IFRS 15 revenue recognition, the capitalisation policy and the treatment of intercompany transactions as the business and its commercial models develop.

  • Group reporting. Support reporting across the UK and US entities, including intercompany reconciliations, and contribute to group consolidation in NetSuite where experience allows.

  • Outsourced provider management. Manage the relationship with the UK outsourced accounting firm, reviewing their output and holding it to the standard the group needs.

  • NetSuite and finance systems. Work directly in NetSuite and across the different systems and platforms that feed into it. Understand how data moves through the business rather than treating the accounting system in isolation.

  • AI and automation. Review and take ownership of automated and AI-generated finance output, making sure it is accurate and properly controlled, and help identify where further automation makes sense.

What success looks like

The first objective is to be a safe pair of hands. That means solving outstanding technical issues, taking ownership of monthly & quarterly close, a well-run audit and numbers the Finance Director and the team can trust without needing to revisit them.

From there, success means taking ownership of the technical agenda: a clear approach to revenue recognition as commercial models change, a robust capitalisation policy as CircuitHub invests in capacity, and clean intercompany accounting across the UK and US.

Over time, the finance team should have the capacity to report more frequently, stronger oversight of outsourced work and less technical accounting sitting with the Finance Director simply because nobody else can own it.

Processes should improve as well as move faster. Automation should remove low-value work without weakening financial control.

This is a role to build into over time. The scope will grow with the finance function and with the contribution the individual makes to it. As the business scales, the role is expected to grow into Group Financial Controller.

The person we are looking for

CircuitHub is looking for a qualified or near-qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA) with strong technical foundations. The specific qualification matters less than acumen, drive and personal qualities.

You are likely to have trained in practice, whether at a Big 4 or a top 20 firm, and be looking for your first move into an operating business. Alternatively, you may already be working in industry, in which case you will be qualified or close to qualifying.

The strongest signals are:

  • Relevant exposure. Experience getting the most out of NetSuite, working in a finance team to produce accounting information & ability to work autonomously and conscientiously to meet deadlines.

  • Technical grounding. Strong knowledge of UK GAAP and IFRS and a clear understanding of how a set of accounts is put together.

  • Technology fluency. You are comfortable working across systems and genuinely interested in how AI is changing finance. You see automation as a tool, not a substitute for judgement.

  • Practical curiosity. When something does not reconcile or a process feels unnecessarily difficult, your instinct is to understand why.

  • Commitment to building. You are motivated by breadth and ownership, and you want to build something over time in a growing business.

  • Interest in the business. CircuitHub sits at the intersection of software, robotics and physical manufacturing. You do not need an electronics background, but an interest in technology and how real products are built will make the environment much more compelling.

Why CircuitHub

This is a chance to join a profitable, fast-growing robotics and manufacturing business at a pivotal stage of scale, in a role with genuine technical ownership.

You will work closely with experienced qualified accountants and gain a breadth of exposure that is rare this early in an industry career: revenue recognition, capitalisation, intercompany, audit and reporting across a UK and US group.

You will also build for where finance is going next. CircuitHub is already using AI, automation and connected systems across the business, creating the opportunity to combine strong technical accounting with skills in systems, data and automation.

For someone with the capability and drive, there is real scope to grow as CircuitHub scales and the finance function builds out around it.

Pay

£75k–£85k, depending on experience, plus equity.

title: Group Financial Controller
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

About the role

We're looking for a Group Financial Controller to own the controllership function across the Lendable group. This is the team responsible for the integrity of our books: the monthly close, the reconciliation control framework, accounts payable and payroll, across multiple entities and multiple GAAP frameworks.

There's a lot to do. We are a high-transaction-volume lending business scaling across the UK, the US and Mexico; and the finance operation needs to scale with it. This role is about process, automation and control rather than technical accounting research: tightening the close timetable, designing controls that actually hold, and building an operation that gets faster and more accurate as volume grows rather than slower and more manual.

What you'll be doing/impact on objectives

  • Own the group month-end close end to end, including the close timetable and the discipline that keeps it on track across all entities

  • Maintain books and ledgers across multiple GAAP frameworks (IFRS, UK GAAP, US GAAP) for a multi-entity group

  • Own the reconciliation control framework: design, integrity and evidencing of reconciliations across the balance sheet

  • Lead accounts payable and payroll at volume, holding the standard on accuracy, timeliness and control

  • Design and embed financial controls across the finance operation, working with the Internal Control Manager on control narratives, RACMs and audit readiness

  • Drive automation and efficiency: identify where manual effort scales badly and replace it with systemised, repeatable process

  • Build, lead and develop the controllership team, setting the standard for how the function operates

  • Partner with Technical Accounting, Tax, Treasury and FP&A, and act as a key point of contact for external auditors

What we're looking for

  • Qualified accountant (ACA/ACCA/CIMA) with a minimum of 10 years PQE

  • At least 3 years in a controllership leadership role

  • Proven experience maintaining books and ledgers across multiple GAAP frameworks (IFRS, UK GAAP, US GAAP). You do not need to be a technical accounting expert in each

  • Track record owning management accounts close, reconciliation control frameworks, AP and payroll at volume in a regulated or high-transaction lending business

  • Demonstrable focus on process, automation, control design and close timetable discipline, with evidence of driving efficiency at scale

  • Comfortable operating in a multi-entity, multi-currency group structure

  • Nice to have: ECL/IFRS 9 or CECL exposure

Interview process

  • Remote Hiring Manager Interview 30 minutes

  • Onsite interviews with the Finance Leadership team: 90 minutes

  • Remote Final Stage interview with the CFO /CCO: 30 minutes

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

title: Growth Engineer (Intern)
descriptionHtml:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers.

Emidat aims to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

Embodied carbon is emitted on day zero and can never be reduced later, while global floor area is set to double by 2060. From January 2026, EU regulation (CPR) requires verified environmental data. 430,000 manufacturers will need it, and only about 2,500 have it today. That gap is our market.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Drive initiatives that grow Emidat. In Growth we prioritise by one question: does this bring in new customers? As a Growth Engineer Intern you work across our four growth functions that sits closest to that answer; 1. Growth Engineering, 2. Growth Marketing, 3. Sales Development and 4. Partnerships

Topics you might work on: our automated campaign planning and lead development process, and the automations behind it. Our mapping of the total addressable market (TAM) and the GTM analysis sheet we use to decide which segments and countries to go after. Our industry get-togethers, for example expert exchanges and C-level breakfasts, from the invite list to the follow-up. LinkedIn posts and customer case studies, which means talking to manufacturers who use Emidat and turning what they tell you into material our sales team can send.

This internship is ideal for someone who has future aspirations to ‘found’ a company. Building a revenue function is one of the most difficult parts of founding, and during your internship, you’ll get insights into how demand is created, how a pipeline is built, and how AI actually optimises a go-to-market team. You will work on initiatives with the leads of each growth function, including our Head of Growth. We expect you to work independently, form your own view on what to prioritise, and challenge us when you think we have it wrong.

  • Map our Market: Extend our TAM mapping into every new geography we enter, and keep our view of the relevant manufacturers, associations and registries current - so the commercial team always plans against a reliable picture of who is worth targeting.

  • Turn Data into Decisions: Build and maintain the reporting our team steers by, from campaign performance to pipeline health. Translate data into clear, actionable insights and own the data quality that makes those numbers trustworthy.

  • Organise our industry get-togethers: Organise formats like the BAU Dinner, our C-level AI Breakfasts and the Climate Native Summit end-to-end - guest list, invitations, on-site logistics and follow-up - turning each one into a reliable source of senior conversations.

What you will bring to this role

Minimum Requirements

  • Language: Fluent (C2/Native) in German and business fluent (C1+) in English.

  • Data-Driven System Integration: Proven ability to interpret complex performance data, generating actionable insights that directly inform strategy. You must be able to effectively bridge data analysis with our internal tech stack to drive business outcomes.

descriptionHtml:

Founded in 2025, Taxforce rethinks tax advisory from the ground up: AI-powered and highly automated, yet personal. We're starting with healthcare professionals, a complex and underserved segment, and we grow both organically and through M&A.

This is a €40B market in Germany alone, with processes that have barely changed in decades. AI now enables a fundamental shift, and there are no playbooks yet. We're writing them. We're a small, highly ambitious team in Berlin, backed by €5M from Tenet VC and founded by alumni of Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company, Y Combinator and the former Klarna Head of Engineering.

The role

You help doctors’ and dentists’ practices find their way to Taxforce and make sure their start with us feels effortless. You work directly with our founders, run our pipeline from first contact to signed mandate, and own the onboarding of new practices until they are fully part of our tax processes.

Tasks

  • Growth engineering. Run our lead pipeline and automate it with AI and our CRM, so every recurring step only has to be built once.

Requirements

  • Structured & reliable. You keep many onboardings on track at once and nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Analytical mindset. You read a funnel, spot where it leaks and know what to test next.

  • AI-native. You use AI tools every day and build small automations yourself. CRM experience is a plus.

  • Steep learning curve. Work on real problems, ship quickly and build skills that prepare you to start your own company.

The details

Full-time internship for 3 to 6 months, start any time of the year, on-site in our Berlin office five days a week.

How to apply

Send us your CV and a few lines on why this role fits you. Our process has three steps: a 30-minute intro call, a short live case from our day-to-day work, and a conversation with the founders.

title: GTM Associate
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity.

Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance.

We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth.

Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures.

 

Position Overview

As a GTM Associate, you’ll sit at the centre of Condukt’s commercial engine, generating new pipeline across financial services and working hand in hand with our Account Executives to turn it into revenue.

You’ll build opportunities from the ground up: reaching high-growth fintechs and financial institutions with well-researched outreach, qualifying inbound interest quickly, and running first discovery conversations. Your work doesn’t end at the first meeting. You’ll stay on the deal with our Account Executives, help build the customer relationship and, as you grow, lead smaller deals end to end alongside an AE.

As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move with urgency, and are excited to help build both a market-leading product and a repeatable enterprise sales motion. You’ll work closely with our AI Deployment Strategists, Product, Engineering, and Leadership to shape how we sell, who we sell to, and how we win.

If you’re at the start of your commercial career, energised by meeting new people, and keen to take on more responsibility fast, this role is for you.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Own early-stage pipeline creation with fintechs and financial institutions that match our ideal customer profile

  • Research and map target accounts, identifying the right C-level Risk & Compliance, Operations, and Product leaders to engage

  • Help build and run our outbound motion, with sharp, well-researched messaging across email, LinkedIn, phone and events. Test creative formats beyond the usual sequences, and turn what works into a repeatable playbook

  • Respond fast to inbound interest and qualify every lead on fit, urgency and decision-makers

  • Lead discovery calls, support AEs on live deals and, as you grow, lead smaller deals end to end

  • Bring what you hear from the market back to Product and Leadership, helping shape who we sell to and spot new market opportunities

  • Pick up whatever the business needs next: priorities will shift as we scale, and you’ll help shape where we go

What you bring:

  • 1-3 years in a client-facing or target-carrying role, with a proven record of booking net-new meetings

  • Genuine energy for meeting people, and the confidence to pick up the phone, walk into a room of strangers and start the conversation

  • Resilience in the face of rejection, and the drive to keep going for the wins

  • Ability to learn fast, handle ambiguity and change course when priorities shift

  • Hands-on attitude, with a focus on outcomes rather than titles

  • Intellectual curiosity about the compliance space

  • Fluency with AI and data tools to work faster and smarter

  • Strong organisation across follow-ups, sequences and your CRM

  • Low-ego, collaborative approach and openness to feedback

  • Genuine interest in fintech and how financial institutions onboard customers and manage risk

  • Excellent written and spoken English

  • The right to work in the UK

Bonus:

  • Sales experience preferred, but not required for the role

  • Background in fintech, banking, payments, or lending ecosystems

  • Second language proficiency (German, French, and Dutch, especially valued)

 

Our offer:

title: Head of Account Management (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

Client Impact at Upvest owns our clients' journey from signature to go-live and beyond, spanning Launch, Migrations, Account Management, Client Experience and Integration Success. Once a client is live, Account Management takes over: we own the relationship end to end, grow it commercially, run it strategically and make sure our clients see Upvest as a partner, not a vendor. Client satisfaction is one of the things that sets us apart from incumbents, and recommendations from our live clients have already been key to new wins.

We are looking for a Head of Account Management to lead this team and Upvest's live client portfolio, which includes some of Europe's best-known fintechs, neobrokers and banks. You will own the commercial development of the portfolio (renewals, upsell, ARR and revenue retention) and the senior relationships behind it, lead a team of senior Account Managers, and build the operating model that lets us scale. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will sit across the table from client C-levels yourself, not only manage the people who do.

You will report directly to Jens Maluck, VP Client Impact, and work closely with Growth, Product, Launch, Client Experience and Finance.

What you’ll do:

  • Commercial growth

    • Own the commercial development of the live client portfolio: renewals, expansions and upsells, against budget and upsell targets

    • Spot commercial opportunities and leveraging knowledge across the portfolio

    • Lead commercial negotiations for live clients, including pricing

    • Build strategic account plans that set out each client's growth path with Upvest, from new use cases and asset classes to new functionality and geographies

    • Advise clients on their end-user investment offering (product, pricing, promotions, conversion), because the better our clients perform, the better Upvest performs

    • Provide case studies and references that help win new business

  • Client ownership

    • Be the senior counterpart for client leadership teams, from handover after go-live through renewals and escalations

    • Lead QBRs, Steering Committees and executive alignment, keeping stakeholders aligned from C-level to technical teams

    • Act as the filter between our clients and the wider Upvest organisation: answer most product, asset class and commercial questions directly, run client meetings independently with your team, and bring in others only where they add real value

    • Be the first point of escalation for live clients, resolving issues quickly and coordinating the wider organisation where needed

    • Represent the voice of the client inside Upvest, channelling structured feedback to Product, Operations and Growth

    • Safeguard the partnership by ensuring contract adherence on both sides

  • Performance and insight

    • Own the portfolio KPIs: ARR, net and gross revenue retention, and client satisfaction (CSAT and Account Health Score)

    • Track client performance (users, conversions, assets under custody, trading activity) against plan, and use anonymised benchmarks to help clients improve

    • Own the client input to the annual budget and the monthly actuals vs budget review with Finance

    • Report to senior management on account health, risks and opportunities, with clear actionable recommendations

  • Team and operating model

    • Lead, hire and develop a team of senior Account Managers, setting a high bar for quality, execution speed and commercial impact

    • Define and continuously improve how Upvest manages its live clients: account tiering, governance cadences, account health scoring, documentation and tooling

    • Drive AI adoption across Account Management, using Claude and system integrations to automate analysis, reporting and preparation work

    • Work very closely with Client Experience who own the day to day operational alignment and ticket resolution

What you bring:

  • Experience: 8+ years in account management, client success or strategic relationship management for B2B enterprise clients, of which 3+ years leading an account management or client team

  • Investment and brokerage expertise: You can discuss asset types in depth (equities, ETFs, funds and MMFs, bonds, securitised derivatives, crypto) and the trading, custody, settlement and fee economics behind them. Ideally, you gained this in B2B investment infrastructure or B2C brokerage (e.g. a neobroker or the investment offering of a digital bank)

  • Commercial track record: You have owned renewals, upsells and negotiations end to end, ideally against NRR / GRR targets or a commission plan, and you can name the deals you generated

  • Relevant background: Regulated fintech or banking with financial institutions as clients, or B2B API, embedded finance or enterprise SaaS

  • Product mindset: You are eager to understand the product in depth and E2E, and have a drive to represent it to the client without the Product team present. You understand the value of standardisation and automation over customisation

  • People leadership: You have led a team of senior individual contributors, and you can show both a strong team culture and raising the bar (coaching, performance management, stepping in when output falls short)

  • Operating model builder: You have built playbooks, improved processes and implemented systems that let a team scale

  • Data-driven: You run accounts on KPIs (client performance, forecast vs actuals, adoption etc.)

  • AI-enabled: You use AI hands-on every day (ideally Claude), are comfortable connecting it to business systems via MCP or similar, and can walk us through workflows you automated

  • Executive presence: You are a trusted counterpart for C-level stakeholders and lead QBRs, SteerCos and difficult commercial conversations without senior back-up

  • Ownership: You are the go-to person for your area: you communicate proactively, flag risks early and take a clear position. You are hands-on and not looking for a pure manage-the-managers role

It’s great if you have:

  • B2C brokerage experience, to guide clients on product design, pricing, promotions, conversion and activity

  • Experience with country expansion (local market specifics, tax and regulatory set-up, market launch)

  • A network and market insight in Upvest's core European markets (e.g. Germany, Netherlands, Spain, UK, France)

  • Experience with migrations or large client transitions

  • German and/or Spanish language skills

  • Location preference: Berlin-based preferred. Alternatively London-based or remote, willingness to travel to Berlin every couple of weeks

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Head of Alliances - Manager (F/H)
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

Nous recrutons, pour renforcer nos équipes Sales, un.e Head of Alliances.

Missions

En tant que Head of Alliances, vous pilotez le go-to-market de WPP Enterprise Solutions avec nos partenaires technologiques stratégiques (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify) et les innovateurs de l’IA. Point de convergence entre nos partenaires, nos équipes commerciales et nos Business Units, vous transformez la force de l’écosystème en pipeline, en différenciation et en croissance. Comme l’ensemble de l’équipe de Business Développement, vous reposez sur un profil hybride dont les 2 piliers sont d’être :

  • Responsable du go-to-market conjoint avec nos partenaires technologiques stratégiques : co-construction des offres, des plans d’affaires et de la démarche de co-selling autour de nos capabilities auprès de clients et prospects,
  • Orchestrateur de l’écosystème en interne : enablement des équipes, montée en compétence et certifications sur les plateformes partenaires, pour activer la bonne expertise au sein de WPP Enterprise Solutions et du réseau WPP

Cette hybridation est la clé du succès : être à la fois moteur du business généré via l’écosystème partenaires et garant de la capacité des équipes à délivrer avec ces technologies.

Dimension Business :

  • Définit et déploie la stratégie de go-to-market et de marketing partenaires de WPP Enterprise Solutions avec ses partenaires technologiques stratégiques, afin de maximiser la valeur, la différenciation et le pipeline générés par l’écosystème,
  • Construit et anime les plans d’affaires conjoints (joint business plans) avec chaque partenaire clé (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify…), en pilotant objectifs, jalons et indicateurs de performance partagés,
  • Orchestre le co-selling et le co-marketing : aligne partenaires, équipes commerciales et Business Units pour transformer les opportunités de l’écosystème en deals, du sourcing à la conversion,
  • Conçoit et orchestre le plan d’événements dédiés ou co-construits avec les partenaires (webinaires, ateliers, salons, temps forts commerciaux), afin de générer visibilité, demande et pipeline,
  • Met en œuvre, en continu, l’excellence de la démarche partenaires via les processus et outils internes ainsi que les portails partenaires, à des fins de visibilité, de pilotage et d’animation globale en interne,
  • Sécurise et défend les intérêts économique et contractuel de WPP Enterprise Solutions dans le cadre des accords de partenariat (referral, reselling, MDF, niveaux de partenariat),
  • Pilote le niveau de préférence et de mindshare de nos partenaires à notre égard : positionne WPP Enterprise Solutions comme partenaire de référence dans leur écosystème, fait progresser notre niveau de partenariat et suit la performance des objectifs conjoints,
  • Contribue au thought leadership de WPP Enterprise Solutions sur les enjeux d’écosystème et de plateformes (IA, data, commerce, CX), via des prises de parole conjointes valorisant nos réussites dans une logique de ROI business,
  • Construit et fait vivre un patrimoine de connaissances sur l’écosystème technologique (roadmaps produits, niveaux et programmes de partenariat, dispositifs de financement) afin d’accélérer et de fluidifier l’action commerciale,
  • Incarne, diffuse et fait vivre l’excellence du modèle partenaires en interne, en particulier auprès des communautés commerciale et managériale, pour l’inspirer et développer son réflexe écosystème.

Dimension Enablement & Delivery :

  • Travaille de concert avec le CTO, à qui revient la responsabilité de l’enablement, des certifications et de la montée en compétences des équipes sur les plateformes partenaires ; il s’assure que ces chantiers progressent au rythme des priorités business et des engagements pris auprès des partenaires,
  • Veille à la disponibilité et à la capitalisation des assets conjoints (cas clients, références, supports de co-vente) et au partage des retours d’expérience.

Profil recherché

Vous justifiez de 5 à 10 ans d’expérience, dont une expérience significative en alliances / partenariats technologiques, channel ou business development – idéalement acquise en cabinet de conseil, ESN, agence ou chez un éditeur / hyperscaler.

Notre croissance reposant sur un écosystème de partenaires technologiques (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify…), vous maîtrisez les mécaniques de co-selling, de co-marketing et de joint business planning.

Vous pouvez justifier de contributions ou de succès significatifs dans le cadre d’initiatives partenaires ou de développement business, au-delà d’en comprendre la logique ou les bonnes pratiques.

Votre capacité à nouer des relations de grande qualité, tant avec les équipes partenaires (alliance managers, channel, avant-vente) qu’avec les décideurs internes (Directions commerciales, Business Units, Marketing), fait de vous un orchestrateur d’écosystème performant, du sourcing d’opportunités à la conclusion de deals conjoints équilibrant les intérêts du partenaire, du client et de WPP Enterprise Solutions.

Les enjeux des plateformes technologiques et de l’écosystème IA / data / commerce vous passionnent, et vous savez vous appuyer sur vos expériences pour bâtir un discours solide en interne comme auprès des partenaires.

Votre rigueur et votre curiosité font de vous un acteur à la fois à l’aise dans la logique de développement business sur des clients existants que sur de la conquête opportuniste, ou en relai d’un partenaire.

La maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, est indispensable : vous adressez des partenaires et des interlocuteurs internationaux de manière totalement autonome.

Intégrer WPP Enterprise Solutions, c’est choisir d’évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, humain et innovant, propice au développement de chacun, à la réalisation de missions enrichissantes et aux évolutions de carrière. title: Head of Compliance
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Head of Operations
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is that we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region, including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

The Head of Operations Lead – UK owns the operational backbone of BJAK's UK business. You'll make sure daily operations, internal systems, and customer-facing execution run smoothly, efficiently, and at a standard that supports scale.

This is not a P&L role, and it's not a "manage from a distance" role either. You'll partner closely with the CEO to turn business objectives into strong execution on the ground, building systems, leading teams, and stepping in directly when execution breaks.

 

What You'll Own

  • Define and execute operational strategies that support growth and align with BJAK's objectives in the UK market.

  • Run day-to-day operations across customer service, administrative operations, and internal workflows so execution stays frictionless.

  • Hire, lead, and develop a high-performing operations and admin team with a strong culture of ownership and accountability.

  • Own process improvement, finding bottlenecks, automating where possible, and implementing systems that cut cost and increase speed.

  • Lead the customer support function and step in hands-on during high-stakes or escalated cases.

  • Oversee company administration and internal operations, including office management, documentation, vendor coordination, and adherence to internal policies.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong background in operations, execution, or internal business operations in tech, fintech, or fast-scaling environments.

  • Proven experience leading operations and admin teams in high-expectation environments.

  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to solve problems directly, not just delegate them.

  • Strong organisational, execution, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing structure to fast-moving situations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally and drive execution without formal authority.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who want to direct operations from a distance instead of stepping in when things break.

  • Candidates who need fully-built systems and processes handed to them.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid escalations, messy cases, or hard conversations with vendors and staff.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

  • This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1-2 weeks from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Head of Regulatory Affairs, Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

Checkout.com holds licences in many countries, and the way we work with our supervisors matters more every year. We are creating a new Regulatory Affairs function to lead that work, and we are looking for the person to build it.

As Head of Regulatory Affairs, you will manage our supervisory relationships day to day and run the formal work that comes with them: information requests, thematic reviews, inspections and examinations. You will also shape how the new function works and where it grows, working closely with the Director of External Affairs.You will bring together the right people across Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Product and Tech, and make sure everything we send is accurate, consistent and on time.

You will start hands-on, building the foundations yourself, leveraging advanced AI tools, then build a team of regulatory affairs specialists across our major markets over time.

What you'll do

Build the function

  • Shape our approach to supervisory engagement across our regulated entities.

  • Design how Regulatory Affairs works day to day, including how it works with Compliance, Legal, Risk and the business.

  • Help plan where the team grows, including which countries need local specialists and in what order.

  • Build a clear view of supervisory risk across the group and use it to set priorities.

  • Advise executives on what our supervisors expect and how upcoming supervisory activity will affect the business.

Manage our supervisory relationships

  • Run the regular cycle of supervisory meetings: preparation, briefing senior colleagues, attending and following up.

  • Keep a clear record of what we have told each regulator and what we have committed to.

  • Own the protocol for how we engage with supervisors, so colleagues know who speaks to whom and when.

  • Spot emerging issues early and raise them with senior leadership.

Run regulatory requests

  • Own regulator information requests and thematic reviews from receipt to submission: scope, owners, deadlines, evidence, version control and quality checks.

  • Act as a single front door for the business, so teams get one clear request instead of several.

  • Challenge draft responses for gaps and inconsistencies before they go out.

Lead inspections and examinations

  • Run inspections, examinations and skilled-person reviews as programmes, from the opening notice to the closing meeting.

  • Set the plan and the narrative, coordinate evidence, and prepare and rehearse subject-matter experts and senior leaders.

  • Run a lessons-learned review after each engagement and improve the process for next time.

Build the team and the infrastructure

  • Hire, develop and lead a team of regulatory affairs specialists across our major markets.

  • Build the playbooks, templates, trackers and governance the function will run on.

  • Build a library of past submissions so we can reuse good work.

  • Set up regular reporting to senior leadership and entity boards on open requests, inspections and commitments.

What we are looking for

  • A builder. You have set up a function, team or process from scratch, and you enjoy turning an open brief into something that works.

  • Significant experience as a regulatory affairs manager / lead at a regulated payments, e-money or fintech firm.

  • Hands-on experience running regulatory information requests and inspections end to end, ideally across more than one country.

  • Time in a supervisory team at a major financial regulator, such as the FCA, ACPR, MAS or CBUAE, is a strong advantage.

  • Strategic judgement. You can set a clear direction, explain it to executives and turn it into a plan.

  • Excellent project management. You can run several deadlines with many contributors at once and keep every one of them on track.

  • A track record of keeping calm under pressure.

  • Sound judgement on when to bring in Legal or Compliance.

  • Credibility with regulators and the trust of senior executives.

  • Impeccable written communication.

  • People management experience, or clear readiness to build and lead a team

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: HR Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Agieren Sie als vertrauenswürdiger HR Business Partner und beraten Führungskräfte strategisch sowie operativ in allen personalrelevanten Fragestellungen.

  • Unterstützen und begleiten Sie Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte während des gesamten Employee Lifecycles und fördern Sie eine positive Employee Experience sowie ein hohes Engagement.

  • Steuern und koordinieren Sie HR-Initiativen in den Bereichen Talententwicklung, Performance Management und Mitarbeiterbindung.

  • Gestalten und begleiten Sie den Performance-Management-Prozess, einschließlich Zielvereinbarungen, Leistungsbeurteilungen und individueller Entwicklungspläne.

  • Analysieren Sie HR-Kennzahlen und Personaldaten, identifizieren Sie Trends und leiten Sie geeignete Maßnahmen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung ab.

  • Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Talent Acquisition Team und den Führungskräften zusammen, um eine hochwertige Recruiting- und Onboarding-Erfahrung sicherzustellen.

  • Stellen Sie die Einhaltung arbeitsrechtlicher Vorgaben, interner Richtlinien und HR-Standards sicher und beraten Sie Führungskräfte zu Best Practices.

  • Unterstützen Sie organisatorische Veränderungsprozesse, die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Betriebsrat sowie komplexe arbeitsrechtliche und mitarbeiterbezogene Themen, um den nachhaltigen Unternehmenserfolg zu fördern.

Qualifikationen

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Human Resources, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder in einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet.

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer generalistischen HR-/People-Funktion innerhalb eines größeren, international ausgerichteten Unternehmens.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht, in HR-Richtlinien sowie in modernen Personalmanagement-Praktiken.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Wort und Schrift.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen sowie Erfahrung im Arbeiten mit HR-Systemen und digitalen Tools.

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit im Stakeholder-Management sowie im Aufbau und der Pflege vertrauensvoller Beziehungen auf allen Unternehmensebenen.

  • Analytische Denkweise und Erfahrung in der Nutzung von HR-Kennzahlen, Datenanalysen und Insights zur Unterstützung fundierter Entscheidungen.

  • Hohe Organisationsfähigkeit sowie eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu managen, Fristen einzuhalten und sowohl eigenverantwortlich als auch im Team erfolgreich zu arbeiten.

Über DP World


Handel ist das Lebensblut der Weltwirtschaft, er schafft Chancen und verbessert die Lebensqualität der Menschen auf der ganzen Welt. DP World existiert, um den weltweiten Handelsfluss zu verbessern und die Möglichkeiten für die Kunden und Gemeinschaften, die wir weltweit bedienen, zu verändern.


Mit einem engagierten, vielfältigen und professionellen Team von mehr als 115.000 Mitarbeitern aus 159 Nationalitäten in 77 Ländern auf sechs Kontinenten treibt DP World den Handel weiter und schneller voran, hin zu einer nahtlosen Lieferkette, die für die Zukunft gerüstet ist.


Wir transformieren und integrieren unsere Geschäftsbereiche – Häfen und Terminals, Seeverkehrsdienste, Logistik und Technologie – schnell und vereinen unsere globale Infrastruktur mit lokaler Expertise, um stärkere, effizientere End-to-End-Lieferkettenlösungen zu schaffen, die den weltweiten Handel verändern können.


Darüber hinaus gestalten wir die Zukunft neu, indem wir in Innovationen investieren. Von intelligenten Liefersystemen bis hin zur automatisierten Lagerbeladung sind wir auf dem neuesten Stand der disruptiven Technologie und treiben den Sektor zu besseren Handelsmethoden an, um Störungen von der Fabrikhalle bis zur Haustür des Kunden zu minimieren.


DP World hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, Grenzen zu überschreiten und die Kluft zwischen allen Nationen und Kulturen zu überbrücken – nicht nur in dem, was wir tun, sondern auch in unserem Verhalten.


Wir sind bestrebt, eine Kultur zu schaffen, in der sich jeder respektiert, unterstützt und befähigt fühlt, sein volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen. Wir glauben, dass die Akzeptanz von Inklusion und Vielfalt Innovation und Wachstum vorantreibt und uns hilft, Menschen, Unternehmen und Gesellschaften zu verbinden. Freie Geister und unterschiedliche Perspektiven verändern unsere Welt, und gemeinsam können wir verändern, was möglich ist.


Die DP World-Familie besteht aus Syncreon, Imperial und P&O.

WE MAKE TRADE FLOW
TO CHANGE WHAT'S POSSIBLE FOR EVERYONE.

title: HR Teamlead
descriptionHtml:
Voor Interconnect, een toonaangevende Nederlandse aanbieder van data- en clouddiensten, is Staffplanning op zoek naar een ervaren en ondernemende HR Teamlead. Een mooie kans voor een HR-professional die graag een team aanstuurt, het management adviseert en HR-processen verder professionaliseert.

De functieAls HR Teamlead geef je leiding aan het HR-team van Interconnect, bestaande uit een HR Business Partner en twee HR-medewerkers. Het team maakt onderdeel uit van de afdeling Business Support.Samen zorgen jullie voor goed functionerende HR-processen op het gebied van instroom, doorstroom, uitstroom, verzuimmanagement, personeelsplanning en performance management.Je bent een belangrijke sparringpartner voor directie en management en vertaalt strategische HR-doelstellingen naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met de HR Business Partner, die zich voornamelijk richt op de teamleiders binnen de organisatie.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Aansturen, begeleiden en coachen van het HR-team.

  • Adviseren van directie en management over tactische en operationele HR-vraagstukken.

  • Bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling en uitvoering van de HR-strategie.

  • Initiëren en begeleiden van HR-projecten en verbetertrajecten.

  • Deelnemen aan het periodieke teamleidersoverleg en overleg met de ondernemingsraad.

  • Signaleren van ontwikkelingen binnen HR en arbeidsrecht en deze vertalen naar passend beleid.

  • Onderhouden van contacten met externe partijen, waaronder de arbodienst en salarisadministrateur.

  • Beheren en actualiseren van HR-documentatie, waaronder het functie- en salarishuis en het bedrijfsreglement.

Wie ben jij?

Interconnect zoekt een praktische, communicatief sterke en resultaatgerichte HR-professional die zowel op tactisch als operationeel niveau kan schakelen.Je hebt plezier in het begeleiden van collega's, weet mensen mee te nemen in veranderingen en voelt je thuis in een organisatie met korte lijnen.Je beschikt over:

  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring als HR Teamlead, HR Business Partner of in een vergelijkbare functie.

  • Actuele kennis van HR-processen en arbeidswetgeving.

  • Sterke communicatieve en adviserende vaardigheden.

  • Een proactieve, zelfstandige en oplossingsgerichte instelling.

  • Beschikbaarheid van minimaal 32 uur per week.

Wat biedt Interconnect?

Je komt terecht bij een stabiel en groeiend familiebedrijf waar professionaliteit, samenwerking en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tot € 5.500 op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. Voor zeer ervaren kandidaten is een hoger salaris bespreekbaar.

  • Een jaarlijkse prestatiebonus die kan oplopen tot één bruto maandsalaris.

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling waarbij Interconnect gemiddeld twee derde van de premie betaalt.

  • 25 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis, met de mogelijkheid om maximaal 10 extra dagen bij te kopen.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,21 per kilometer of volledige vergoeding van het openbaar vervoer.

  • Mogelijkheid om maximaal 40% van de contracturen vanuit huis te werken.

  • Een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan en mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen.

Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

  • Een moderne werkomgeving in het hoofdkantoor in ’s-Hertogenbosch, met een lunch-/werkcafé, gaming room en skybar.

  • Regelmatige teamactiviteiten, waaronder een zomer-BBQ, game nights, vitaliteitsdagen en teamuitjes.

Over Interconnect

Interconnect is een Nederlands familiebedrijf dat sinds 1995 actief is in de wereld van IT-infrastructuur, datacenters en clouddiensten. Met ongeveer 130 medewerkers en eigen Tier III-datacenters in ’s-Hertogenbosch en Eindhoven levert Interconnect veilige en betrouwbare IT-oplossingen aan onder andere managed service providers, softwarebedrijven en zakelijke eindgebruikers. De organisatie speelt een belangrijke rol in de digitale infrastructuur van Nederland en combineert technologische expertise met de betrokkenheid en korte communicatielijnen van een familiebedrijf.

Interesse?

title: HSE Manager (h/f)
descriptionHtml:

title: Human Resources Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role
You'll own the people agenda for our teams in France, where the large majority of Vibe's engineering and product talent sit. You'll be the go-to HR partner for our technical organization, working hand in hand with the CTO, the SVP Product, and the SVP Engineering, while leading employee relations and French labor law compliance across France. You'll report to our HRBP Director in New York and partner closely with our Chief People Officer, based in Paris. This role exists because our European headcount is scaling fast and the technical org needs a dedicated partner on the ground. You'll get real ownership of a strategic region, direct exposure to senior technical leaders, and the chance to shape how we grow talent across three continents.


What You'll Do

  • Partner with leaders on the full talent lifecycle, from onboarding to retention.

  • Serve as the primary HR partner to the CTO, SVP Product, and SVP Engineering on their technical teams.

  • Lead employee relations across France, from everyday cases to complex situations.

  • Own compliance with French labor law across all people practices.

  • Coach managers across the region to raise the bar on people management.

  • Advise on organizational design as the technical org scales.

  • Build career frameworks that give technical teams clear growth paths.

  • Adapt company-wide People programs to the local context: Total Rewards, performance, mobility.

What You Need

  • 3–5 years as an HRBP or HR generalist, including time in both a scale-up and a larger group.

  • Working knowledge of French labor law and employee relations.

  • Experience supporting engineering and product teams.

  • Fluency in English (our working language) and French.

  • Familiarity with People programs like Total Rewards, performance cycles, or internal mobility.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience partnering with teams across multiple countries and time zones.

  • A track record of connecting people decisions to business outcomes.

Our Values
At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.
You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.
This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.
If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.


What We Offer

The pay range for this role is €60,000–€90,000.
At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

Our Interview Process
We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect — no surprises, no ghosting.

  • Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  • Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

Equal Opportunity

descriptionHtml:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

The Role:

We are looking for an IAM Engineer to support day-to-day identity and access management operations, primarily using Okta Workforce Identity Cloud. This is a hands-on role suited to someone beginning their IAM career or developing from an IT support or security operations position. You will help manage secure access to SaaS, cloud and internal systems, with structured guidance from experienced IAM and security engineers.

You will support joiner, mover and leaver processes, application access requests, Okta troubleshooting and role-based access control (RBAC). You will also gain practical exposure to Terraform-managed IAM configuration through peer-reviewed changes and established deployment processes.

What you’ll do:

title: Implementation Manager
descriptionHtml:
Location: Dublin or London, hybrid, minimum 2 days per week in office

Full-time, permanent


About Kota

Kota is making insurance and retirement benefits as accessible as modern software. We do this across two products: Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance and retirement product for other platforms.

Today we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at companies including Carwow, Tines, Zoe and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from investors including EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone and Frontline, along with founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio and OpenAI.

The Role

Kota Embed powers the benefits layer inside other platforms, mostly employers of record and HR platforms with employees across multiple countries. Partner launches and growth require best-in-class delivery: integration build, benefits set up market by market, data migration, seamless end-customer product experience, and support readiness.

We're hiring an Implementation Manager to own those launches end to end, plus the renewals that follow. You'll run around five at once working alongside Embed Sales and Account Management teams.

This is a delivery role with real teeth. Partners tell their own clients when benefits are going live based on what we tell them, so the dates matter and the person who owns them has to be able to hold a line and change it early when it needs changing.


What You'll Do

  • Own new partner launches from signature to live: scope, plan, cadence, dependencies, blockers, the lot

  • Run roughly five concurrent projects, and know which one needs you this week

  • Align product, engineering, benefits and commercial around the same plan and the same dates

  • Define what go-live actually means for each launch, and get everyone using the same definition

  • Chase blockers rather than report them, including with people who don't work for you

  • Join partner calls alongside the Account Executive or Account Manager, and lead the delivery half of them

  • Keep internal tracking in Asana and the partner-facing view in sync

  • Spot a slipping date early and say so, to us and to the partner

What We're Looking For

  • Experience running multiple customer-facing implementations at once rather than one large programme

  • Either technical depth, comfortable with APIs and integration conversations, or a strong data and analytics background. We're open on which

  • A track record of getting things delivered through people who don't report to you

  • Calm and process-driven, with the judgement to know when the process is in the way

  • Comfortable in front of customers, including when the news isn't good

  • Able to hold a date, defend it, and change it early rather than late

  • Highly organised and proactive - enough to run five things properly rather than five things approximately

  • Comfortable with pace and with processes that are still being built


Benefits, HR tech, payments, fintech, cross-border or migration experience is a plus. You don't need to know anything about insurance or pensions before you start.


Our Values

  • Have Integrity. We care deeply about our why and it won't jeopardise our how.

  • Care Deeply. Our products are our story, we look at the details, go the extra mile to delight customers.

  • Own Your Ship. Ask why, do the work, get the data, solve the problem, be an owner.

  • Raise the Bar. We continuously look to push past good enough. Expect more, move faster, and never stop raising your and the team's standards.

  • Play to Win. We exist because we decided to say no to the norm, now we do this everyday.


Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter screen, 30 mins. Cover the basics and make sure we're aligned

  2. Competency interview, 45 mins. With our Strategy & Operations Associate

  3. Task, 60 mins. A real implementation scenario. We'll send it in advance and work through it together on the call with GM + 1

  4. Final, 45 mins. With our CEO and COO


Benefits

  • Health insurance via Kota

  • Workplace pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota (location dependent)

  • Group life assurance via Kota (location dependent)

  • WFH stipend for your home office setup

  • Annual company-wide offsite
