title: Influencer & Branded Content  Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are PMG

PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years.

Who You'll Be Working With

At PMG, our Influencer & Branded Content team is at the intersection of culture, storytelling, and strategy, helping brands connect with audiences in authentic, meaningful ways. We craft high-impact influencer campaigns that go beyond traditional advertising, driving engagement, building brand affinity, and delivering measurable results across social, digital, and experiential platforms.

As the Influencer & Branded Content Senior Manager, you’ll play a key leadership role in shaping and delivering influencer and creator strategies across PMG’s clients. You’ll collaborate with creators, talent agencies, media strategists, content teams, client leaders, and brand partners to develop programs that connect cultural relevance with business impact. You’ll help strengthen PMG’s influencer and creator marketing capabilities by establishing scalable best practices, developing strong talent and platform relationships, and ensuring a high standard of strategy, execution, measurement, and client service.

You’ll help advance the future of branded content at PMG by identifying emerging creator trends, exploring new content formats and platforms, and translating innovation into actionable opportunities for clients. You’ll also lead and develop team members, helping them strengthen their strategic thinking, channel expertise, and ability to deliver exceptional work.

If you’re passionate about shaping culture through creator-driven storytelling, using data to guide meaningful decisions, and building innovative influencer programs that deliver measurable impact, this is the place to make your mark.

What You Will Do

  • Lead full-scale influencer and branded content campaigns from brief to delivery—including strategy development, talent identification, negotiations, publisher partnerships, content approvals, and reporting—translating business objectives, audience insights, and cultural trends into impactful creator programs.
  • Oversee campaign strategy and execution in partnership with internal team members, ensuring every detail is delivered with excellence, on time, aligned with brand standards and client business objectives, and optimized for measurable success.
  • Manage and mentor a team of professionals, supporting workload planning, day-to-day execution, coaching, feedback, performance management, and long-term professional development while building a culture of collaboration, creativity, and accountability.
  • Partner with the Director of Influencer & Branded Content to help evolve PMG’s offerings, develop scalable frameworks, best practices, processes, and measurement approaches, and train team members to grow their expertise and impact.
  • Serve as a senior subject matter expert in influencer marketing and branded content, bringing a strong point of view to client conversations, strategic recommendations, new business opportunities, and emerging creator trends.
  • Serve as a senior point of contact for clients, clearly communicating strategic plans, campaign updates, recommendations, and results through regular calls, emails, and in-person meetings.
  • Develop innovative influencer and branded content programs for existing clients and new business opportunities, partnering closely with account, strategy, media, and creative teams to connect creator ideas to broader marketing objectives.
  • Play an active role in new business efforts, contributing to RFPs, pitch development, influencer research, and presentation storytelling.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with creators, talent agencies, publishers, and platform partners to expand access to talent, industry insights, platform innovation, and strategic opportunities.
  • Bring platform fluency across both established and emerging social channels, shaping creator strategies that are native to each platform.
  • Track and distill influencer marketing trends into practical strategies that keep our work relevant, fresh, and forward-thinking.
  • Apply and evolve measurement frameworks to evaluate creator performance, campaign effectiveness, audience engagement, and business impact, translating results into actionable recommendations for clients.
  • Provide strategic guidance and quality oversight across campaign planning, creator selection, contracting, content approvals, reporting, compliance, and partnership deliverables.
  • Partner with senior leaders to identify opportunities to improve team processes, resource planning, capabilities, and approaches that support continued client and business growth.
  • Use AI, automation, and technology to elevate the quality and efficiency of work, streamline processes, and enable faster, more informed decision-making.
  • The primary focus of this role is the Influencer & Branded Content channel, ensuring excellence in strategy, execution, and performance. However, responsibilities may extend across other media channels as needed to support broader campaign objectives and business priorities.

What You Will Bring

  • 6+ years of experience in Influencer & Branded Content, including 3+ years of leadership experience, with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • You bring advanced expertise in content creation and influencer marketing strategy, developing creator-led programs that connect cultural insight, platform behavior, audience needs, and client business goals.
  • You have strong experience in contract review and proposal development, navigating creator and partnership negotiations with clarity, consistency, and a focus on delivering value for clients and partners.
  • You bring exceptional attention to detail, maintaining high standards across campaign execution, reporting, content approvals, compliance, and partnership deliverables.
  • You have strong proficiency in project implementation, leading complex influencer and branded content programs from strategic planning through launch, optimization, and post-campaign learning.
  • You are skilled in presentation and communication, delivering clear strategic narratives, senior-level recommendations, and performance insights to clients, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • You have a deep understanding of advertising standards, client service, and relationship management, helping brands and creators build trusted partnerships that meet business, legal, and platform expectations.
  • You are proficient with influencer management dashboards, social media platforms, and the broader social media ecosystem, using data to evaluate creators, guide recommendations, and improve campaign performance.
  • You have experience building relationships across the influencer marketing ecosystem, including creators, talent agencies, publishers, and platform partners, and leveraging those relationships to strengthen client programs.
  • You bring strategic thinking, business and financial acumen, and thoughtful resource management to guide account priorities, team planning, and scalable approaches to client growth.
  • You have demonstrated experience managing and developing team members, balancing day-to-day leadership with coaching, feedback, performance management, and long-term professional development.
  • A commitment to curiosity and adaptability as a Continual Learner, staying at the forefront of media innovation while prioritizing client success with a Customer-Focused mindset that seeks opportunities to deliver meaningful value.
  • A dedication to People-Focused leadership, fostering collaboration, innovation, and professional growth by Leading by Example and nurturing strong relationships that empower others to excel.

What We Offer

Performance-Based Rewards: Your impact should be part of your reward. This role is eligible for PMG’s annual bonus program—a standout part of our total compensation offering and an opportunity to share in our success. Bonus awards are informed by individual impact and performance, as well as team and company results, and are subject to applicable program terms.

Professional Development: Keep growing through learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and support for career advancement.

Generous Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge, connect with loved ones, and enjoy life outside work.

Parental Leave: Receive paid parental leave during life’s important family moments.

Retirement Benefits: Build for your future with competitive retirement benefits, including employer contributions or matching where applicable.

Fertility and Family Support: Access fertility and family-building benefits for eligible employees and their spouses or partners.

Healthcare: Choose from medical, dental, and vision coverage designed to support you and your family.

Pet Insurance: Access optional coverage for the four-legged members of your family.

Commuter Benefits: Access support for your commute where available.

Volunteering Opportunities: Receive eight paid hours each year to give back to your community.

AI Tools and Training: Access enterprise AI tools and ongoing training that helps PMGers use AI effectively, creatively, and responsibly.

Our benefits and compensation programs may vary by location and eligibility and are subject to applicable plan terms. We’ll share full details during the hiring process.

What Sets Us Apart

Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that’s unmatched in digital. We're dedicated to working hard to serve our employees and clients, delivering value, results, and innovation—which often requires true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve in every way.

title: Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

As the Instrumentation Development Embedded Engineer, you will own the development of high-speed control and protection systems for the Alpha fusion demonstrator, focusing on FPGA-based solutions for plasma heating hardware protection.

You will work across the full development lifecycle, from writing and verifying HDL code to developing software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop testing, integrating embedded software and electronics, and establishing robust development and deployment pipelines.

You will also help establish Proxima’s FPGA development capability beyond plasma heating, defining reusable architectures, development workflows, testing methodologies, and HDL best practices that can be adopted across other systems.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Design, implement, and maintain HDL-based control and protection systems, starting with plasma heating system protection.

  • Establish end-to-end FPGA development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and SIL/HIL test environments integrated with plant design frameworks.

  • Develop embedded software, firmware, and low-level drivers to interface FPGAs with sensors, actuators, and other control systems.

  • Collaborate across RF, controls, electronics, and systems teams to define system interfaces, ICDs, and verification plans.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Degree in Electronics, Embedded Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Strong proficiency in HDL (VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog) and software scripting (Python, C/C++).

  • Proven experience integrating FPGAs with hardware peripherals, board-level electronics, and communication interfaces.

  • Familiarity with modern software development practices (Git, CI, code review, automated testing).

  • Systems-thinking approach with strong debugging skills spanning HDL, embedded firmware, and physical hardware.

Nice to have:

  • High-speed digital interfaces (multi-gigabit serial links, LVDS, SerDes, RF/instrumentation links) and PCB-level signal integrity.

  • FPGA+processor platforms and MPSoCs (e.g., AMD/Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+).

  • Precision timing and synchronization (IEEE 1588 PTP, White Rabbit)

  • Network protocols (Ethernet).

  • Real-time signal processing, fast protection systems, and high-speed data acquisition in fusion or industrial environments.

  • HDL design methodologies and techniques for reliable radiation-hardened systems.

  • Schematic comprehension and custom PCB development.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at "L2" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

Many people completely underestimate the market size: about €600bn sold per year today, going to €1.8tn by 2028.

Instead of 5 players in the chain (brand → issuing tech provider → global distributor → local distributor → client), we connect brands directly with clients via the finperks platform.

We’re a team of 20 in Berlin-Charlottenburg. A mix of our best people from the last journey and brilliant new joiners. High ownership. Low ego. Kind humans. We ship fast, help each other, and celebrate wins.

Join early. Help build the global champion for prepaid.

Tasks

As a Founders Associate Intern, you’ll work directly alongside the founding team and be involved in every aspect of building finperks. As we move fast, your tasks and responsibilities will evolve with the company – expect new topics to land on your desk regularly.

  • Brand Approvals: Own brand approval workflows across clients, markets and suppliers – from building client-specific brand lists to preparing one-pagers and volume forecasts for suppliers and tracking approvals until brands go live

  • Sales Support & GTM Automation: Build and run outreach campaigns, create and enrich lead lists, and prepare tailored offers and materials for clients and brands

  • Strategic Projects: Work on founder-level topics such as market entry, internationalization and pricing, building your own analyses and decision materials. You’ll also be involved in our next funding round by preparing fundraising and due diligence materials

  • Operational Excellence & Automation: Build internal tools, trackers and automations (e.g. with AI tools) that help us scale

  • Client Onboarding: Support new clients from contract signing to go-live, including product setup in our platform and supplier coordination

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, brand & supplier, product and tech to drive projects across team boundaries – and occasionally represent finperks at conferences, events or client dinners

Requirements

  • Drive & Ambition: You’re motivated to go the extra mile and thrive in fast-paced, dynamic startup environments

  • Analytical Mindset: You’re proficient in Excel and PowerPoint and comfortable working with CRM tools and Notion, with strong analytical skills and the ability to quickly grasp complex business models and market dynamics

  • Organized & Detail-Oriented: You keep many workstreams on track at once and care about getting the details right

  • Tech-Savvy: You’re comfortable with AI tools and can implement small automations independently

  • Communication Skills: Excellent English; German is a plus. Any additional European language (e.g. French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Romanian) is a big advantage

  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: You’re excited about building something from scratch and comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration

  • Location: You’re willing to relocate to Berlin and work from our office in Berlin-Charlottenburg

Nice to have: Prior startup/FinTech or Consulting experience

Benefits

  • Learn from Proven Entrepreneurs: Work directly with founders who’ve built and successfully exited one of Germany’s most successful FinTech companies

  • Ownership from Day One: You’ll be a full team member with real responsibility and the opportunity to shape the company’s direction

  • Deep Startup Ecosystem Access: Immerse yourself in Berlin’s vibrant startup scene and build a network that will accelerate your career

  • Insights into Scaling a Startup: Experience first-hand how a venture grows from its first clients to expansion across Europe, and learn how business models, markets and partnerships are evaluated along the way

  • Venture Capital Insights: Get close to the investment side through our next funding round, learning how investors evaluate startups and make investment decisions

Ready to build the next Unicorn in FinTech?

Join us at finperks and help us financially empower people across Europe. If you’re excited about the opportunity to learn from experienced entrepreneurs while making real impact, we want to hear from you!

finperks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Internship - UAV Robotics/Mechatronics (Drone Prototyping, Integration & Field Testing)
descriptionHtml:
Opening

WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP


Details

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: full-time (5 days/week)

Period: 6 months

Location: Aerospace Innovation Hub, Delft, the Netherlands


About the company

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.


Your role

If you’ve ever spent a weekend building a drone, tuning a flight controller, soldering a power harness, or figuring out why your FPV setup won’t arm, this internship is literally designed for you.

We’re looking for a hands-on builder who loves working with real hardware:

  • wiring sensors

  • mounting compute boards

  • setting up flight controllers

  • testing drones outdoors

  • fixing whatever breaks and making it better

If phrases like ArduPilot, PX4, Jetson, ESCs, power distribution, 3D printing, or FPV gear make you smile, you’re the kind of person we want.

This is not a “sit behind a desk” internship. You will be on the drones. You will be in the field. You will fly.


What you’ll do

  • Build and integrate hardware onto real drone platforms used in active R&D.

  • Work hands-on with flight controllers (ArduPilot) and compute boards (Jetson, Orange Pi).

  • Deploy and debug embedded perception software.

  • Solder, assemble, and prototype wiring, adapters, mounts, and housings.

  • 3D-print parts and quickly turn ideas into working physical prototypes.

  • Support and participate in drone flight tests (you’ll fly regularly).

  • Troubleshoot issues, iterate fast, and improve our hardware setups.

You’ll see your work fly, literally!


Who you are

  • You’ve built or flown drones / RC systems (any level counts).

  • You tinker with electronics, FPV, embedded software, or robotics.

  • You enjoy making physical things work.

  • You like fast iteration and getting your hands dirty.

  • Linux doesn’t scare you.

  • You are independent, curious, and resourceful.

We don’t care about grades, we care about what you’ve made.

Please include photos/links of:

  • your drone builds

  • FPV rigs

  • electronics projects

  • CAD/3D-printed parts

  • GitHub repos

  • anything that shows you build things

If you’ve ever crashed something, fixed it, and sent it back into the sky — you’ll fit right in.


Requirements

  • Enrolled in a relevant study (Aerospace, Robotics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Engineering etc.).

  • Linux basics.

  • Interest in UAVs, robotics, embedded systems, or autonomy.

  • English proficiency.

  • Organized and proactive.

Bonus:

driver’s license, drone pilot license, CAD, 3D printing, soldering, or flight experience.

What we offer

  • 1000 euro monthly compensation.

  • 10 vacation days during internship period.

  • (Really) flexible working hours and option to work from home 2 days per week.

  • Have a direct and significant influence on highly innovative products.

  • The opportunity to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops, close to the product. We are innovating, learning is to be expected.

  • Responsibility over the things you implement, you are the expert on what you build.

The application procedure

  • If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself; this can be a resume, website or other source, as long as we get a clear impression of your background and skills.

  • We’ll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we’ll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a technical focused interview could follow.

  • If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we’ll discuss the specifics (starting date and period).

  • Welcome to the team!

title: Interviewer / Fahrgastzähler (w/m/d) - Minijob
descriptionHtml:
Die ISUP GmbH ist ein in Dresden ansässiges und seit 35 Jahren umfassend im Verkehrssektor tätiges Ingenieurbüro. Im Bereich der empirischen Mobilitätsforschung führen wir deutschlandweit Verkehrserhebungen im Personennahverkehr durch. Diese bieten den Auftraggebern aktuelle Informationen über die tatsächliche Verkehrsnachfrage (zeitliche und räumliche Nutzung) und dienen u. a. als Aufteilungsschlüssel der Fahrgeldeinnahmen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir SIE.

Aufgaben

Als Verkehrserheber*in fahren Sie auf ausgewählten Strecken im Dieselnetz Niedersachsen-Südost jeweils ab Uelzent im Zug mit, zählen die Ein- und Aussteiger sowie die mitfahrenden Fahrgäste und befragen diese nach Fahrschein und Fahrtverlauf (keine Kontrollfunktion). Die hierbei ermittelten Daten werden per Erfassungsgerät aufgenommen und nach Abschluss des Einsatzes per WLAN übertragen.

Die Erfassung der Daten erfolgt mit zur Verfügung gestellten Smartphones. Die Nutzung priv. Erfassungsgeräte ist nach Absprache möglich und wird mit einer Aufwandsentschädigung vergütet.

Die Verkehrserhebung "DINSO 2027" wird unter anderem auf folgenden Strecken durchgeführt:

  • RB 47 Uelzen - Gifhorn - Braunschweig Hbf.

  • RB 32 Lüneburg - Dannenberg Ost

Weitere Informationen finden Sie auch auf unserer Homepage.

Qualifikation

Sie haben:

  • das 18. Lebensjahr vollendet

sind:

  • aufgeschlossen, kommunikativ, pünktlich, zuverlässig und freundlich

und verfügen über:

  • die Möglichkeit auch Einsätze in Randzeiten zu übernehmen

  • sehr gute deutsche Sprachkenntnisse (B2 und höher)

  • ein gepflegtes Erscheinungsbild und höfliche Umgangsformen

  • grundlegende Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Smartphone sowie MS Office (Excel-Tabellen)

  • Zugang zum WLAN und eigene E-Mail-Adresse

  • eigenen PKW (nicht Bedingung, aber von Vorteil)

Ihr Wohnort befindet sich

  • möglichst in Uelzen oder der näheren Umgebung

Benefits

Ihre Einsätze erfolgen flexibel nach Ihrer Verfügbarkeit (freie Auswahl bezüglich Einsatzzeit und -ort aus einer Vergabeliste). Die Einsätze werden fahrplanabhängig in den Betriebszeiten der jeweiligen Verkehrsunternehmen stattfinden. Die Dauer eines Einsatzes beträgt zwischen ca. 4,0 und ca. 6,0 Stunden. Der Startbahnhof ist in der Regel auch der Zielbahnhof.

Pausen und Umstiegszeiten innerhalb eines Einsatzes werden voll bezahlt!

Im Vorfeld erhalten Sie von unseren Mitarbeitern eine kostenfreie Schulung/Einweisung im Untersuchungsgebiet, in welcher Ihnen die Arbeitsaufgaben, die Organisation sowie der Umgang mit der Erhebungs-App und den möglichen Fahrausweisen und Tarifen erklärt werden.

Abschlussbemerkungen:

  • Vergütung: 16,50 Euro / Einsatzstunde

  • zzgl. 0,50 Euro pro Einsatzstunde bei Nutzung priv. Handy

  • Zeitraum: 11.01.2027 - 28.11.2027

  • Minijob - geringfügige oder kurzfristige Beschäftigung

  • für Selbstständige auch auf Honorarbasis möglich

title: iOS Engineer - Design System
descriptionHtml:
About the team:

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns — empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.

The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide.

What you’ll do:

  • Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem
  • Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful
  • Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming support for landscape orientation
  • Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development
  • Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health

You’ll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications
  • Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each
  • Bring experience building or contributing to a design system, component library, or shared UI framework, and understand what it takes to make components truly reusable and scalable
  • Take pride in crafting accessible user experiences — you know your way around VoiceOver, dynamic type, color contrast, and touch target standards, and treat accessibility as a first-class concern, not an afterthought
  • Bring a strong grasp of testing best practices for UI components, including unit tests, snapshot tests, and UI automation
  • Are comfortable reviewing code and mentoring peers — you enjoy sharing knowledge, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team
  • Are self-motivated and structured in your working style — you manage your own priorities, communicate clearly in English, and thrive in a cross-functional, collaborative environment
  • Stay genuinely curious about the iOS ecosystem — you follow Apple's releases closely, experiment with new APIs, and are excited to bring fresh ideas back to the team

Why you should join SumUp:

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced.

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp’s future success.

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advancing your career through further education.

💶 Competitive Health & Life Insurance: Includes comprehensive cover (optical, dental) and Life Assurance (2 x your salary).

💰 Financial Future: A corporate pension scheme and a referral bonus for bringing in top talent.

🏖️ Generous time off: 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days.

🌴 Break4me: 1-month paid sabbatical after 3 years of service.

🎉 Culture of Connection: Attend global offsites and/or hackathons with your teammates.

About SumUp

We believe in the everyday hero.

Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating tools that help them run their businesses. With a founder’s mentality and a 'team-first’ attitude, our diverse teams across Europe, South America and the United States work together to ensure that the small business owners we partner with can be successful doing what they love. 

SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

SumUp will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Java Developer (Regular to Senior) | Backend-focused Full Stack (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Become a Part of Accurids

Join us and help shape the future of pharmaceutical data!
At Accurids, we're building the data backbone behind life-science innovation. Our system identifies, links and standardizes critical enterprise data in compliance with global standards such as ISO IDMP. We help global life-science companies launch products faster, more safely and with better patient outcomes.
At Accurids, you'll join a collaborative, growth-driven environment where your work makes a real impact from day one.
As a member of our Product Development team, you will work with a high degree of autonomy while collaborating closely with backend and frontend engineers, QA, DevOps and product owners. You will work directly with cross-functional engineering stakeholders, and the features and fixes you deliver reach our customers. Our CTO is directly available to you as a mentor and technical sparring partner.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Own features end-to-end, backend first: Design and build services, APIs (GraphQL and REST) and the data layer in modern Java and Spring Boot, then take the feature all the way into our React/TypeScript frontend. AI agents write most of the UI code, so your eye for good interfaces is what makes the difference.
  • Extend the platform: Build integrations with the systems our pharma customers rely on and extend the platform for customer-specific needs.
  • Bring AI into the product: Work on AI features inside the platform, from integrations with AI assistants to LLM-powered capabilities.
  • Amplify velocity with AI: Be part of our AI-native engineering culture. You use tools like Cursor, Claude or Gemini to speed up scaffolding, refactoring and test writing, while keeping architectural integrity, security and quality in view. As agents take on more of the routine coding, your role moves up a level. You direct them, help shape the architecture and own the quality of what ships.
  • Contribute to the architecture, hands-on: Help develop our modular architecture (Spring Modulith, platform and feature modules), optimize PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch queries and work with RDF semantic data structures.
  • Raise the bar on quality: Maintain solid test coverage (JUnit, Testcontainers, Playwright) and give thoughtful merge request reviews, including on AI-generated code.

What helps you succeed:

  • Backend experience: 3+ years building backend services in production. Solid knowledge of modern Java (21+) and Spring Boot (Spring Security, Spring Data JPA), PostgreSQL with Flyway and API design with REST and GraphQL. A Computer Science degree, Fachinformatiker training or strong hands-on experience as a career changer are all welcome.
  • Eye for good UI: You have a feel for good UI principles and are happy to own the frontend part of a feature. Experience with React and TypeScript is a plus.
  • Architectural thinking: You think in modules, boundaries and trade-offs, and you enjoy building what you design.
  • AI-native mindset: AI tools like Cursor, Claude and Gemini are part of your daily workflow. You treat AI as an output amplifier and combine curiosity with sound judgment about what ships.
  • Quality & delivery: Experience with testing at all levels (unit, integration, E2E) and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Location & work permit: You are based in Germany within a reasonable commuting distance to our Cologne office (NRW) and hold a valid German work permit.
  • Languages: Business-fluent English is required, and German skills are a strong plus.
  • Bonus: DevOps experience (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS), semantic web (RDF, SPARQL, Apache Jena), Elasticsearch, LLM or MCP integration, Material UI, or pharma/life-sciences domains (FHIR, IDMP).

Why you’ll love working here:

  • Grow your expertise: Deepen your specialization in semantic data platforms, AI features or platform architecture as we scale.
  • Epic Office & Hybrid Work: Work from our brand-new office in the KölnTurm, featuring breathtaking views over the city (even higher than the view from the Cologne Cathedral!). Enjoy flexible hybrid options. (Note: On-site presence in Cologne/NRW is required, and fully remote work is not offered.)
  • Community & Industry Events: Connect and grow your network through exclusive industry events hosted regularly right in our scenic office space.
  • Competitive Compensation: Fixed salary package of €60,000 to €100,000 per year, depending on experience, for a full-time, permanent position.
  • Work-Life Balance & Perks: 30 days of paid vacation, a personal learning budget, hardware of your choice (Mac, Linux, Windows), and your choice between a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership or a €50/month City Plus Card.
  • Empowered Culture: High trust, flat hierarchies and an environment where your decisions directly shape the product.

Not ticking every box?

We encourage you to apply anyway! We know great talent doesn't always follow a checklist, and we care more about your potential, curiosity and motivation to learn.
At Accurids, we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially encourage women and people from underrepresented backgrounds in tech, science and data to apply.

Join our international team in Utrecht. Build relationships across borders. Start your career with Securance.

Apply now!

title: Junior Product Manager:in
descriptionHtml:
Über Valova

Wir bauen die KI-Betriebsplattform für Europas Krankenhäuser, damit sich jede Ärztin und jeder Arzt auf die Patienten konzentrieren kann.

Hinter jedem Fall steht eine Kette administrativer Aufgaben: Dokumentation, Kodierung, Abrechnung, Prüfungen, Planung. Sie läuft über getrennte Systeme und unzählige manuelle Übergaben, während die meisten deutschen Kliniken bereits rote Zahlen schreiben.

Wir starten dort, wo der Effekt ab Tag eins messbar ist: vom Fall bis zum Geldeingang. Valova kodiert jeden Fall, verteidigt ihn in der Prüfung und sorgt dafür, dass das Geld ankommt. Von dort übernehmen wir jeden Workflow eines Krankenhauses, bis ein agentisches System die Routine erledigt und Menschen über Ausnahmen entscheiden. Erst Deutschland, dann Europa.

Ein Team aus Ärzt:innen, Engineers, Strategieberater:innen und Start-up-Profis. Vor Ort in München und Berlin. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Warum diese Rolle wichtig ist

Mit Valova kodieren Kliniken ihre Fälle schon heute deutlich schneller. Und das ist erst der Anfang: Wir bauen Valova Schritt für Schritt über die Kodierung hinaus aus, und jede Erweiterung muss im Klinikalltag funktionieren, nicht nur in der Demo.

Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel. Du findest heraus, wo Kodierteams Zeit und Erlöse verlieren, entscheidest mit, was wir als Nächstes bauen, und bringst es mit unserem Engineeringteam live. Du bist die Brücke zwischen Klinik und Code und zwischen unserem Team und den Menschen, die täglich mit Valova arbeiten.

Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du schwarz auf weiß: in weniger Minuten pro Fall und in mehr Fällen, die Valova ohne Korrektur abrechnet.

Deine Rolle im Team

Du berichtest direkt an Malte, unseren Produkt Lead, und arbeitest täglich mit unseren Engineers zusammen. Fachlich arbeitest Du eng mit unseren Kodier- und Abrechnungsexpert:innen: Sie kennen die Regeln, Du machst daraus Produkt. In Klinikprojekten arbeitest Du Hand in Hand mit unserem Vertrieb und Customer Success und auf Klinikseite mit Medizincontrolling, Kodierfachkräften und Ärzt:innen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Einen Produktbereich verantworten: Du übernimmst einen eigenen Bereich unseres Produkts, von der ersten Anforderung bis zum Einsatz in der Klinik.

  • Vor Ort beobachten: Du bist regelmäßig in Kliniken, schaust Kodierteams und Medizincontrolling über die Schulter und findest heraus, wo Zeit und Erlöse verloren gehen.

  • Anforderungen schreiben: Du übersetzt Deine Erkenntnisse in klare User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien und klärst offene Fragen, bevor sie die Entwicklung aufhalten.

  • Regeln ins Produkt bringen: Mit unseren Fachexpert:innen sorgst Du dafür, dass Kodier- und Abrechnungsregeln richtig im Produkt ankommen.

  • Unsere KI besser machen: Du arbeitest mit Engineering an Evaluationen und prüfst, ob die Vorschläge von Valova mit jedem Release besser werden.

  • Releases begleiten: Du testest neue Versionen und begleitest mit Customer Success den Start in neuen Kliniken.

  • Mit Daten arbeiten: Du verfolgst, wie Valova genutzt wird und wirkt, und leitest daraus ab, was wir als Nächstes bauen.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Medizinischer Hintergrund: Idealerweise ein Medizinstudium, eine Ausbildung in einem Gesundheitsfachberuf oder Erfahrung im Medizincontrolling. Du weißt, wie ein Fall durchs Krankenhaus läuft.

  • Erste Produkterfahrung: Ein bis zwei Jahre im Produktmanagement, in einem Health-Tech-Startup oder in der Beratung. Du hast schon einmal ein Feature oder Projekt von der Idee bis zum Ergebnis verantwortet.

  • Technisches Verständnis: Du musst nicht programmieren, kannst aber technische Dokumentation lesen und mit Engineers über Lösungen diskutieren.

  • Präzises Denken: Du hinterfragst gern Prozesse und beschreibst Regeln so genau, dass Software sie umsetzen kann.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist im Gespräch mit Ärzt:innen, Medizincontrolling und Technik gleichermaßen sicher.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du bist gern rund 20 bis 30 Prozent Deiner Zeit in Kliniken unterwegs.

  • Sprachen: Du sprichst Deutsch fließend auf C1-Niveau und gutes Englisch.

  • Ein Plus: Kenntnisse in Kodierung oder Abrechnung (z. B. DRG, OPS, GOÄ), Erfahrung mit KIS-Software (z. B. Orbis, SAP IS-H, i.s.h.med) oder Tools wie Jira und Figma sowie erste Erfahrung mit Datenanalyse (Excel, SQL) oder KI-Anwendungen.

Dir fehlen ein oder zwei Punkte, aber Du bist überzeugt, die richtige Person für diese Rolle zu sein? Dann bewirb Dich trotzdem. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ownership ab der ersten Woche. Du übernimmst echte Projekte mit klarem Ergebnis und deinem Namen darauf, keine Aufgabenliste, die sich jemand anderes ausgedacht hat.

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern. Du arbeitest täglich mit Sophia, Ärztin und ehemalige McKinsey-Beraterin und Christian, der zwei Health-Tech-Startups gegründet und ein Jahrzehnt lang klinische Systeme gebaut hat. Keine Hierarchieebenen, kein wochenlanges Warten auf Freigaben.

  • Lernen im Startup-Tempo. Du erlebst hier in einem Jahr mehr als anderswo in drei.

  • Ein Team, mitten in der Stadt. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam vor Ort im WeWork am Odeonsplatz in München und im WeWork in Berlin-Mitte. Voll ausgestattete Büros mit Kaffee, Meetingräumen und Phone Booths bedeuten null Verwaltungsaufwand, und die zentrale Lage bedeutet kurze Wege, schnellen Zugang zu Kunden und Investoren und Mittagsoptionen an jeder Ecke.

  • Ein motiviertes Team. , mit Ärztinnen und Ärzten, Engineers und Operators, die sich hohe Ziele setzen und sich gegenseitig dabei unterstützen, sie zu erreichen.

  • Team-Events, die München und Berlin zusammenbringen, denn die Menschen, mit denen du baust, sollten auch die sein, mit denen du feierst.

  • Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, das deinen Impact widerspiegelt.

So sieht Erfolg aus

  • Nach 3 Monaten kennst Du Valova in- und auswendig, hast in mehreren Kliniken Kodierteams bei der Arbeit begleitet und Deine ersten Features live gebracht.

  • Nach 6 Monaten verantwortest Du einen eigenen Produktbereich, und Kodierteams wissen, dass sie sich an Dich wenden können.

  • Nach 12 Monaten zeigt Dein Bereich messbare Wirkung im Klinikalltag, und Kodierteams verlassen sich täglich darauf.

  • Die ganze Zeit über kommt Feedback aus den Kliniken schnell in unserem Produkt an, weil Du regelmäßig vor Ort bist.

Bewerbungsprozess

Lade einfach Deinen Lebenslauf mit Deiner Bewerbung hoch. Für die nächsten Schritte melden wir uns bei Dir:

  • Kennenlernen (30 Min.): Wir lernen uns kennen, sprechen über Deinen Werdegang und beantworten Deine ersten Fragen.

  • Gespräch mit Malte (Produkt Lead) (60 Min.): Wir sprechen über Deinen Hintergrund und darüber, wie Du an Produktfragen herangehst.

  • Case: Du bekommst eine echte Situation aus dem Klinikalltag und zeigst uns, wie Du das Problem eingrenzt, priorisierst und in erste Anforderungen übersetzt.

  • Referenzen: Wir sprechen mit zwei oder drei Personen, mit denen Du zusammengearbeitet hast, zum Beispiel ehemaligen Vorgesetzten oder Kolleg:innen.

  • Team treffen: Du verbringst Zeit mit uns vor Ort in München, lernst unsere Gründer:innen Sophia und Christian kennen und siehst, wie wir im Alltag arbeiten.

  • Angebot: Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, hörst Du schnell von uns.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter oder sexueller Identität.

title: Key Account Manager (m/w/d) – E-Commerce & Retention Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Unternehmen: Invisible Brands GmbH
Erfahrungslevel: Senior

Du betreust keine Accounts. Du entwickelst erfolgreiche Brands weiter.

Stell dir vor, du übernimmst die Verantwortung für eine ambitionierte E-Commerce-Brand.

Du analysierst ihre Zahlen, erkennst ungenutzte Umsatzpotenziale und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team Strategien, die wirklich etwas bewegen.

Wenige Wochen später steigen die Umsätze, die Kundenbindung verbessert sich und du sitzt mit der Geschäftsführung am Tisch, um die nächsten Wachstumsziele zu definieren.

Und das Beste daran? Du hast diese Entwicklung maßgeblich mitgestaltet.

Genau so verstehen wir Key Account Management bei Invisible Brands.

Wir suchen keine reinen Projektverwalter, sondern Menschen, die strategisch denken, Verantwortung übernehmen und für ihre Kunden zu echten Wachstumspartnern werden.

Wer wir sind

Wir sind Invisible Brands, eine spezialisierte Agentur für E-Mail- und Retention-Marketing aus Paderborn.

Wir helfen ambitionierten E-Commerce-Brands dabei, durch strategisches E-Mail-, SMS- und WhatsApp-Marketing nachhaltig zu wachsen.

Dafür verbinden wir datengetriebene Strategien mit kreativem Storytelling, hochwertigem Design und technologischem Know-how.

Zu unseren Kunden zählen Brands wie Braineffect, Gillie, Fairment, Dermalogica, Bär Schuhe, Cusb Clothing, YoungFashionMind und Aylashes.

Unser internationales Team wächst weiter. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, unternehmerisch denken und gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Wachstumsphase gestalten möchten.

Deine Aufgaben – Strategie trifft Verantwortung

  • Key Account Management: Du verantwortest dein eigenes Kundenportfolio, bist zentraler Ansprechpartner auf Entscheiderebene und entwickelst langfristige, vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen.

  • Retention-Strategie: Du entwickelst individuelle E-Mail-, SMS- und WhatsApp-Strategien, um Umsatz, Wiederkaufraten und Customer Lifetime Value nachhaltig zu steigern.

  • Performance & Reporting: Du analysierst relevante KPIs, identifizierst Wachstumspotenziale und präsentierst konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen in regelmäßigen Strategie- und Performance-Calls.

  • Projekt- & Teamsteuerung: Du koordinierst unsere Copywriter, Designer und technischen Spezialisten und stellst sicher, dass Strategien effizient und qualitativ hochwertig umgesetzt werden.

  • Kampagnen & Automationen: Du verantwortest die strategische Planung von Kampagnen, automatisierten Flows, Produktlaunches und saisonalen Aktionen.

  • Kundenentwicklung & Retention: Du erkennst frühzeitig Herausforderungen und Abwanderungsrisiken, entwickelst proaktiv Lösungen und baust bestehende Kundenbeziehungen langfristig aus.

Das Besondere: Du bist nicht für das operative Tagesgeschäft verantwortlich. Dir steht ein spezialisiertes Umsetzungsteam zur Seite, sodass du dich auf Strategie, Kundenentwicklung und Performance konzentrieren kannst.

Dein Profil – Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing, CRM, E-Commerce oder Account-Management gesammelt, idealerweise im Agenturumfeld.

  • Fachliche Expertise: Du verstehst Retention-Marketing, Customer Journeys, Segmentierung und Marketing-Automationen und kannst daraus wirkungsvolle Strategien entwickeln.

  • Technisches Verständnis: Du bist mit Klaviyo oder vergleichbaren CRM-Plattformen vertraut und verstehst die grundlegenden Zusammenhänge hinter erfolgreichen Set-ups.

  • Analytisches Denken: Du kannst E-Commerce-KPIs interpretieren, Potenziale erkennen und daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ableiten.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du trittst souverän auf, kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich erklären und kommunizierst mit Geschäftsführern und Marketingverantwortlichen auf Augenhöhe.

  • Ownership: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, denkst unternehmerisch und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Entscheidungen und Ergebnisse.

Nice to have: Erfahrung mit Shopify, Klaviyo CDP, A/B-Testing, Kundenbindungsstrategien oder der fachlichen Führung kleiner Teams.

Ein Studium oder eine bestimmte Ausbildung ist für uns nicht entscheidend. Uns interessiert, was du kannst und welche Verantwortung du übernehmen möchtest.

Was dich bei Invisible Brands erwartet

  • Modernes Office: Ein hochwertiges Arbeitsumfeld mitten in Paderborn.

  • Bekannte E-Commerce-Brands: Übernimm strategische Verantwortung für spannende Marken und anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte.

  • Eigenes Kundenportfolio: Du erhältst echte Entscheidungsfreiheit und gestaltest die Entwicklung deiner Accounts aktiv mit.

  • Spezialisiertes Umsetzungsteam: Copywriting, Design und technische Implementierung werden durch erfahrene Kollegen unterstützt.

  • Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Arbeite mit Experten aus E-Commerce, CRM und Retention-Marketing zusammen und entwickle deine strategischen Fähigkeiten weiter.

  • Flache Hierarchien: Direkte Kommunikation, kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Fitnessstudio-Zuschuss: Wir unterstützen deinen sportlichen Ausgleich.

  • Monatlicher Sachbezug: Nach deiner Probezeit erhältst du eine Sachbezugskarte mit monatlich 50 € Guthaben.

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Möglichkeit auf Unternehmensanteile (ESOP) nach zwijähriger Firmenzugehörigkeit

  • Firmenwagen: Je nach Position und individueller Vereinbarung besteht die Möglichkeit auf einen Firmenwagen.

Unsere Kultur – Ownership statt Dienst nach Vorschrift

Wir glauben an datenbasierte Entscheidungen, unternehmerisches Denken und den Anspruch, jeden Tag besser zu werden.

Bei uns zählt nicht, wer am lautesten spricht, sondern wer Verantwortung übernimmt und Ergebnisse liefert.

Wir suchen Menschen, die Herausforderungen frühzeitig erkennen, Lösungen entwickeln und nicht darauf warten, dass ihnen jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt.

Menschen, die ihre Kunden verstehen, ihre Zahlen kennen und den Anspruch haben, gemeinsam mit ihrem Team außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

Du musst nicht auf jede Frage sofort eine Antwort haben. Aber du solltest den Ehrgeiz besitzen, die beste Lösung zu finden.

Bereit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil und ein paar kurze Sätze darüber, warum du Teil von Invisible Brands werden möchtest.

title: Lab Technician
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.


We’re looking for a detail-oriented Lab Technician to keep our Bristol labs running safely and reliably. You’ll support hardware engineers with testing, setup and equipment upkeep in a fast-paced AI hardware company.


Key responsibilities

  • Run routine tests and measurements across both Bristol labs, following established procedures

  • Set up, maintain, calibrate and troubleshoot lab equipment

  • Carry out basic soldering and small rework tasks as needed

  • Record results accurately and keep clear, traceable logs

  • Uphold health and safety procedures, including housekeeping, equipment safety checks and proactively reporting risks

  • Support audits, risk assessments and safe working practices, including for lone working

  • Help improve lab processes and SOPs

  • Keep both labs organised and stocked, and hand over clearly on the days you’re not in

Requirements

  • Experience in an electronics, hardware or lab environment

  • Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to documentation

  • Solid understanding of workplace health and safety, with a proactive approach to it

  • Able to work independently and as part of a team across two labs

  • Right to work in the UK

Desirable

  • Experience in or around data centres

  • Basic soldering and rework skills (IPC or similar training is a plus)

  • Knowledge of liquid cooling systems

  • A health and safety qualification (e.g. IOSH or NEBOSH)

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

title: Lead Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why loveholidays?

We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway.

Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams.

 

The difference you’ll make

You’ll lead the Applied AI team within the wider AI Centre of Excellence, setting technical direction and managing the engineers who build, administer and improve the AI-enabled systems and SaaS platforms that support our customers and colleagues. You’ll work closely with business verticals, engineering, security and senior stakeholders to turn business priorities into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes.

You’ll combine people management with hands-on technical leadership across applied and agentic AI workflows, SaaS services, integrations and data pipelines. You’ll guide architecture and delivery, develop the team’s capabilities and own relationships with third-party SaaS suppliers, ensuring our platforms are reliable, secure and deliver value for money.

The team sits within Business IT & AI Operations. You’ll provide the direction, governance and operational ownership that help loveholidays scale intelligent automation and well-run business systems safely and effectively, balancing new opportunities with service quality, cost and long-term maintainability.

Your day-to-day:

  • Lead and line-manage Applied AI engineers, setting clear goals, providing regular feedback and coaching, supporting career development and managing performance. Help recruit and onboard new team members as the team grows.

  • Set the team’s technical direction and delivery roadmap with business and technology stakeholders, prioritising work, allocating capacity and managing dependencies to deliver measurable business outcomes.

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership for applied and agentic AI workflows, integrations and automation pipelines, guiding architecture, reviewing designs and code, and contributing to complex or high-impact engineering work.

  • Set standards for building, testing and evaluating tool-using agents with Google ADK or similar frameworks, including safe tool access, human oversight and production readiness.

  • Own operational performance across AI-enabled services and SaaS platforms, including service health, access, releases, usage and cost. Lead incident escalation and continuous improvement, with clear evaluation criteria and service measures.

  • Own account management for third-party SaaS suppliers, acting as the primary relationship owner and running regular service and roadmap reviews. Hold suppliers accountable for agreed service levels, resolve escalations and coordinate their delivery with internal priorities.

  • Manage the supplier and contract lifecycle with procurement, finance, legal and security, covering selection, onboarding, licensing, commercial negotiations, contractual obligations, renewals, notice dates and exit planning. Own spend management for the team’s SaaS and AI services, working with finance to forecast and manage costs against agreed budgets, explain variances and optimise licences and consumption. Track adoption, spend and value, and inform build-versus-buy decisions.

  • Establish engineering and operational standards for secure change management, documentation, runbooks and governance. Communicate progress, risks and trade-offs clearly, and ensure services have clear ownership and support arrangements.

Your skillset:

  • People & Delivery Leadership: Experience line-managing engineers, coaching and developing people, managing performance and leading delivery. Able to set direction, prioritise competing demands and build a collaborative, accountable team.

  • SaaS Supplier & Account Management: Experience owning third-party supplier relationships, service reviews, escalations, licensing and renewals. Commercial judgement and the ability to work with procurement, finance, legal and security to improve service quality and value for money.

  • SaaS Platform Ownership: Experience leading the administration and lifecycle management of cloud-based business systems, including configuration, user access, environments, integrations and releases.

  • Applied AI & Technical Direction: Strong experience delivering applied and agentic AI workflows that combine models, tools and business data, including orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation and evaluation. Able to make architecture and build-versus-buy decisions, establish engineering standards and guide others. Familiarity with Google ADK or similar frameworks is desirable.

  • Engineering & Integration: Strong hands-on engineering skills and experience designing and reviewing REST API, webhook and event-driven or scheduled integrations between SaaS platforms, AI services and backend systems.

  • Operational & Stakeholder Leadership: Experience operating production services in cloud environments, preferably Google Cloud Platform, using CI/CD, observability, incident management and secure operational practices. Able to explain technical and commercial trade-offs, influence stakeholders and connect delivery to business outcomes.

The interview journey

  • Intro with a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 30 mins

  • 1st stage video interview with the hiring manager - 1 hour

  • Applied AI technical leadership, team management and SaaS supplier management task

  • Final stage with Director of Applied AI and senior stakeholders - 1 hour

Perks of joining us:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends

  • 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum

  • Ability to buy and sell annual leave

  • Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers

 

Our commitment to inclusion

At loveholidays, we focus on creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute, grow and succeed. We value the different perspectives, experiences and ideas each person brings, because they help us work better together, challenge our thinking and make stronger decisions.

As we continue to grow and evolve, we want everyone to feel supported and able to do their best work. We’re also committed to making our hiring process accessible, so please let our Talent Acquisition team know if you need any adjustments at any stage.

title: Lead Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 

About the team

 

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

  

About the role

 

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will lead high-impact AI projects and shape the technical direction of bespoke solutions. This role requires hands-on technical excellence combined with crucial team leadership.


You will define data science approaches, design robust software architectures, mentor junior colleagues, and ensure delivery rigour across projects all while building deep client relationships and solidifying our reputation as a leader in practical, measurable AI.

#LI-PRIO

  

What you'll be doing:

 

  • Leading project teams that deliver bespoke algorithms and high-stakes AI solutions to clients across the sector.

  • Conceiving the core data science approach and designing the associated robust software architecture for new engagements.

  • Mentoring a small number of data scientists and supporting the professional growth of technical team members on projects.

  • Partnering with commercial teams to build client relationships and shape project scope for technical feasibility.

  • Contributing to Faculty’s thought leadership and reputation through delivering courses, public speaking, or open-source projects.

  • Ensuring best practices are followed throughout the project lifecycle to guarantee high-quality, impactful delivery.

     

Who we're looking for:

 

  • You possess senior experience in a professional data science position or a quantitative academic field.

  • You demonstrate strong programming skills, with the ability to be a fluent Python programmer, using core libraries (NumPy, Pandas) and a deep-learning framework (e.g., PyTorch).

  • You have a deep expertise in core data science paradigms (supervised/unsupervised, NLP, validation), demonstrating a proficiency across the standard data science toolkit, including the ability to develop new, innovative algorithms.

  • You bring a leadership mindset, focused on growing the technical capabilities of the team and nurturing a collaborative culture.

  • You exhibit commercial awareness, with experience in client-facing work and the ability to translate business problems into a rigorous mathematical framework.

  • You are skilled in project planning, assessing technical feasibility, estimating delivery timelines, and leading a team to deliver high-quality work on a strict schedule.

 

Our Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Take Home Technical Assessment

  3. Technical Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team!

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.
