title: Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React
descriptionHtml:
Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring für unseren Kunden die Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD

  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit

  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote

  • Standort: Berlin

  • Produkt: Eine Software für Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement in der öffentlichen Verwaltung

  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Das Kernprodukt unserer Kunden ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen

  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen

  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln

  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen

  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden

  • Zwei Auszubildende im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)

  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für die Auszubildenden eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID

  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework

  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.

  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab

  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL

  • Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD

  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1

  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.

  • Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design-Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Dein Team

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: ein Developer Lead, ein Geschäftsführer und Projektmanager, der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Die Entwicklungsleitung und die Geschäftsführung übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Was wir bieten

  • Ein sinnstiftendes Produkt, das täglich in Bürgerämtern genutzt wird, in einem krisensicheren Markt

  • Echter Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen und eine Modernisierung mit klarem Ziel

  • 30 Urlaubstage

  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit ab 10 Uhr, 2 Remote-Tage pro Woche

  • Weiterbildung während der Arbeitszeit, Udemy-Kurse; eigene Vorschläge sind willkommen

  • Claude-Lizenz, offen für weitere Tools

  • Hardware: Lenovo ThinkPad, offen für Vorschläge

  • UrbanSportsClub und JobRad

  • Gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

  • Kennenlerngespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team

  • Technisches Interview mit Live-Projektarbeit mit dem Developer Lead und der Geschäftsführung

  • Teamgespräch vor Ort

  • Angebot

Über das Unternehmen

Unser Kunde entwickelt seit über 25 Jahren Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf die Lösungen des Unternehmens.

Du willst ein bewährtes Produkt fit für die Zukunft machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior Growth Director (Commercial Lead)
descriptionHtml:
About Moloco:

Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet.

Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system. Moloco Ads is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet. Moloco Commerce Media is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture), the AI system behind every Moloco product.

At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer. Come build what's next.

The Impact You’ll Be Contributing to Moloco:

Join Moloco as a Senior Growth Director and lead the strategic growth of some of our most important partners across EMEA. As a senior individual contributor, you will own a dedicated portfolio of top accounts, building executive partnerships and developing commercial strategies that create lasting value for customers and Moloco.

You will bring a deep understanding of each customer’s business, connect their priorities to Moloco’s capabilities, and lead our most complex commercial conversations. Your impact will extend beyond your own portfolio through selective support on high-stakes opportunities, coaching, and influencing Moloco’s product and commercial direction.

The Opportunity:

Based in London, you’ll operate as a Commercial Lead within the EMEA Growth team, accountable for substantial revenue outcomes and long-term customer growth. This is an individual contributor role combining hands-on account ownership with commercial leadership across the wider team.

Strategic Growth & Commercial Ownership

  • Own and deliver revenue targets across a dedicated portfolio of top EMEA accounts, with accountability for forecast accuracy, risk management, and long-term growth.
  • Set and drive the multi-year growth agenda for your customers, leading joint business planning with executive stakeholders to secure investment commitments, establish shared accountability, and drive delivery against ambitious commercial goals.
  • Unlock incremental revenue through expansion into new geographies, business units, use cases, and product adoption.
  • Own the most complex and ambiguous commercial negotiations across your portfolio, structuring non-standard agreements in partnership with Sales, Finance, Legal, and leadership to balance customer value, commercial risk, and sustainable growth.

Consultative Selling & Executive Partnership

  • Act as a trusted commercial advisor and industry expert to your customers, combining deep knowledge of their business models and company goals with insight into market dynamics and competitive trends to challenge assumptions, shape growth strategies, and identify where Moloco can create lasting business value.
  • Develop tailored proposals grounded in customer business outcomes, including lifetime value, payback period, and return on ad spend at scale.
  • Build long-term strategic partnerships with customers, independently owning C-suite and senior commercial relationships and aligning Moloco’s role in their growth with shared objectives, investment priorities, and measures of success.
  • Use trusted executive relationships to shape customer priorities, influence investment decisions, and unlock growth opportunities beyond existing campaigns—including opening doors to new decision-makers, business units, and markets.
  • Lead executive business reviews and strategic planning conversations, translating performance data into clear recommendations for long-term growth.

Product Expertise & Cross-Functional Influence

  • Apply deep knowledge of Moloco’s products, machine learning capabilities, and the mobile advertising ecosystem to shape credible solutions for customers.
  • Work hands-on with data to test growth hypotheses, diagnose challenges, and build commercially sound recommendations.
  • Act as the voice of the market, partnering with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to translate customer needs, industry trends, and competitive insights into recommendations that shape product priorities and unlock growth.
  • Lead the commercial development of new and ambiguous growth opportunities, setting direction, mobilising cross-functional teams, and driving customer validation to turn successful approaches into repeatable revenue opportunities across EMEA.
  • Influence senior cross-functional stakeholders to prioritise strategic account opportunities, secure resources, and resolve competing priorities to deliver commercial outcomes.

Coaching & Commercial Leadership

  • Set the standard for consultative selling, deal strategy, negotiation, and executive engagement across EMEA, leading by example in your own accounts and coaching Growth Managers and Growth Directors to strengthen their commercial capabilities.
  • Bring senior commercial expertise to accounts beyond your own portfolio, working alongside account owners to lead high-stakes customer conversations, navigate complex negotiations, and resolve escalations.
  • Turn successful approaches into practical frameworks and playbooks that raise commercial standards across EMEA.
  • Build a reputation as a recognised industry expert in adtech and mobile growth, actively speaking at industry events and sharing insights that strengthen Moloco’s credibility with customers and the wider market.
  • Adapt your leadership and communication style to the audience and situation, using expertise and sound judgment to build trust, navigate disagreement, and secure commitment to action without formal management authority.

How Do I Know if the Role Is Right for Me?

Experience & Expertise

  • 10+ years of experience in mobile advertising, account management, consultative sales, or commercial leadership.
  • A proven track record of owning and growing some of an organisation’s largest and most strategically important accounts, navigating complex customer relationships and delivering substantial, sustained revenue growth.
  • Experience leading complex commercial negotiations and structuring agreements around customer business objectives.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted executive relationships and influence strategic investment decisions.
  • Deep understanding of the mobile advertising ecosystem, mobile measurement partners (MMPs), attribution, and programmatic performance marketing.
  • Evidence of improving commercial outcomes beyond your own accounts through coaching, co-selling, or cross-functional leadership.
  • Fluency in English (Turkish a strong plus).

Skills & Mindset

  • Exceptional commercial judgment and the ability to understand how customers make money, assess opportunities, and make disciplined trade-offs.
  • Strong product and analytical fluency, with the ability to connect technical capabilities and performance data to business value.
  • Executive presence and clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to simplify complex issues for senior audiences.
  • High ownership and resilience, with the ability to sustain momentum through long commercial cycles and changing priorities.
  • Comfort operating autonomously in ambiguous situations, creating clarity and mobilizing others around a shared outcome.
  • A collaborative, low-ego approach, with a commitment to learning, sharing credit, and developing others.

Supporting Your Best Work and Your Best Life:

Our benefits are designed to support our people in doing their best work and living well, at work and beyond. Benefits vary by country, employment type, and eligibility. Connect with a recruiter to learn more about benefits in your region.

Moloco Values: 

  • Lead with Humility: Everyone’s voice is respected, valued, and heard. We win, lose, and learn together. Accountability and feedback are essential to our success. 
  • Uncapped Growth Mindset: We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what’s possible. 
  • Create Real Value: We pursue the most impactful opportunities with intensity and rigor. We take intelligent risks and make disciplined trade-offs to maintain deep focus. We help our customers win by delivering durable value. 
  • Go Further Together: We’re one team working towards one vision. We collaborate proactively and inclusively, involving the right people at the right time and in the right way. We strive to create a more equitable workplace. We won’t let each other fail. 

Additional Resources: 

  • Moloco Company Blog 
  • Moloco Leadership
  • Moloco Newsroom

What is The Role :

This position offers the opportunity to work on meaningful projects that directly impact our security posture and collaborate with a skilled team passionate about information security.   In more details: We ingest the security telemetry that the whole security org runs on. In this role you'll get that telemetry into Elasticsearch consistently and keep the underlying Elastic clusters healthy. You own the pipeline end to end: from a new security data source landing, through ingest pipelines, into the indices detection, IR, and consulting teams query, plus the clusters that store it all. 

What You Will Be Doing :

  • Security telemetry ingestion - build and maintain ingestion of security-relevant data into Elasticsearch (cloud provider audit logs, identity/SaaS activity, endpoint and asset data). This means integrating with third-party and cloud provider APIs to pull telemetry: auth, pagination, rate limits, and handling schema changes. Both Elastic integrations and one-off custom integrations.
  • Keep the Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes clusters healthy. Monitor and upgrade them regularly. This involves updating versions and builds. Manage capacity and shards. Handle index lifecycle management (ILM). Enable cross-cluster search (CCS).
  • Use Terraform to manage cloud infrastructure and Elasticsearch resources. This includes managing pipelines, index templates, and alerts. Utilize Kubernetes and Helm to deploy scheduled ingest jobs.
  • Use AI automation and tooling to reduce toil. This includes self-healing jobs and health checks. It also involves alerting, internal CLIs, and AI or agent-assisted workflows for investigation and operations.
  • Data quality & reliability - Own the "is the security data actually flowing correctly?" question. Monitor backfills. Ensure that schemas and fields are consistent. Keep an eye on costs.

What You Bring :

  • Ability to operate Elastic and Elasticsearch in production. This includes managing ingest pipelines, index templates, mappings, and queries, while ensuring that clusters are healthy and upgraded. Experience with ECK or Elasticsearch on Kubernetes is strongly preferred.

  • Kubernetes - deploying and operating workloads (scheduled jobs, Helm charts, operators); troubleshooting pods/jobs in a cluster.
  • Terraform - managing cloud and Elasticsearch resources as code.
  • API integration - consuming REST APIs for data ingestion: authentication, pagination, rate limiting concurrency, and error handling.
  • Python scripting - able to read, write, and modify ingestion/automation scripts. Scripting-level, not full software-engineering depth.

Bonus Points :

  • Knowledge of GitHub, PR-based workflows, GitHub Actions and Continuous Integration (CI).
  • Knowledge of SOC operations and incident response (IR) workflows, including the use of security telemetry during investigations.

title: Senior Infrastructure Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.
  • Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.
  • Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.
  • Build Great Teams: We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work.
  • Raise the Bar: We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most.
  • Think Long-Term: We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.
 

About the Role

Lightning AI is seeking a Senior Infrastructure Software Engineer to join our Infrastructure Engineering team.

Our Infrastructure Engineering team builds the software systems that operate and manage Lightning AI’s large-scale GPU and bare-metal infrastructure. We develop services, APIs, tooling, and automation that bridge the gap between our physical infrastructure and the systems our customers depend on for AI/ML training, inference, and HPC workloads.

In this role, you will build production software and automation that support infrastructure throughout its lifecycle, from provisioning and bring-up through monitoring, maintenance, and decommissioning. You will design systems that enable engineers and software to interact programmatically with thousands of servers, storage systems, and high-performance networks, reducing manual operations and making infrastructure management more reliable, repeatable, and scalable.

This is a software-first infrastructure role that combines strong software engineering with Linux systems and hardware-aware infrastructure automation. You will work closely with teams across Infrastructure, Networking, Data Center Operations, and Platform Engineering to bring new capacity online and continuously improve how we operate our infrastructure at scale.

This role may be fully remote within the U.S., or hybrid out of one of our office hubs (NYC, SF, Seattle, or London), with occasional team and company offsites. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position at this time.

What You Will Do

Infrastructure Software & Automation

  • Design, build, and operate production services, APIs, tooling, and automation for managing large-scale bare-metal and GPU infrastructure
  • Build and extend software systems that support infrastructure provisioning, configuration, monitoring, and lifecycle management
  • Develop reliable automation that reduces manual operational work and improves the consistency and scalability of infrastructure management
  • Build tools and interfaces that enable engineers and other systems to interact programmatically with physical infrastructure

Provisioning & Lifecycle Management

  • Build and extend systems for server discovery, provisioning, configuration, validation, and lifecycle management
  • Automate infrastructure bring-up and capacity deployment across large fleets of compute systems
  • Integrate software and automation with hardware management and provisioning systems
  • Improve tooling and workflows for managing infrastructure throughout its production lifecycle

Reliability & Observability

  • Build telemetry, logging, and observability capabilities that provide visibility into the health of our infrastructure
  • Develop tools and automation to identify, diagnose, and respond to infrastructure and hardware issues
  • Translate recurring operational issues and hardware failure modes into improvements to software, tooling, and automation
  • Improve the reliability and scalability of infrastructure operations as the fleet grows

Architecture & Collaboration

  • Partner with Network, Infrastructure Operations, Data Center, Platform Engineering, and other teams to define requirements and build new infrastructure capabilities
  • Participate in architectural discussions and help define the technical direction of Lightning AI’s infrastructure software
  • Make pragmatic design decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity, and speed of execution
  • Write clear design documents and technical documentation and contribute to engineering best practices

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering, infrastructure engineering, or related experience
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production backend systems in Python or similar object-oriented programming languages
  • Strong experience with Linux in production environments
  • Experience building APIs, tooling, or automation for managing infrastructure at scale
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration concepts
  • Understanding of HPC and bare-metal infrastructure fundamentals, including provisioning and out-of-band management
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and make pragmatic architecture decisions while building for long-term reliability and scale
  • Experience working in a startup or other fast-paced environment with a high degree of ownership and autonomy

Ideal Experience

  • Experience with bare-metal hardware troubleshooting and provisioning, including technologies such as PXE/iPXE, BMC, Redfish, or IPMI, particularly with Dell hardware
  • Experience with GPU servers, either in bare-metal environments or under virtualization
  • Experience with network switches, routers, and firewalls, particularly SONiC switches, Palo Alto firewalls, or Juniper Networks
  • Experience with high-performance storage systems, particularly VAST
  • Experience supporting AI/ML or HPC infrastructure at scale

Compensation

We are committed to offering competitive compensation that reflects the value each team member brings to our mission. Final offers are based on factors such as experience, skills, geographic location, and role expectations. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package for eligible roles includes a discretionary bonus, a meaningful equity component, and comprehensive benefits.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is:$180,000—$220,000 USD

Benefits and Perks

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and long-term success:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents.
  • Meaningful Equity: RSUs that give employees a stake in the company's long-term success.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) matching (U.S.) and pension contributions (U.K.).
  • Flexible Time Off: Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and floating holidays to support work-life balance.
  • Company-Wide Winter Break: Two weeks of company closure each winter to disconnect and recharge.
  • Paid Parental & Family Leave: Paid leave to support you and your family through life's important moments.
  • Professional Development: Annual learning and development allowance to support your professional growth.
  • Wellness Benefits: Wellness and work-from-home stipends to support your physical and mental well-being.
  • Sabbatical Program: Four weeks of paid sabbatical leave after four years of service.
  • Flexible Work: Flexible schedules and a hybrid work model for our office-based teams.
  • In-Office Meals: Complimentary meals at our office hubs.

Benefits may vary by location, team, and role.

We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We are dedicated to building a culture where everyone can thrive and contribute to their fullest potential.

title: Senior Legal Counsel
descriptionHtml:
Legal Europe is a trusted partner to the business, playing a critical role in enabling commercial growth while managing legal and regulatory risk for our European trading businesses 

We're looking for an experienced financial markets lawyer who can operate as a trusted adviser to the business from day one. You’ll lead complex negotiations, advise senior stakeholders, and take ownership of significant legal matters in a fast-moving environment where your advice has direct commercial impact.

What you'll do 

As a Senior Legal Counsel, you will work closely with trading, compliance, risk, finance, operations and technology teams. You will support the businesses and trading desks covered by the Legal Europe team, including our European listed derivatives, commodities, and systematic trading businesses. The role is primarily focused on listed markets and market infrastructure. 

Proximity to trading is fundamental to the way we work. You will partner directly with traders and business leaders, developing a deep understanding of the products, markets, and commercial objectives of the desks you support. Experience advising on relevant trading products or market structures will be a significant advantage. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Leading legal support for key business initiatives and acting as the primary legal adviser to assigned trading desks. 
  • Advising traders and business stakeholders on legal issues arising from market making, exchange trading, listed derivatives, clearing and related market infrastructure. 
  • Challenging stakeholders where appropriate and helping shape commercial outcomes through clear, pragmatic legal advice. 
  • Drafting, reviewing and negotiating trading and commercial documentation, including: futures and options clearing agreements; prime brokerage agreements; execution, brokerage and market access agreements; exchange and market infrastructure documentation; market data, connectivity and trading technology agreements; and other commercial agreements supporting the trading business. 
  • Providing pragmatic advice on market structure, trading regulation, market conduct and legal risk affecting the European trading business. 
  • Working closely with our compliance and risk teams to develop practical solutions that appropriately balance business objectives and legal risk. 
  • Supporting strategic projects, including new market launches, legal entity expansions, and growth initiatives. 
  • Managing external counsel where specialist jurisdictional or product expertise is required. 
  • Developing scalable legal processes, templates, playbooks and technology-enabled solutions that improve the effectiveness of the legal function. 
  • Contributing to the continued development of Legal as a proactive, commercially focused business partner 

Who you are

  • Qualified lawyer in England & Wales.  
  • 8–15 years' post-qualification experience, with most of that experience focused on financial markets, derivatives, or trading.  
  • Experience within the markets legal function of an investment bank or other financial markets participant. Experience at a leading international law firm with a recognised financial markets, derivatives or trading practice is also desirable.  
  • Demonstrable experience advising trading businesses on legal and commercial issues. Experience advising on trading regulation as part of a broader markets legal practice is required, including close partnership with front-office trading businesses. 
  • Strong experience negotiating complex financial markets agreements, including execution agreements, brokerage agreements, exchange documentation, clearing documentation, market access arrangements, market data agreements, or other trading-related contracts.  
  • A strong understanding of financial market infrastructure, including exchanges, central counterparties, clearing brokers, and execution models.  
  • The judgement and confidence to lead negotiations independently, balance legal and commercial risk, and provide pragmatic advice without close supervision.  
  • Outstanding drafting, analytical and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal issues clearly to traders, technologists and senior management.  
  • Ability to manage multiple high priority matters simultaneously while exercising sound judgement in a fast-moving environment.  
  • Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding the products, strategies and markets that underpin Optiver's trading business. 
  • A collaborative, low-ego approach and a genuine enjoyment of working as part of a high-performing team. You build trusted relationships through sound judgement, responsiveness and high-quality execution, and are known for being approachable, pragmatic, and easy to work with. 

Nice to have 

  • Experience at a proprietary trading firm or market maker.  
  • Experience supporting algorithmic or electronic trading businesses.  
  • Familiarity with MiFID II, UK MiFIR and exchange rulebooks.  
  • Experience implementing scalable legal processes or legal technology.  
  • Experience supporting strategic business projects. 

Who we are

At Optiver, our mission is to constantly improve the market by injecting liquidity, providing accurate pricing, increasing transparency and acting as a stabilizing force no matter the market conditions. With a focus on continuous improvement, we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets for everyone who participates. As one of the largest market making institutions, we are a trusted partner of 70+ exchanges across the globe.

What you'll get

You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets. 

In addition, you’ll receive: 

  • A performance-based bonus structure, enabling all of our employees to benefit from our global profit pool. 
  • 27 paid vacation days plus all UK public holidays. 
  • Daily breakfast and lunch, along with support on commuting expenses. 
  • Private medical insurance, pension scheme, and ClassPass fitness membership. 
  • Training and continuous learning opportunities, including access to conferences and tech events. 
  • International transfer opportunities for global career growth

How to apply
Apply directly via the form below. If you have any questions feel free to contact our Recruitment team via our recruitment inquiry form.

title: Senior Lifecycle Manager
descriptionHtml:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The Role

Synthesia is growing fast, and lifecycle is how we turn that growth into lasting customer relationships, guiding every user from first signup to real value. Every month we send 150+ emails to 1+ million contacts, and as we launch new products and enter new markets, that scale and its impact on revenue will keep rising.

As Senior Lifecycle Manager, you’ll build one of the most exciting lifecycle programmes in Europe. You’ll own the product-led growth motion after signup: the journeys that turn new users into activated, paying and expanding customers. You’ll build automations triggered by what users do in the product and set the standard for how every customer-facing email Synthesia sends works together as one experience. You’ll partner with Product, Product Marketing and Data teams to build a lifecycle engine that grows with the company.

What You'll Do

  • Customer journeys: Design, build and optimise lifecycle journeys that support customers throughout their experience with Synthesia, from activation, adoption and engagement through to expansion, retention and winback.

  • Lifecycle automation: Own the end-to-end implementation of lifecycle programmes, from audience segmentation and behavioural triggers to workflow logic, suppression rules, QA and performance monitoring.

  • Experimentation: Develop and execute structured experiments to continuously improve lifecycle performance. Test messaging, timing, segmentation and journey design, analyse results and turn learnings into actionable improvements.

  • Data-driven personalisation: Leverage product usage, customer attributes and engagement signals to deliver increasingly relevant lifecycle experiences.

  • Lifecycle quality and deliverability: Own campaign QA and testing processes, support email deliverability and sender reputation and help establish best practices for segmentation, frequency management and customer experience.

  • AI-powered lifecycle: Explore and apply AI to make lifecycle marketing more effective and efficient. From content creation and dynamic personalisation to workflow automation, identify opportunities to improve both the customer experience and how we work.

We’d love to hear from you if you have

  • You deliver impact: You understand how lifecycle marketing contributes to activation, adoption, retention and revenue, and you can demonstrate measurable results from programmes you’ve owned

  • You’re analytical and curious: You use data to understand performance, challenge assumptions and continuously improve what you build

  • You think in customer journeys: You look beyond individual emails to understand the customer experience, identify friction and create relevant, connected communications

  • You’re technically excellent: You’re confident building sophisticated automation, managing complex segmentation and working with customer and product data. You care about the details that make programmes effective and reliable

  • You take ownership: You’re comfortable independently leading initiatives from concept through execution, proactively solving problems and making informed decisions

  • You collaborate naturally: You know how to work across functions, build strong relationships and move complex projects forward without direct authority

  • You care about quality: From deliverability and data accuracy to messaging and customer experience, you hold your work to a high standard

  • You’re excited about AI: You actively explore how emerging technologies can improve personalisation, experimentation and the way lifecycle marketing operates

We’d be particularly excited if

  • 6+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM or email marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or product-led companies

  • Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot, including complex workflows, list building, segmentation and campaign execution

  • Proven experience building and optimising always-on automated programmes, including onboarding, nurture and re-engagement, alongside one-off campaigns

  • Experience owning lifecycle initiatives end to end, from briefing and journey design to implementation, QA, reporting and optimisation

  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using product, CRM and engagement data to build audiences, evaluate performance and run structured experiments

  • Practical experience using AI to improve lifecycle execution, operational efficiency or customer personalisation

  • Working knowledge of email deliverability, including SPF, DKIM and DMARC, and privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA/CPRA

  • Proven ability to manage complex cross-functional projects and influence stakeholders across different teams

Nice to have

  • Experience with customer data platforms

  • Experience with Salesforce, particularly connecting CRM and account data to lifecycle programmes

  • Experience with in-product messaging and multichannel lifecycle journeys

  • SQL skills for self-serve behavioural analysis and insights

Compensation

We offer a competitive salary, equity and benefits. Your offer will reflect your experience, skills and the scope of the role. The range for this position is £70,000 - £90,000 GBP, and we are open to discussing where you land within it, or beyond it, for exceptional experience.

You will independently own and execute the machine learning strategy for major product capabilities—such as Search, Retrieval, Ranking, or Content AI—that power how millions of users discover and plan their travel itineraries.

This Senior Machine Learning Scientist role bridges the gap between state-of-the-art (SOTA) research and robust, production-grade engineering. You will navigate technical ambiguity, implement custom algorithmic components, and explicitly map offline model metrics directly to business KPIs like booking conversion and user engagement. If you are a relentlessly curious scientist who excels at rapid prototyping, practical SOTA deployment, and multiplying the capabilities of your peers, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Leadership & Custom Implementation: Act as the technical lead for specific ML projects within your pod. Design and implement custom model components or loss functions that don't exist "off-the-shelf," breaking down massive research goals into deliverable, iterative milestones.
  • Optimization & SOTA Scouting: Evaluate the global research landscape to conduct cost-benefit analyses on new architectures, balancing model complexity against inference speed, memory usage, and execution costs (such as token consumption). Optimize models for production using techniques like quantization and distillation.
  • Operational Frameworks & Rigor: Tailor Golden Datasets and leaderboards with minimal supervision, and implement rigorous validation automation (such as backtesting and slice-based evaluation) to prevent data leakage, over-fitting, and production regressions.
  • Engineering Partnership & Handovers: Collaborate closely with Engineering Leads to ensure compute/GPU infrastructure supports model requirements. Clearly define model failure modes, edge cases, and confidence thresholds—to enable SWE partners to build robust fallback systems.
  • Applied Debugging & Guardrails: Diagnose complex algorithmic bugs and implement automated checks for "Silent Failures" (e.g., concept drift or production feature distribution shifts). Lead team-level post-mortems and resolve blocking corrective actions.
  • Career Multiplier: Formally mentor mid-level and associate ML scientists, reviewing their experimental logic to ensure high scientific rigor while guiding them through applied ML and production constraints.

Skills & Experience

  • Education: Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a highly quantitative field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of industry experience developing, validating, and deploying large-scale ML models in production environments.
  • Algorithmic Expertise: Strong practical and theoretical foundation in machine learning techniques, feature engineering, and deep learning paradigms.
  • SOTA Adaptability: Proven ability to tweak, hybridize, and adapt existing state-of-the-art architectures to solve non-linear business problems. Experience with multi-task learning (MTL), ranking, Content AI stacks, Agentic AI etc is highly desirable.
  • Technical Stack: Mastery of Python and deep learning frameworks (such as PyTorch, PyTorch Lightning, or TensorFlow) alongside familiarity with data versioning and experiment tracking tools.

Desired

  • Next-generation retrieval pipelines, multi-stage ranking systems and Content AI stacks.
  • Advanced sequential recommendation systems designed to model real-time user session dynamics.
  • Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), knowledge graphs, and multi-modal representation learning to map travel entities.
  • Generative AI and Agentic AI workflows to improve conversational discovery experiences.

What We Offer 

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars:

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us. 

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges. 

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

title: Senior Manager, CRM Marketing, Europe
descriptionHtml:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

Crunchyroll is seeking a Senior Manager, CRM Marketing to lead localized CRM engagement for our European markets, one of our fastest-growing regions. Based in London, this role will own the CRM campaign calendar for the region, balancing high-velocity title moments and catalog beats while bringing our biggest anime moments to life across owned channels.

You will plan and execute high-impact, fan-first campaigns that support title launches and catalog discovery—including new season/series drops, dub drops, mid-season arcs, and finales for top-tier titles. Success in this role requires strong segmentation and analytical judgment, plus the ability to translate IP into messaging that creates an emotional connection with fans.

You’ll also act as a subject matter expert for the Europe market, championing transcreation and locally resonant storytelling (not just translation), cultural nuance, and fan-first engagement. You’ll partner closely with our global Lifecycle Marketing team that owns always-on lifecycle journeys; in this role, you will serve as a regional advisor and ensure key title moments and local insights are reflected in the broader lifecycle strategy.

What You’ll Do

  • CRM Campaign Calendar Ownership: Own the CRM campaign calendar for Europe across tentpole releases, seasonal beats, and catalog programming, aligning timing, targeting strategy, and channel plans with local and global priorities (across multiple markets, languages, and time zones).
  • Go-to-Market Campaigns: Collaborate with regional marketing, brand, programming, and curation teams to design localized go-to-market moments for major content launches, seasonal events, partnerships, and fan activations.
  • Segmentation & Audience Strategy: Apply best practices in personalization and segmentation to build targeted campaigns informed by fan behavior, affinities, regional nuances, and language/dub preferences. Partner with Data Science and Growth teams to refine audience definitions, identify opportunities, and improve precision over time.
  • Regional Market Expertise: Serve as Crunchyroll’s CRM market lead for Europe, advising on cultural nuances, local market behaviors, local platform norms, channel norms, and fan engagement opportunities.
  • Localized Lifecycle Strategy: Provide regional inputs into Europe lifecycle journey strategies across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and winback, working closely with our Lifecycle Marketing team. Ensure best practices in personalization, segmentation, and lifecycle orchestration.
  • Marketing Technology Ownership: Lead campaign execution and performance optimization in partnership with Operations, Martech, and Data Analytics; manage CRM initiatives within Braze (or similar) across email, push, in-app, notification center, and relevant messaging channels, ensuring excellence in configuration, QA, measurement, and reporting. Own content-triggered messaging strategy that supports title moments and engagement in alignment with lifecycle standards and guardrails.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work with Regional Marketing, Product, Brand, Content, Creative, Data Science, and GTM teams to create cohesive fan experiences and ensure lifecycle campaigns align with both local and global priorities.
  • Performance & Optimization: Analyze CRM campaign performance, identify opportunities, and apply insights to continuously improve effectiveness and fan impact through test-and-learn approaches, including cohort analysis and incrementality-minded measurement.
  • Innovation & Experimentation: Stay ahead of market dynamics and messaging ecosystems (multilingual markets, consent and preference management, deliverability best practices, local payment behaviors, and evolving platform changes across iOS/Android) to evolve CRM campaign strategy and execution.

About You

  • 8+ years of experience in CRM, retention, or subscriber engagement marketing, ideally within streaming, digital subscription, gaming, e-commerce, or entertainment.
  • Strong experience with Braze (or comparable orchestration platforms) with a focus on campaign planning/execution, segmentation, triggers, and multi-channel delivery.
  • Deep knowledge of European consumer behaviors, digital marketing platforms, and messaging ecosystems (including WhatsApp where applicable), with experience operating in privacy-first environments.
  • Strong creative acumen and storytelling ability—capable of translating IP into fan-first messaging that builds emotional connection and drives action.
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret performance data, develop insights, and translate them into targeting and creative optimizations.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across regional and global teams in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
  • Passion for anime, entertainment, or fan-first brands is highly valued. 
  • Additional proficiency in relevant regional languages is a plus.

About the Team

The Lifecycle Marketing team curates personalized journeys that strengthen fan loyalty and lifetime value. With data-driven insights and fan-first creativity, we connect users to the right experiences at the right moments across owned channels.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

  • Best-in class medical, dental, and vision private insurance healthcare coverage
  • Access to counseling & mental health sessions 24/7 through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Employer 5% salary contribution into a DC Pension Plan

title: Senior Manager, Customer Support, Deliveroo Operations
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Why Deliveroo?

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders to bring the neighbourhood to their door. We're redefining convenience by giving customers the ability to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

Deliveroo is a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the world's most dynamic industries. We are a relatively small team making a very large impact, moving fast, valuing ownership, and tackling some of the most interesting challenges in global commerce. We're driven by innovation, autonomy, and the ambition to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers, partners, and riders alike.

What You'll Be Doing

You will own frontline operational performance across two closely linked parts of Deliveroo's customer support network: an in-house Global Escalations team of around 50 agents based across the UK and Georgia, and the outsourced network delivering support on our behalf through three BPO partners and three Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents across multiple locations, including the team leads and ops managers embedded within those outsourced functions.

Global Escalations sits at the heart of Deliveroo's most critical customer moments. The team manages our most sensitive, high-risk, and high-impact contacts, including complaints escalated to the Executive team. As the leader directly accountable for this recovery-focused centre of excellence, you will ensure the team operates with exceptional skill, judgement, and empathy, protecting Deliveroo's reputation, driving improvement through root cause analysis, and embedding a culture of integrity and customer-first recovery across the organisation.

For the outsourced network, you own how performance is delivered day to day, working closely with the team leads and ops managers embedded in each BPO and Shared Service Centre, not just the vendor relationship at arm's length. You own the operational rigour needed to make the network the best in class, from an experience and consistency perspective, across every market it supports.

Your key objective is to drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, measured through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like average handling time (AHT) and refund costs, rather than trading one off against the other. You will be the voice of Support to Deliveroo's market General Managers, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets, and you will partner closely with cross-functional Support & Operations teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that positively impact all three sides of the marketplace: customers, riders, and merchants.

You Will…

  • Own frontline operational performance delivered through the in-house Global Escalations team (UK and Georgia) and the outsourced network (3 BPOs, 3 Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents), including the team leads and ops managers within those outsourced functions
  • Lead and develop the Global Escalations team directly, managing our most sensitive and reputation-critical contacts with judgement, empathy, and rigorous root cause analysis
  • Drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, tracked through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like AHT and refund costs
  • Act as the voice of Support to Deliveroo market GMs, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets and representing their priorities back into the function
  • Partner with Support & Operations cross-functional teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that improve the experience for customers, riders, and merchants
  • Design and run performance frameworks that hold BPO and SSC team leads and ops managers accountable for quality, SLA adherence, and CSAT, fostering a culture of partnership rather than pure oversight
  • Standardise processes and playbooks across outsourced partners and sites where it drives consistency, while respecting genuine market and site-specific differences
  • Diagnose and help bring down attrition and quality issues across the outsourced network, working with BPO and SSC leadership on the retention, engagement, and workforce planning changes needed
  • Partner with Product and Technology to shape the roadmap for customer support systems and channel strategy, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency and automation across both in-house and outsourced teams
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across HR, Legal, and Policy to ensure service delivery evolves in line with business priorities
  • Drive data-informed improvement through analysis of contact drivers, escalation themes, and customer sentiment, translating insight into action for both Global Escalations and the outsourced network
  • Represent the function at relevant Weekly Business Reviews and senior forums, providing visibility on performance, risk, and recovery across both the in-house team and the outsourced network
  • Participate in the 24/7 Leadership Team on-call rota
  • Shape functional strategy and set OKRs for contact centre Support across Deliveroo markets, growing the remit from directing your own team to leading leaders, in line with DoorDash's Team Management career framework
  • Grow and develop the managers and leaders within your network, including Team Leads inside Global Escalations and the team leads and ops managers at each BPO and Shared Service Centre, building the next generation of people leaders

Skills & Experience You'll Need

  • Extensive contact centre, BPO, or shared service centre leadership experience in a fast-paced, consumer-facing environment
  • Proven experience managing outsourced or vendor relationships at scale, including the team lead and ops manager layer embedded within partner organisations, not just the commercial relationship
  • Experience leading escalations or complaint handling in a reputation-sensitive environment, with strong judgement and the ability to drive recovery from the most sensitive customer moments
  • A track record of bringing consistency and governance across multiple outsourced partners while respecting genuine local and market differences
  • Experience diagnosing and reducing attrition while improving quality, in a large-scale, multi-site support operation
  • A data-driven approach to balancing customer experience (CSAT) against cost metrics such as AHT and refund rate, without trading one off blindly against the other
  • Experience representing a support or operations function to senior commercial stakeholders, such as General Managers or market leadership, taking full accountability for their experience of the function
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy to drive improvements across a multi-sided marketplace
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work cross-functionally with Product, Legal, Policy, and People teams
  • Strong analytical ability, comfortable turning contact driver, escalation, and sentiment data into action
  • Strong people leadership skills, with experience building and developing a dispersed in-house team and driving performance indirectly through partner leadership
  • A self-starter mindset, a can-do attitude, and willingness to be hands-on in a fast-moving, multi-geography environment
  • Proven strategic mindset with a track record of shaping and executing operational strategies across multiple markets and vendors
  • Deep operational understanding, including customer service design, vendor management, and process optimisation
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver results in high-volume, complex environments with multiple priorities
  • Experience partnering with Product and Tech to drive tooling, system, and automation improvements
  • A mindset focused on continuous improvement, customer advocacy, and operational excellence
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at a 'leads leaders' level per DoorDash's Levels and Expectations framework (Team Management track): shaping strategy and OKRs beyond your own team, and developing managers who in turn develop their own teams
  • Meets the senior people-leadership bar DoorDash expects at this level: effectively leads a high-performing team, fosters a culture of belonging and engagement, and takes full accountability for the people outcomes of a large, dispersed organisation

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

descriptionHtml:

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

You will establish Legora's first local People Advisory layer, building the team and its capability from the ground up. Reporting to the Director of People Operations, you will define market coverage, lead hiring and onboarding, and develop a distributed team of People Advisors. Your team will provide practical local advice, handle casework and build managers' confidence in handling people matters.

You will establish an AI-first way of working across Advisory: simplifying processes, turning local knowledge into reusable guidance, and using AI to improve preparation, documentation and access to advice.

You will partner with Employee Relations & Compliance on jurisdictional standards, certification and sensitive casework; People Business Partners on local business needs; and People Operations on service delivery. With People Tech & Data, you will turn requirements into reliable tools and workflows for employees and managers.


What you'll own

  • Team build and capability. Establish the Advisory team from the ground up. Coach Advisors towards independent delivery, setting clear expectations for service and judgement.

  • Local advisory delivery. Build a trusted, visible People presence in each market, with Advisors who understand local business needs and build strong relationships with employees and managers.

  • Manager enablement. Equip Advisors to coach managers through people matters. Turn recurring questions into practical guidance and AI-supported resources, equipping managers to take ownership of their decisions.

  • Local policy and process. Close gaps in local policies, playbooks and processes with the relevant owners. Keep guidance current and usable, securing Employee Relations & Compliance approval where required.

  • Jurisdictional readiness. Partner with Employee Relations & Compliance on Advisor certification, training and calibration, addressing gaps in capability and casework quality early.

  • Partnership with People Operations. Give Specialists clear local guidance and escalation routes. Partner on self-service content and workflows so routine requests resolve quickly and judgement-based matters reach Advisors.

  • Local delivery. Coordinate Advisor support for people programs, organisational changes and new markets with People Business Partners, People Programs and Market Expansion.

  • Performance and insights. Use case reviews, service data and feedback to improve quality, response times and manager experience. Share emerging risks and measure the impact of AI and process improvements.


What you'll bring

  • 7+ years in HR generalist, People Advisory or operational HR roles, including leading a team across markets in a growing international company.

  • Strong experience of coaching and advising managers, challenging constructively and overseeing probation, performance and absence cases, with clear judgement on when specialist support is needed.

  • Knowledge of employment practices across multiple jurisdictions, and the ability to work effectively with local experts.

  • A track record of building local HR capability and closing policy and process gaps with practical, usable guidance.

  • Practical experience applying AI to advisory work, knowledge management or case administration, with the ability to test outputs, drive adoption and demonstrate improvements.

  • Comfort working in a tiered People model, with clear boundaries between operations, local advisory, People Business Partners and specialist teams.

  • A hands-on leadership style, strong stakeholder relationships and a high bar for documentation, confidentiality and the quality of advice.

  • Fluency in English, which is our working language.

Why this role

People Advisory brings local expertise closer to the employees and managers who need it, helping the business move fast with confidence. You will build that capability from the ground up: hiring and developing trusted Advisors across our markets, combining local judgement with consistent standards, and using AI to make expertise easier to access. It’s an opportunity to shape a new team at one of the most exciting companies in tech and set the standard for how local people support scales globally.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

Role Overview

Airwallex is seeking highly skilled Sanctions Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our second line of defense (2LoD) Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) team. To support our global operations and ensure nuanced, localized oversight, we are looking for dedicated, in-region sanctions specialists across EMEA/UK.

In this role, you will act as the ultimate regional escalation point for L3 sanctions alerts to advise on complicated sanctions matches, drive sanctions investigations and efficacy of sanctions screening, determine potential reporting obligations, and assist in scaling a global sanctions program. This role requires a strategic thinker who can seamlessly translate complex regional regulatory changes into practical, scalable control enhancements across the business and multiple geographies.

Responsibilities

  • Act as an in-region Sanctions Subject Matter Expert (SME) and serve as the second-line escalation point for highly complex, ambiguous sanctions matches, special investigations, and potential block-and-reject.

  • Own L3 Sanctions case investigation and decisioning regionally, assessing applicable reporting, disclosure, and recordkeeping obligations.

  • Provide practical, timely, and risk-based sanctions advice on complex cross-border payment flows, indirect exposure, jurisdictional conflicts, new products and services, customer segments, commercial transactions, and geographic expansion.

  • Own and maintain regional Sanctions operational procedures and provide effective second-line oversight of sanctions controls implemented by first-line teams, ensuring alignment with the Global Sanctions Policy while incorporating applicable local requirements.

  • Liaise with global teams to provide actionable feedback on product-specific controls and screening technologies, leveraging in-region expertise and historical L3 escalations to ensure continuous optimization and alignment with the organization’s risk appetite.

  • Monitor US, regional, and international sanctions and export-control developments, geopolitical events, and regulatory expectations, assessing their impact on customers, products, jurisdictions, lists, systems, procedures, and risk appetite.

  • Develop and deliver targeted training and ongoing guidance for L2 sanctions reviewers, KYC, Operations, and other stakeholders on sanctions risk, alert adjudication, investigative research, discounting criteria, escalation standards, and documentation requirements.

  • Lead responses to banking partners and other external stakeholders on sanctions-related inquiries and due diligence reviews.

Qualifications

  • 7-10 years of relevant experience, preferably at a fintech, payments company, or large financial institution specializing in sanctions.

  • Experience managing sanctions alerts at the L3 level, recommending blocking/freezing transactions, assessing sanctions-related licenses and respective transactional permissibility, and managing reporting.

  • History of assessing current sanctions frameworks and recommending enhancements to strengthen the program, including designing and scaling sanctions programs.

  • Demonstrated understanding of in-region sanctions regulations and industry best practices pertaining to economic sanctions; knowledge of US sanctions in addition to in-region expertise is strongly preferred.

  • History of executing the operationalization of sanctions controls in collaboration with technological teams, adhering to global policies, in-region procedures, and risk appetite.

  • A history of interacting or supporting engagement with external stakeholders such as regulators or financial institution partners on sanctions matters.

  • Expert knowledge of financial and trade sanctions within the European Union (EU) framework and UK regulations administered by the Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) and corresponding export control bodies.

  • Strong understanding of the EU/UK Blocking Statute and how to navigate conflicting regulatory obligations within European jurisdictions and the UK.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
