title: Senior Marketing Manager- Burson
descriptionHtml:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially minded Senior Marketing Manager to help Burson drive visibility, relevance and connection to the clients and prospects we most want to work with.

Sitting at the heart of the UK Growth Team, this is a high-profile role working closely with the Chief Growth Officer and senior leaders across the business. You will help further Burson’s momentum in the UK having been named Cannes Lions Agency of the year 2026, turning our best thinking, expertise, people and client work into marketing that builds our reputation, creates demand and opens doors.

You will be responsible for growing Burson's reputation and visibility in the market, strengthening engagement with priority audiences and building marketing programmes that support our growth ambitions across all areas of our business.

We are looking for someone with ideas, energy and excellent judgement. Someone who understands what makes senior decision-makers pay attention, knows how to turn complex expertise into compelling stories and can mobilise a busy organisation behind a great idea.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and deliver a focused UK marketing strategy that builds brand awareness, distinctiveness and demand, aligned with business and growth priorities.
  • Strengthen Burson’s profile among priority clients, prospects, industry influencers, business leaders and future talent, positioning us as a modern strategic advisory partner.
  • Build a distinctive thought leadership and editorial programme, turning our expertise, insights, data and senior counsel into timely and compelling content across multiple channels.
  • Identify key moments across the business, media and cultural agenda where Burson can lead the conversation, mobilising experts and building the external profiles of senior leaders.
  • Create an engaging events and experiences programme, including briefings, roundtables, webinars and partnerships that deepen relationships with clients and prospects.
  • Showcase Burson’s best work through case studies, credentials, awards and external storytelling, increasing visibility and recognition for our people, expertise and client impact.
  • Build a modern, high-performing marketing engine, using AI, automation, media intelligence, data and measurement to make marketing faster, smarter and more effective.
  • Partner closely with UK leadership, Growth, practices, capabilities and the EMEA Marketing Team to maximise commercial impact, amplify regional and global programmes, and share the best of Burson UK across the wider network.

Experience that contributes to success:

We're looking for an ambitious marketer who combines the instincts of amarketer, editor and connector, and who likes making things happen.

You'll bring:

  • A strong track record in B2B or professional-services marketing, ideally within strategic communications, consulting, creative, technology or another expertise-led business.
  • Evidence that you have helped build a brand, audience or market position, rather than simply managed marketing activity.
  • Experience developing and delivering high-impact thought leadership, content and integrated marketing programmes.
  • Excellent editorial judgement. You know what makes an interesting point of view, what will engage an external audience and what won't.
  • Outstanding writing and storytelling skills, with an ability to turn complex ideas into clear, engaging narratives.
  • Commercial instinct and an understanding of the relationship between reputation, relationships, marketing and new business.
  • Confidence working with senior leaders, including the ability to advise, influence and challenge constructively.
  • A strong understanding of AI-enabled marketing, together with curiosity about how emerging technology can improve insight, creativity, personalisation, productivity and measurement.
  • Strong knowledge of the communications, marketing and wider business landscape, with a natural curiosity about what's happening in the world.
  • A proactive approach to building external relationships with industry influencers, partners, media stakeholders and senior decision-makers.
  • A bias for action. You spot opportunities, bring ideas and make them happen.
  • High standards and exceptional attention to detail, without allowing perfection to get in the way of momentum.
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to bring people together across Growth, practices, capabilities, creative teams and regional marketing colleagues.

What success looks like

You will help create a Burson UK that feelsimpossible to ignore: sharper in the market, faster into important conversations and better at turning our expertise into reputation, relationships and growth.

Success will mean:

  • greater visibility and distinctiveness for Burson amongst priority audiences;
  • stronger engagement with the clients and prospects we most want to reach;
  • a recognisable and consistent flow of distinctive Burson attitude, thinking and expertise into the market;
  • greater visibility for our senior experts and our best client work;
  • marketing programmes, content and experiences that create meaningful conversations and support growth; and
  • a faster, smarter and more measurable marketing operation.

This is an opportunity to help shape not simply how Burson markets itself in the UK, but how the market sees Burson and what we are capable of.

#LI-CY1

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

title: Senior Marketing Manager, Integrated Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Global Campaign Ownership: Lead high-profile global marketing programmes and integrated campaigns from global strategy through to local market execution.

  • Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals.

  • Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics.

  • Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation.

  • Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority.

  • Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy.

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact.

Nice to Have

  • Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments.

  • Background working across international or multi-market structures.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: (Senior) Marketing Manager mit Entwicklungsperspektive (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Marketing von A bis Z. Verantwortung übernehmen. Gemeinsam etwas bewegen.

Vom Newsletter über die Website bis zum gebrandeten Kugelschreiber. Von der Versandaktion bis zur eigenen Messe mit über 3.000 Besuchern und mehr als 180 Ausstellern: Bei uns entsteht Marketing von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung im eigenen Team.

Du hast Lust auf genau diese Vielfalt? Du denkst strategisch, packst operativ mit an und möchtest nicht nur Konzepte entwickeln, sondern selbst etwas bewegen?

Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Als (Senior) Marketing Manager (m/w/d) gestaltest Du unsere externe Kommunikation und Markenpräsenz aktiv mit. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt im E-Mail-Marketing, der zielgruppengerechten Kommunikation sowie der Weiterentwicklung unserer CRM- und Marketing-Automation-Prozesse.

Dabei übernimmst Du Verantwortung, triffst Entscheidungen und setzt Projekte eigenständig um. Gemeinsam im Team entwickelst Du unser Marketing weiter, mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und der Perspektive, langfristig noch mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Deine Aufgaben

Von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung – bei uns bist Du mittendrin.

  • E-Mail-Marketing: Eigenverantwortliche Konzeption, Gestaltung, Umsetzung und Optimierung unserer Newsletter und zielgruppenspezifischen E-Mail-Kampagnen

  • Externe Kommunikation: Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Markenkommunikation über Websites, Social Media, Printmedien und weitere Kanäle hinweg

  • HubSpot & Marketing-Automation: Aktive Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unseres CRM-Systems, Aufbau automatisierter Workflows, Zielgruppensegmentierung und Optimierung digitaler Prozesse

  • Kampagnen & Projekte: Eigenständige Planung, Steuerung und operative Umsetzung vielfältiger Marketingmaßnahmen – von digitalen Kampagnen über Versandaktionen bis hin zu klassischen Werbemitteln

  • Content & Design: Erstellung überzeugender Inhalte sowie Gestaltung von Grafiken, Präsentationen und Kommunikationsmitteln mit der Adobe Creative Cloud

  • Eventmarketing: Aktive Mitgestaltung unseres unitex-FashionFestivals – von der Vermarktung und Ausstellerkommunikation bis zur Koordination und Umsetzung einer Messe

  • Analyse & Optimierung: Auswertung relevanter KPIs, Identifikation von Potenzialen und Umsetzung konkreter Verbesserungen

  • Weiterentwicklung: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Marketingleitung, Einbringen eigener Ideen und schrittweise Übernahme übergreifender Verantwortung

Das bringst Du mit

Du denkst mit, packst an und bringst Dinge ins Ziel.

  • Fundierte Praxiserfahrung im Marketing – ob durch Studium, Ausbildung oder einen anderen beruflichen Weg. Entscheidend ist, was Du kannst und daraus machst.

  • Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing und ein gutes Verständnis für zielgruppengerechte externe Kommunikation

  • Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise HubSpot, sowie Begeisterung für Marketing-Automation und digitale Prozesse

  • Ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung, Sprache und zielgruppengerechte Inhalte sowie die Bereitschaft, Dich in neue Tools einzuarbeiten

  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, Organisationstalent und Entscheidungsfreude

  • Echte Hands-on-Mentalität: Du kannst große Projekte koordinieren, hast aber genauso Freude daran, selbst ins Detail zu gehen und Dinge umzusetzen.

  • Eigeninitiative, Teamgeist und Lust auf ein vielseitiges Marketingumfeld, in dem nicht jeder Tag gleich aussieht

  • Motivation, Dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln und perspektivisch zusätzliche Verantwortung zu übernehmen

Das erwartet Dich bei uns

Vielseitigkeit statt Schubladendenken. Gestaltungsspielraum statt langer Abstimmungswege.

  • Marketing in seiner ganzen Bandbreite: Bei uns wird nicht nur geplant oder an Agenturen delegiert. Wir entwickeln, gestalten, organisieren und realisieren unsere Marketingmaßnahmen selbst – digital, analog und live.

  • Verantwortung von Anfang an: Du betreust eigene Projekte, bringst Ideen ein und hast die Freiheit, Entscheidungen zu treffen und Dinge voranzubringen.

  • Projekte mit echter Sichtbarkeit: Von unseren regelmäßigen Newslettern und dem unitex-FashionBook bis zum unitex-FashionFestival mit mehreren Tausend Besuchern.

  • Raum zum Wachsen: Du arbeitest eng mit der Marketingleitung zusammen und kannst schrittweise mehr übergreifende und koordinierende Verantwortung übernehmen.

  • Kurze Wege, starkes Team: Wir arbeiten eng zusammen, unterstützen uns gegenseitig und setzen lieber um, statt Ideen endlos zu diskutieren.

  • Spannendes Branchenumfeld: Du gestaltest die Kommunikation der führenden Verbundgruppen im Modehandel aktiv mit.

Klingt nach Deiner nächsten Herausforderung?

Du möchtest Marketing nicht nur begleiten, sondern von A bis Z mitgestalten? Du hast Ideen, übernimmst Verantwortung und hast Lust, gemeinsam mit uns etwas zu bewegen?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

Nicht nur mitdenken. Mitmachen. Mitgestalten.

title: (Senior) Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle

Unsere Kunden lernen uns meist persönlich kennen: auf sechs bis neun eigenen Events im Jahr, die meisten davon in München. Dazu gehört das Commerce Impact Forum, bei dem Geschäftsführer und CIOs aus Handel und Industrie zusammenkommen. Außerdem Webinare, Messen und unsere Inhalte auf LinkedIn und im Blog. Als (Senior) Marketing Manager planst du das mit der Geschäftsführung, setzt es selbst um und sorgst dafür, dass aus Teilnehmern Gespräche werden.

Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und hast viel Raum, Prozesse und Formate selbst aufzubauen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du planst mit der Geschäftsführung, welche Events, Webinare und Messen wir im Jahr machen, und setzt sie um, bei Bedarf mit Unterstützung aus dem Team.
  • Du bist am Puls der Zeit: Du verfolgst, was in der Branche passiert, und bekommst Input aus dem Team, der Geschäftsführung und Projektleitung. Daraus machst du Inhalte und verantwortest dafür alle unsere Kanäle, etwa LinkedIn für das Unternehmen und die Geschäftsführung, Blog, Newsletter und Website, und alles, was künftig dazukommt.
  • Du verantwortest unsere Marketing- und Outreach-Prozesse: wie wir Kontakte gewinnen, im Blick behalten und an den Vertrieb übergeben, einschließlich der Automatisierung dahinter.
  • Du wertest aus, was funktioniert, und entwickelst unser Marketing mit neuen Formaten und Ideen weiter.
  • Du steuerst Agenturen und Freelancer, wenn wir sie für Design oder Produktion einsetzen.

Dein Profil

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder Beratung im Commerce- und Datenumfeld.
  • Erfahrung mit Marketing-Automation: Du hast Prozesse, Sequenzen und Workflows selbst aufgebaut, idealerweise in HubSpot.
  • Du schreibst sicher auf Deutsch für Entscheider und kannst in der Stimme anderer Personen schreiben. Dasselbe auf Englisch ist ein Plus.
  • Du hast Events oder Messeauftritte geplant und durchgeführt.
  • Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge selbstverständlich in deiner Arbeit.

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

title: Senior Platform Reliability Engineer, Fabric & Interconnection
descriptionHtml:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.  

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. 

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. 

AI FactoryOS Operations 

AI FactoryOS is Firmus' proprietary operating system for the AI Factory. It governs GPU telemetry, cooling, power and grid interaction as one integrated layer, so that every Firmus site can be optimised and monitored as a single system. 

AI FactoryOS Operations runs that platform in production and owns the 24/7 reliability of AI FactoryOS, Firmus AI Cloud and the platforms built on them, together with the service levels the estate is measured against. 

The remit is an engineering one. The function builds the guarded automation, remediation and operational tooling that turn manual response into a software-defined capability, and builds and operates the shared services the estate's own operation depends on. The function works closely with the engineering teams that build the platform, supplying the production evidence that shapes what they fix and what they build next. 

Role Summary  

Firmus runs large-scale, state-of-the-art AI infrastructure built on the latest generation of GPU rack-scale systems and operated as one estate to power the next generation of AI innovation. The Senior Platform Reliability Engineer, Fabric and Interconnect, owns the reliability of the fabrics this estate runs on: the GPU-to-GPU interconnect domains, the high-performance network fabrics carrying training and inference traffic, and the DPU-based host networking that binds compute to the rest of the platform. 

This is a hands-on senior role with deep technical expertise. Automation is a first-class part of the role: the team builds and maintains the guarded automation and remediation tooling that turn manual fabric response into a self-healing capability, and the role engages fabric vendors at engineering level, reproducing faults to their standard and holding them to their answers. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Responsible for the reliable operation, automation and continuous improvement of the estate's GPU interconnect and network fabrics (for example NVLink and NVSwitch domains, InfiniBand and Spectrum-X). 
  • Build and maintain the guarded automation and remediation tooling for fabric faults, contributing to the software-driven remediation of AI clusters, including fault isolation and fabric reconvergence. 
  • Diagnose and tune performance across the interconnect stack, from application collective communication down to link level, working with technologies including NVLink, InfiniBand, RoCE and congestion control tuning. 
  • Operate DPU-based host networking across the fleet, including offload path configuration and driver and firmware compatibility. 
  • Execute firmware upgrade waves, fabric expansions and capacity changes to the supported paths and scaling patterns defined by AI Infrastructure, owning the production window, the staged or canary path, verification against declared success criteria, and rollback execution. 
  • Provide the deepest technical expertise for fabric and interconnect faults, correlating a collective communication failure to a specific physical link and diagnosing the faults that require internals-level knowledge to root cause, and driving the permanent fix to closure through AI Infrastructure. 
  • Lead vendor escalations at engineering level, reproducing faults to the vendor's standard and pushing back credibly when a diagnosis does not explain the observed behaviour. 
  • Lead technical recovery during major fabric incidents, drive the changes that remove repeat causes, share the follow-the-sun on-call roster, and mentor the engineers who carry frontline diagnosis, documenting operational procedures, runbooks and performance results. 

Skills & Experience 

  • Strong skills in high-performance networking and systems engineering, with 8+ years of experience including substantial ownership of production network or interconnect infrastructure in a 24/7 environment. 
  • Deep operational experience with high-performance GPU interconnect fabrics (for example NVLink and NVSwitch), including domain topology and failure diagnosis. 
  • Extensive experience with high-performance networking fabrics (for example InfiniBand or RoCE-based Ethernet such as NVIDIA Spectrum-X), including routing internals and congestion control tuning. 
  • Experience with DPU or SmartNIC-based host networking, including offload paths and driver and firmware coordination. 
  • Experience planning and executing firmware upgrade waves and capacity expansions on production fabrics with defined rollback. 
  • Strong skills in infrastructure automation and infrastructure-as-code practices, with change delivered through peer review and progressive rollout. 
  • Practical experience with scripting or programming for operational automation and tooling, such as Python, Go or Bash. 
  • Proven ability to act as a senior escalation point in production, including major incident response, on-call participation, vendor escalation at engineering level, and the production of runbooks that others can execute successfully. 
  • Clear technical judgement and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex fabric failures to engineers and non-specialists. 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience operating fabrics for large-scale distributed training or inference workloads. 
  • Experience with NVIDIA rack-scale or multi-node GPU systems and their interconnect topology. 
  • Experience in a multi-tenant service provider, cloud or colocation environment. 
  • Knowledge of data centre and hardware fundamentals, including cabling and optics, firmware management and hardware fault workflows. 
  • Relevant vendor certification. 

Location & Reporting 

Location: Based in Australia or Singapore, with travel to Australian AI Factory sites as required. 

On-call: The function runs 24/7. First line monitoring and first response sit with the operations centre. This role shares the after-hours escalation roster for its domain with the other senior engineers in the function. 

Reporting to:  Reports to the Head of AI FactoryOS Operations while the function is being established, working under broad direction with a high degree of autonomy and direct access to the decision makers. As the function reaches its planned structure, the role will report to the Infrastructure Operations Manager, with the Head of AI FactoryOS Operations remaining accountable for the function. The scope, level and remit of the role do not change under either arrangement. 

Employment Basis

Permanent full-time

We're building the front door of UK healthcare, creating a future where one billion NHS appointments are transparent and instantly bookable, and patients are guided to the right service first time using AI.

We're developing critical national infrastructure. Today, 26% of GP practices in England use our patient registration software, while one in five GP practices in London use Bookable Search to help new patients find and book appointments seamlessly.

Our latest product, Bookable Navigator, extends this vision by automatically booking appointments for existing patients.

Notre mission ? Mettre à disposition des solutions de stockage pour l’ensemble de la Data Platform de Decathlon, tout en garantissant la gouvernance, robustesse et scalabilité par défaut. Véritable pilier de la gouvernance technique du patrimoine de données, notre équipe gère les métadonnées via le metastore Unity Catalog et les data contracts, permettant ainsi de construire une observabilité globale de la plateforme (usage, lignage, etc.). Un terrain de jeu technique à fort impact et aux défis d'envergure internationale !

L'équipe est composée actuellement de :

  • 1 Product Manager
  • 1 Data Architect
  • 1 Data Engineer
  • 1 Software Engineer
  • 2 Ops Engineer

Exemples de challenges actuels :

  • Améliorer notre offre de support pour faciliter le parcours utilisateur (documentation, gestion des incidents, ...)
  • Discussion avec les équipes Data/IA des pays et domaines sur leurs challenges du moment (données sensibles, données privées, ...) pour définir les priorités de nos équipes
  • Comment faciliter la gouvernance des données ? Par exemple intégrer des règles automatiques de validation des données, data contractualization, ...
  • Rationalisation de notre offre et décommissionnement du legacy

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

Notre ambition groupe, celle d’améliorer l’expérience digitale de nos clients, nous amène à une nouvelle approche orientée clients, une approche produit.

Le/La Product Manager de l'équipe Data Lake:

  • Acquiert une compréhension de son périmètre, de l'état de l’art sur le marché, du fonctionnement technique des outils associés.
  • Représente nos utilisateurs métiers, comprend leurs challenges et les retranscrit aux équipes techniques.
  • Accompagne la mise en œuvre de nouvelles fonctionnalités ou produits sur tout le cycle de vie (démo, formation, communication, documentation, …).


Tu seras garant·e de l'évolution et de la robustesse de ce produit critique pour l'ensemble des équipes Decathlon.

Tes missions principales s'articuleront autour des axes suivants :

  • Vision & Delivery : Tu pilotes le cycle complet du produit, de la Discovery à la coordination du Delivery en lien étroit avec le Leader. Tu traduis les enjeux business et techniques en une roadmap claire, priorisée et axée sur la valeur.

  • Projets Stratégiques : Tu lead l'End-of-Life (EOL) de notre Legacy, orchestres la migration vers la nouvelle infrastructure et designs les nouveaux espaces et fonctionnalités sur Unity Catalog.

  • Gouvernance & Excellence Opérationnelle : Tu assures la gouvernance fine du metastore, la gestion des droits d'accès et intègres au cœur de ta roadmap les enjeux de sécurité, de performance, de maintenance et de FinOps (optimisation des coûts cloud).

  • Leadership Fonctionnel & Synergies : Tu assures le management fonctionnel de l'équipe technique au quotidien et tu pourras être amené·e à animer un groupe transverse de PM sur des sujets communs afin de garantir l'alignement de notre vision produit globale.

  • Mesure de l'impact : Tu définis et suis les indicateurs clés de réussite focalisés sur la fiabilité, la robustesse de la plateforme et la mesure précise de l'usage de tes produits. Tu co-animes le budget du produit avec le leader.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • Expérience : Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience comme Product Manager, avec une légitimité et une réussite reconnues sur des produits complexes ou de plateforme.

  • Expertise Technique & Data : Tu possèdes une forte appétence technique ainsi qu'une solide compréhension des enjeux liés à la gestion des données, aux accès et à la gouvernance. Savoir manipuler la donnée est un réel plus pour ce poste.

  • Culture Tech & IA : Tu maîtrises les outils d'Intelligence Artificielle appliqués au Product Management et tu appréhendes parfaitement les défis techniques sous-jacents (sécurité, infrastructure, scalabilité).

  • Soft Skills : Orienté·e utilisateur, tu as un fort sens du service. Tu aimes écouter, creuser des sujets de fond et proposer des solutions innovantes.

  • Communication & Fédérateur·rice : Tu disposes d'excellentes capacités de communication pour vulgariser des concepts complexes, dialoguer aussi bien avec des profils techniques que métiers, et fédérer autour de ta vision.

  • Langues & Mindset : Un niveau d'anglais courant (B2 minimum, écrit et oral) est requis pour évoluer dans notre contexte international. Tu es motivé·e, curieux·se, ambitieux·se et tu as le goût du challenge.

  • L'étincelle Decathlon : Tu es passionné·e de sport, tu as envie de partager tes passions en équipe et de rejoindre une entreprise à impact positif !


STACK TECHNIQUE

  • Ops : Terraform, Kubernetes

  • IA : Gemini, Github Copilot

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L'INCLUSION ET DE L'ACCESSIBILITE

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l'immense valeur qu'apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c'est pourquoi l'Inclusion est l'un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

Decathlon s'engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d'aménagement, tu peux en faire la demande via le formulaire de candidature, celle-ci sera confidentielle. Ces demandes n'affectent pas le résultat du processus de recrutement.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
descriptionHtml:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets.

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
  • Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
  • Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
  • Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
  • Own delivery end to end - set the roadmap, own the backlog, and take each bet from discovery to launch with engineering, design and data: frame the problem, write the specs and user stories, prioritise sprint by sprint, make the scope calls, and measure what shipped. This is a hands-on build role, not a coordination role.
  • Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
  • Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
  • Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

Your Profile:

  • 5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.
  • A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
  • Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
  • Hands-on product delivery - you have recently (last 2 to 3 years) taken features from problem to production yourself, working day to day with engineers and designers: running discovery, writing the specs, owning backlog and sprint priorities, and making trade-offs when scope, time or data ran short. You are as comfortable in the detail as at the roadmap level.
  • Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
  • A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.
  • Fluent English required

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day.One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
*Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role.

Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged.

title: Senior Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Changing your car should feel like one seamless journey, not a series of disconnected tasks. Right now it's the opposite: people value their car in one place, search for the next one in another, and manage the handover somewhere else, much of it on the web and most of it forgotten between car changes. The Carwow app is our most direct relationship with those customers, and today it is nowhere near what it could be.

We are reimagining it. If we can give people a reason to open Carwow between car changes, understand what they drive and what they want next, and make the moment of changing effortless, the app becomes the place UK drivers start. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with design and engineering to build it.

This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. The best consumer apps of the next few years won't be lists with filters; they will understand you and act on your behalf. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise.

If you want to shape a new consumer product from the ground up, work at the cutting edge of applied AI, and build things that millions of UK drivers could use, this is it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Product Strategy & Execution:

    • Set the product direction for the Carwow consumer app, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Lead discovery work with consumers: interviews, usage data, behavioural analysis, to build a precise understanding of where the app can add the most value

    • Identify, prototype and ship opportunities to bring AI into the app: smarter discovery, personalisation and recommendations that actually change behaviour

    • Collaborate with the Engineering Manager, Designer and Engineers as a product trio to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

    • Manage the backlog with commercial awareness, prioritising work that drives engagement, retention and revenue, not just activity

  • Design & Engineering Partnership:

    • Work shoulder to shoulder with design to shape journeys and screens from the ground up, and test them with users before engineering starts

    • Work with engineers on the right trade-offs for a native app: release cadence, quality and what to build versus reuse

    • Use AI tools every day in your own work, prototyping, synthesising research and analysing data, so the squad learns faster and ships more

  • Cross-functional Leadership:

    • Work across product, engineering, data, CRM and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

    • Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

    • Own the app's success measures and bring clean evidence, including holdouts and controlled tests, to decisions on what to scale, change or stop

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including time owning a consumer mobile app, with evidence of improving engagement or retention metrics

  • Hands-on experience with product discovery: you run your own interviews, interrogate your own data, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for research to land in your inbox

  • AI-native: you use AI tools daily, you have shipped or prototyped AI-powered features, and you have a clear point of view on where it adds real value for consumers

  • Comfort with ambiguity: this role involves defining the problem as much as solving it, and the scope will evolve as evidence comes in

  • A proven partnership with design and engineering: you have worked as a product trio and can hold a credible conversation about journeys, architecture and app quality

  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in automotive, marketplace or two-sided consumer products

  • Familiarity with habit loops and engagement design in a consumer app: push, onboarding, personalisation

  • Background in scale-up or high-growth environments

  • Experience taking new products to market, including GTM planning and launch

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Step 1: Talent Screening Call (25 min)

  • Step 2: Hiring Manager Call: Experience (30 min)

  • Step 3: Case Study (60 min + Task)

  • Step 4: Values Interview (45 min)

 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

    • 28 days annual leave

    • 1 day for your wedding

    • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

    • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • Work from abroad for a month

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

Diversity and inclusion is an integral part of our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Manager - Retrieval | Storage, Peripherals & Retrieval | Hybrid Working | HatfieldAbout Us

We are Ocado Group and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About the Role

Storage, Peripherals & Retrieval is the product area behind the automated systems at the heart of Ocado's automated warehouses: the grid, the peripherals and the bots that run on it. Our mission is to develop the world's leading ASRS: highly cost-competitive, reliable, easy to launch and support and suitable for diverse global use cases.

As the Senior Product Manager for Retrieval, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for our bot, battery and charger fleet. Retrieval is the core driver of grid movement - bots transport stock and customer orders between grid locations, stations and ports, meaning every customer order depends on their availability, reliability and cost-effectiveness.

Operating at the intersection of hardware, firmware, wireless and cloud software, you will lead a critical product domain where even a small change to a bot scales across every operational site globally. You will collaborate closely with mechanical, mechatronics, firmware, wireless and cloud engineering teams, as well as manufacturing and field support teams, driving complex problem-solving and cross-domain alignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Vision & Strategy: Shape and execute the product vision for complex initiatives across the bot, battery and charger domain, balancing short- and long-term goals to lower Capex, Opex and lead time.
  • Commercial & Data Leadership: Define key domain metrics connected directly to business outcomes. Manage financial rationale, balance KPI impacts and make informed Build vs. Buy decisions.
  • Execution & Problem Solving: Lead discovery and problem-solving across cross-functional teams, setting high standards for scoping, requirements and data-driven hypothesis testing.
  • Product Adoption & Scale: Build adoption metrics into domain capabilities, monitor usage across customer segments and collaborate with Solutions, Partner Growth and Partner Success teams to drive global rollout.
  • Stakeholder Management & Evangelism: Manage relationships across engineering crafts, leadership levels and external partners. Articulate complex technical decisions clearly and build strong buy-in.
  • Domain Expertise & Leadership: Serve as the recognized go-to expert for Retrieval, providing strategic guidance, mentoring surrounding PMs and stepping into leadership moments for the Product Director when needed.

What We’re Looking For

  • Substantial, battle-tested product management experience owning end-to-end product lifecycles for complex engineering products shipped at scale.
  • Proven track record of leading product discovery, setting product strategy in uncertain environments and making high-impact strategic trade-offs.
  • Strong experience building product roadmaps alongside Design and Engineering peers, owning the business case and ROI.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, UX, Data, delivery teams and external partners or clients.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment and deliver on commitments.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with products that combine hardware and software (e.g., robotics, connected devices or industrial automation).
  • Experience mentoring or coaching other Product Managers.

Benefits

We believe in supporting our people with meaningful, flexible benefits that prioritise well-being and work-life balance. Here’s a snapshot of what you can expect:

  • Time to recharge: 25 days annual leave (rising to 27 after 5 years), plus the option to buy more - and 30 days a year to work from anywhere in the world.
  • Health & wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance from your first month, wellbeing support through specialist apps and EAP, plus Income Protection and Life Assurance.
  • Family-first policies: 22 weeks paid maternity/primary carer leave and 6 weeks paid paternity leave.
  • Financial support: Pension with employer matching up to 7%, share schemes (Sharesave & BAYE) and interest-free loans for train tickets.
  • Commuter perks: Cycle to Work Scheme, Car salary sacrifice and free shuttle buses to/from Hatfield and Welwyn Garden City stations.
  • Exclusive discounts: 15% off at Ocado.com with free delivery (starting in your first month) and up to 70% off at our Company Shop.

title: Senior Product Manager – Tax and Recs (Europe)
descriptionHtml:
Hybrid role based in our London office (3 days a week)

 

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

 

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe, starting in Ireland.

 

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

 

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

 

If you want to help build the next chapter of Seccl in Ireland and shape the future of investing across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

 

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

 

The role

We’re looking for a Senior product manager to join the Tax and Recs squad in our European tribe. You’ll own how we reconcile client cash and assets, and how we help our clients report their customers’ tax correctly, as we grow across Europe.

Our European strategy has two parts. First, we’re going deep in Ireland, building a full proposition with the products, tax wrappers and pensions that Irish firms and their clients need. Second, we’re building the foundations to spread at speed into more European countries, with a focused offering for each market rather than a rebuild every time we enter a new one. The Tax and Recs squad makes both possible: we can only grow if our reconciliations hold up under regulatory scrutiny and our tax engine is something clients can trust.

You won’t be joining a finished roadmap. You’ll help define it, with real ownership over the problems that will decide how far and how fast we can grow in Europe. You’ll work closely with our Operations, Compliance and Customer teams, and with key European clients. A reliable tax engine is not just a regulatory necessity, it is a genuine advantage when we sell to new firms, so your work will be felt well beyond the squad.

What you’ll own

  • Scaling our cash and stock reconciliations to meet Client Asset Requirements (CAR) in Ireland, so we can grow volumes with confidence

  • Making sure our Operations team’s processes work in Europe and scale as we do

  • Building the tax reporting and tax engine for Ireland, so our clients can report tax correctly on behalf of their customers across the wrappers that matter to Irish firms

  • Localising that foundation to each wrapper and each country across Europe, rather than starting again every time

  • Connecting directly to tax authorities where a country requires us to pay tax on behalf of our clients’ customers

  • Making our tax engine reliable, transparent and easy to build on, so tax becomes a reason firms choose Seccl

  • Defining and prioritising the Tax and Recs squad’s roadmap, balancing what Ireland needs today with what the next European markets will need

  • Translating regulatory requirements, including CAR and Irish tax rules, into clear product requirements with Compliance

  • Breaking down complex problems like localising a tax engine into clear, actionable plans with engineers and other stakeholders

  • Using quantitative and qualitative data, such as break rates, exceptions and resolution times, to make evidence-based decisions

This role’s for you if...

  • You have a track record of owning a product area end to end, ideally in reconciliations, custody, investment operations or tax in a regulated environment (e.g. fintech, banking, investments, pensions, insurance)

  • You understand client money and money flow

  • You’re comfortable operating in 0→1 or highly ambiguous environments where structure doesn’t yet exist

  • You can bring clarity to complex, undefined problems and turn them into actionable plans

  • You’re highly proactive: you create momentum rather than wait for direction

  • You’re customer-obsessed, with a focus on improving workflows and outcomes

  • You thrive in cross-functional environments, working comfortably with Operations, Compliance, Customer and Engineering, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 As salary between £75,000 and £90,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, with some flexibility around bank holidays, plus your birthday off

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 Annual learning budget

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Sales Enablement (AI & Research)
descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Marketing Manager, Sales Enablement (AI & Research)

Team: Marketing

  Prolific

Prolific isn’t just enabling AI innovation – we’re redefining it. While foundational AI technologies are becoming commoditized, Prolific’s human data infrastructure provides the high-quality, diverse data required to train the next generation of AI models. Through our platform, we empower researchers and companies to access a global, ethically curated participant base, ensuring cutting-edge AI research and training grounded in inclusivity and precision.

The role

This is a brand new role, and you’ll be the first person to do it at Prolific.

Right now, the insight that could help us win more deals is scattered. We have valuable learnings about why we win, why we lose, and why deals stall, but they aren’t turned into the pitch, proof and materials that sellers use every day. You’ll fix that. You’ll become the person who knows our market position inside out and turns it into tools that help sellers win.
This is a revenue role. It sits at the point where product marketing meets sales enablement, across both our AI and research businesses. You’ll dig into win-loss, competitive intelligence and customer proof, then turn it into pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, case studies and training that reps use on their next call. You’ll also help new AEs and SDRs get up to speed faster.

You’ll be measured on win rate, sales cycle length, rep ramp time and how well equipped our sellers are in front of a buyer.

Our AI PMM leads strategic lab and enterprise AI pursuits, and our vertical PMMs tailor messaging for specific audiences. You own the foundation they all build on: the shared, trusted system of resources every other deal runs on.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 6+ years in an enablement-facing role (product marketing, sales enablement or competitive intelligence) at a B2B company
  • Experience enabling sellers across more than one product or product line, at a startup, scale-up or enterprise
  • Experience doing the full job, not just the final slides: you’ve gathered the data and insight yourself, then turned it into materials sellers use
  • Enablement you’ve built that measurably moved win rate, ramp time or deal velocity. You can show who used it and what changed
  • Hands-on experience running buyer interviews. You ask about past behaviour, not hypothetical opinions, and you can get a lost buyer to tell you the real reason
  • Comfort with data: you can pull from a CRM and call-intelligence tools, build an analysis or business case, and defend your conclusions
  • Clear writing for busy readers: short, specific and easy to act on
  • Credibility with sellers and senior leaders, and the ability to get sales, product and customer success to act without managing any of them. You’ll spend a lot of time with sales

    What you’ll be doing in the role 

  • Build and own sales enablement across AI and research: onboarding, ongoing training and launch readiness (with the AI PMM), plus a single source of truth that reps actually use
  • Audit what exists today, decide what stays and what goes, and set up a way to keep it current
  • Build and maintain the core sales toolkit: pitch narrative, decks, one-pagers, discovery guides, battlecards, objection handling, white papers and business-case tools
  • Design and run our win-loss programme: buyer interviews after closed-won, closed-lost and no-decision outcomes, combined with CRM and call data and a regular readout to leadership. You’ll also run one outreach calendar for every AI buyer interview, including the AI PMM’s, so no buyer is asked twice
  • Own competitive intelligence against data labelling vendors, research panel providers and in-house alternatives, including a live view of competitor pricing and positioning that feeds the AI PMM’s category point of view
  • Turn findings into specific changes, such as a new talk track, a revised discovery question or a pricing recommendation, then check whether the change moved the number
  • Own customer proof: case studies with AI and research customers, a sourced library of proof points, the reference programme for live deals, and advocacy through quotes, reviews and speakers
  • Sit in on sales calls every week and feed deal-level evidence into product: feature gaps, blockers and pricing friction, ranked by revenue impact
  • Define and report the numbers: win rate, competitive win rate, deal velocity, rep ramp time and content usage, including the AI segment win rates the AI PMM is measured on. Work with RevOps to clean up CRM fields for loss reasons and competitor.

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

title: Senior Quantum Applications Architect
descriptionHtml:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. 

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. 

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. 

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström. 

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact. 

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real. 

Job Summary:

Within the Quantum Algorithms team, we develop and adapt quantum algorithms, identify and scope promising use cases, and analyze their resource requirements. In this role, you will translate computational tasks into abstract quantum-algorithm specifications, analyze their asymptotic performance, and define meaningful problem instances that lie beyond the practical reach of classical computation. You will also work closely with PsiQuantum’s Compilation team to develop explicit implementations of these algorithms and evaluate their resource requirements on our architecture. 

In this position, you will be expected not only to conduct outstanding individual research, but also to formulate and lead broader research programs that draw on the work of other researchers and collaborators. You will contribute to cross-team initiatives spanning PsiQuantum’s applications, architecture, and compilation efforts, helping to connect algorithm design with the practical requirements of fault-tolerant quantum computation. 

The role will also involve external collaboration. You will have the opportunity to lead projects with industrial and research partners, working with domain experts to identify important computational challenges, formulate them as well-defined problems, and map them to appropriate quantum algorithms. Success in this work requires the ability to communicate across disciplinary boundaries and to move fluently between real-world applications, mathematical abstractions, algorithmic complexity, and implementation-level resource analysis. 

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with scientific leadership, intellectual independence, and a collaborative mindset. They will be comfortable shaping open-ended research directions, assessing the practical significance of algorithmic advances, and guiding projects from the initial identification of an application through to a concrete fault-tolerant quantum algorithm and a detailed resource estimate. 

Responsibilities:

  • Propose initiatives into research and development of quantum algorithms tailored for fault-tolerant quantum computers; act as primary contributor to research programs beyond the current state of the art in quantum algorithms design.
  • Work closely with external partners to instantiate, validate and optimize quantum algorithms for use cases across a variety of domains, such as life sciences, industry and sustainability.
  • Establish families of benchmarks and problem instances to validate post-classicality of quantum algorithms.
  • Guide both the simulation and analysis of resource requirements for fault tolerant implementation of quantum algorithms in photonic quantum computing.

Experience/Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of research experience (academia or industry) in the field of quantum computing, with focus on algorithms and applications.  
  • A degree in Physics, Math or Computer Science or equivalent is required. PhD in Physics, Math or Computer Science, with a focus on quantum information theory or quantum computation will be preferred. 
  • Experience with quantum algorithms and compiling in the regime of fault tolerant gates preferred.
  • Experience working with partners in academia or industry to analyze real-world quantum applications of interest preferred.
  • Proven team player with an ability to work effectively across departments, sites and time zones.
  • Ability to work independently and contribute to fast-moving start-up environment.
  • Experience programming in Python, C++ or similar languages.

  • Account for aircraft capabilities, energy, maneuverability, sensing uncertainty and changing target behaviour.

  • Build decision and behaviour logic that allows the system to adapt continuously during a mission.

  • Combine classical robotics, optimization, MPC and learned approaches where appropriate.

  • Explore reinforcement learning, imitation learning and policy-based autonomy where they provide meaningful advantages.

  • Work closely with perception, estimation and control engineers to close the autonomy loop.

  • Take algorithms from simulation into real aircraft and validate them through repeated flight testing.

Your contribution to the team (required)

  • Strong robotics or autonomous-systems background with significant real-world deployment experience.

  • Strong experience with motion planning, trajectory generation or autonomous decision-making.

  • Deep understanding of kinematics, dynamics and optimization.

  • Experience with dynamic environments and moving-target problems.

  • Experience with trajectory optimization, optimal control, MPC or comparable approaches.

  • Strong C++ skills and good Python skills.

  • Experience deploying autonomy algorithms onto real robotic systems.

  • Strong understanding of uncertainty and its implications for decision-making and planning.

  • Ability to design algorithms that operate under real-time compute constraints.

  • Hands-on attitude and willingness to participate directly in flight testing and system debugging.

Big plus

  • UAV / fixed-wing autonomy.

  • High-speed aerial robotics.

  • Rendezvous, pursuit or intercept problems.

  • Target-motion prediction.

  • Aggressive flight.

  • Reinforcement learning on real robots.

  • Imitation learning / learned policies.

  • PX4.

  • ROS2.

  • Optimal control and trajectory optimization.

  • Aviation, defence or space systems.

Even if you don’t tick every box, we encourage you to apply - we’d love to hear from you.
