title: stagiair(e) Advies & Onderzoek – Arbeidsmarkt en Strategisch HRM
descriptionHtml:
0,8- 1fte per week | Utrecht | Hybride | Transformaties van organisaties| € 600,- | Wo-master

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat mensen en organisaties klaar zijn voor de arbeidsmarkt van morgen? Hoe kunnen we talent beter benutten, ontwikkeling stimuleren en organisaties helpen om toekomstbestendig te blijven?

Bij Berenschot krijg je de kans om als stagiair mee te werken aan actuele arbeidsmarkt- en HR-vraagstukken. Je maakt kennis met het adviesvak, werkt samen met ervaren adviseurs en ontdekt hoe je wetenschappelijke inzichten vertaalt naar oplossingen die in de praktijk het verschil maken.

Je werkt op het snijvlak van arbeidsmarkt, human capital, strategisch HRM, skills, leren en ontwikkelen en organisatieverandering.

Dit ga je doen

Tijdens je stage draai je mee in verschillende advies- en onderzoeksprojecten. Je helpt bij het onderzoeken van complexe vraagstukken, het verzamelen en analyseren van informatie en het ontwikkelen van adviezen, programma's en instrumenten.

Je werkzaamheden kunnen onder andere bestaan uit:

  • Uitvoeren van literatuuronderzoek, interviews en kwalitatieve of kwantitatieve analyses.

  • Ondersteunen bij adviestrajecten voor werkgevers, overheden en brancheorganisaties.

  • Voorbereiden en uitwerken van gesprekken, workshops en werksessies.

  • Meedenken over nieuwe methodieken, instrumenten en oplossingen.

  • Ondersteuning bij het vertalen van onderzoeksresultaten naar heldere rapportages, presentaties en adviezen.

  • Bijdragen aan publicaties over actuele arbeidsmarkt- en HR-thema's.

Je kunt bijvoorbeeld werken aan vraagstukken rondom arbeidsmarktkrapte, strategische personeelsplanning, skillsgericht werken, talentontwikkeling, leren en ontwikkelen, duurzame inzetbaarheid of regionale samenwerking op de arbeidsmarkt.

Afhankelijk van je interesses en de mogelijkheden binnen onze projecten krijg je ruimte voor een eigen onderzoeks- of ontwikkelopdracht. Ook is het mogelijk om je stageperiode te combineren met het schrijven van je scriptie.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je komt terecht in de adviesgroep Transformaties van Organisaties, waar we organisaties helpen bij complexe verander- en ontwikkelvraagstukken. We werken op het snijvlak van strategie, organisatie-inrichting, leiderschap, cultuur en mensontwikkeling. Daarbinnen maak je onderdeel uit van het Arbeidsmarkt & Mensen. Samen werken we aan vraagstukken rondom HR-transformaties, goed werkgeverschap, arbeidsmarkt, talentontwikkeling en de toekomst van werk. Wat ons verbindt, is de overtuiging dat organisaties pas echt succesvol kunnen zijn wanneer mensen kunnen groeien, samenwerken en het beste uit zichzelf halen. Vanuit die overtuiging combineren we inhoudelijke expertise met een resultaatgerichte en praktische aanpak, waarbij kennisdeling, samenwerking en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan.


Dit neem je mee

Je bent een nieuwsgierige WO-masterstudent met interesse in arbeidsmarkt-, organisatie- en HR-vraagstukken. Je vindt het leuk om maatschappelijke thema's te onderzoeken en wilt ontdekken hoe het adviesvak in de praktijk werkt.

Daarnaast:

  • je volgt een universitaire masteropleiding, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van bestuurskunde, organisatiekunde, psychologie, sociologie, HRM, Strategic HRM, Business Administration (Management Consulting), economie, onderwijskunde of een vergelijkbare studie.

  • je bent analytisch sterk en weet informatie kritisch te beoordelen, waarbij je ook effectief gebruikmaakt van hulpmiddelen zoals AI.

  • je neemt initiatief, werkt zelfstandig en pakt nieuwe vraagstukken met enthousiasme op.

  • je communiceert helder, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • Je bent gedurende je stage ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. We hebben een informele cultuur, korte communicatielijnen en volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele groei. Daarnaast bieden we:

  • Een stagevergoeding van € 600,- bruto per maand op basis van fulltime.

  • flexibele werkmogelijkheden, ook thuis

  • begeleiding door twee adviseurs op het gebied van strategie en operations

  • een stimulerende en leerzame werkomgeving waarin ruimte is voor eigen inbreng

  • de mogelijkheid om een netwerk op te bouwen binnen Berenschot en met bedrijven

  • Een laptop.

  • Veel stagiairs zijn na hun stage aan een traineeship bij Berenschot begonnen – bij goed presteren biedt deze stage uitstekende kansen voor jouw carrière.

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het Stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma . Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot

Solliciteer meteen

Spreekt deze stage je aan? Wacht niet langer en solliciteer! Neem contact op met Oumnia Makrani via WhatsApp (06 13 33 87 70) of per e-mail () voor informatie over de procedure. Oumnia is op vrijdag bereikbaar. Heb je een dringende vraag? Mail dan naar .

Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent. Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Heb je gesolliciteerd? Dan ontvang je binnen één werkweek een reactie. Is die positief? Dan nodigen we je graag uit voor een kennismaking. Zijn we na dit gesprek allebei enthousiast? Dan volgt een gesprek met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Dat is het moment om jouw laatste vragen te stellen. Blijkt daaruit dat jij een echte Berenschotter bent? Dan gaan we snel over tot een concreet aanbod. Hierna ben je een echte Berenschotter en heten we je graag welkom in ons team.

Créée en 2015, Make Me Stay® est une startup spécialisée dans le financement immobilier urgent. La société propose aux propriétaires pressés et ne pouvant pas obtenir un crédit bancaire classique un apport de trésorerie en seulement quelques jours.

Vos missions

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un nouveau stagiaire bras droit, dont le rôle est de participer activement aux côtés des fondateurs aux processus opérationnels, à la transformation par l'IA et au développement de la startup.

L'équipe est directement managée en mode agile par les fondateurs et regroupe des compétences dans les domaines IT, IA & automatisation, marketing & Growth Hacking, vente, finances et juridique.

En tant que bras droit, tes principales missions seront :

  • Suivre les dossiers clients jusqu'à leur finalisation avec les différents intervenants et intermédiaires (experts, investisseurs, notaires, commerciaux)

  • Analyser les dossiers, participer au processus de décision d'investissement et préparer les dossiers pour le comité d'investissement (documentation, analyse, avis)

  • Concevoir et déployer des automatisations de nos processus métier (workflows, connexion de nos outils entre eux, traitement automatique des dossiers et des données)

  • Exploiter les outils IA au quotidien pour accélérer notre travail : analyse de dossiers, rédaction et structuration de documents, synthèses, assistants internes

  • Prendre en charge des chantiers d'IA de bout en bout, du cahier des charges à la recette. C'est une part croissante du poste : une partie de ce que nous développons aujourd'hui te sera déléguée

  • Assurer les reportings quotidiens et hebdomadaires des différents étages, en automatisant leur production autant que possible

  • Améliorer en continu nos procédures (analyse, automatisation, documentation, site web)

Vos compétences

  • Tu es étudiant(e) de niveau Bac +4/5 issu(e) d'une formation type fac, école de commerce ou d'ingénieur

  • Tu es à l'aise avec les outils numériques et tu as un vrai appétit pour l'IA et l'automatisation (usage avancé de l'IA générative, outils no-code/automatisation type Make, Zapier, n8n, ou volonté de t'y former rapidement)

  • Tu justifies idéalement d'une première expérience dans le secteur de la finance ou de l'immobilier

  • Tu es autonome, agile et rigoureux(se) avec de fortes capacités d'organisation

  • Tu as un sens de l'analyse, un esprit d'initiative et tu es proactif(ve)

  • Tu es doté(e) d'une excellente communication orale et écrite

Avantages

  • Tu bénéficieras d'une plus-value professionnelle en te formant à toutes les facettes de la gestion d'une start-up (commercial, marketing, opérations, juridique, investisseurs) et à l'usage concret de l'IA en entreprise

  • Tu participeras à la construction de notre stack d'automatisation et d'IA, une compétence très recherchée sur le marché

  • Tu travailleras au sein d'un espace de coworking dynamique (Neuilly-sur-Seine et La Défense) et dans un environnement multiculturel et stimulant

  • Tu profiteras d'une grande autonomie au quotidien et l'on te confiera des responsabilités

Notre niveau d'exigence, dit franchement

L'essentiel de notre travail répétitif est déjà automatisé. Nous ne cherchons donc pas quelqu'un pour exécuter : nous cherchons quelqu'un dont l'analyse et la rigueur apportent davantage que ce que nos outils produisent déjà seuls. Le niveau attendu est élevé et il le restera. La sélection comporte une étude de cas réelle, à rendre en 72 heures.

Conditions

Stage conventionné et rémunéré de 6 mois, à partir de janvier 2027. Sur site à Neuilly-sur-Seine. Pas de télétravail, la convention de stage l'interdit hors temps plein.

Pour postuler

Candidatez en utilisant le bouton sur cette page. Nous répondons sous 48 heures. La sélection se fait en trois temps : un premier échange écrit, une courte vidéo de présentation, puis un entretien et une étude de cas réelle à rendre en 72 heures.

title: Stagiaire en Comptabilité
descriptionHtml:
Dans le cadre du développement de notre équipe comptable, nous recherchons un(e) Stagiaire en Comptabilité de niveau Master, en fin d’études ou en année de césure, pour accompagner l’équipe dans la gestion des opérations comptables courantes.

Ce stage constitue une véritable immersion au sein d’un service comptable et vous permettra de développer votre autonomie, votre rigueur et votre maîtrise des processus comptables.

Vos missions

Rattaché(e) à l’équipe comptable, vous participerez notamment aux missions suivantes :

  • Tenue et suivi du courrier du service comptable ;

  • Suivi du workflow des factures fournisseurs : contrôle du circuit de validation, suivi des factures en attente et identification des éventuels blocages ;

  • Import et intégration des écritures comptables :

factures d’achats ;

factures de ventes ;

opérations bancaires ;

  • Contrôle de la cohérence des écritures importées ;

  • Participation aux travaux de saisie, de contrôle et de révision comptable ;

  • Participation aux différents travaux comptables du quotidien et contribution à l’amélioration des processus du service.


Vous êtes actuellement en Master en Comptabilité, Finance, Gestion ou Audit, et recherchez un stage de fin d’études ou une année de césure.

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne :

  • Rigoureuse et organisée ;

  • Autonome et capable de respecter les délais ;

  • À l’aise avec les chiffres et les outils informatiques ;

  • Curieuse et souhaitant approfondir ses connaissances en comptabilité ;

  • Dotée d’un bon esprit d’analyse et d’équipe ;

  • Avec une réelle envie de découvrir le fonctionnement d’un service comptable.

Une première expérience en comptabilité, en cabinet ou en entreprise, serait appréciée.

Duration: 4-6 months

title: Steuerfachangestellter als Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unser Kunde gehört zu den weltweit führenden Industrieunternehmen mit Sitz in München. Eine langjährige Unternehmensgeschichte sowie ein breites Produktspektrum zeichnen das Unternehmen aus. Das international- und somit auch mit multikulturellen Teams aufgestellte Unternehmen sucht für eine Niederlassung in München Verstärkung. Nutzen Sie ihre Chance und lassen Sie uns Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen zukommen, diese werden selbstverständlich auf höchstem Niveau diskret behandelt. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung als Steuerfachangestellter als Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d)!

Aufgaben

  • Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung von Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen

  • Regelmäßige Erstellung von Statistiken, Analysen und Auswertungen

  • Vornahme von Intercompany-Abstimmungen und des monatlichen Cash-Flow Reportings

  • Durchführung der Kreditoren- und Debitoren- und Anlagenbuchhaltung

  • Erstellung der Umsatzsteuervoranmeldung

  • Durchführung der Budgetplanung und des monatlichen Outlooks

  • Ermittlung von Rückstellungen und unterjährigen Abgrenzungen

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung zur/zum Steuerfachangestellten (m/w/d)

  • Alternativ: ein abgeschlossenes Wirtschaftsstudium mit Schwerpunkt Rechnungswesen / Controlling

  • Sie haben bereits fundierte Erfahrung im Bereich der Finanzbuchhaltung sammeln können

  • Sie zeichnen sich durch rechtliche Grundlagen und Kenntnisse nach HGB und IFRS aus

  • Sie verfügen über gute Anwenderkenntnisse in gängigen buchhalterischen EDV-Programmen sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Sie besitzen ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative, sowie zeitliche und inhaltliche Flexibilität bei der Wahrnehmung Ihrer Aufgaben

Benefits

  • Lediglich eine Bewerbung bei uns, die wir bei Passgenauigkeit gezielt an mehrere Unternehmen weiterleiten können

  • erstes Interview und individuelle Beratung

  • Zugang zum sog. verdeckten Stellenmarkt (nicht ausgeschriebene Stellen)

  • Eine Vielzahl an Stellen, die kurzfristig besetzt werden müssen

  • Persönliche Kontakte zu Entscheidern und hilfreiche Informationen

  • Hilfreiche Tipps und Informationen für das Vorstellungsgespräch beim Unternehmen

  • Unsere Leistung ist absolut kostenlos für Sie als Bewerber (m/w/d)

  • Selbstverständlich behandeln wir Ihre persönlichen Daten und Bewerbungsunterlagen absolut vertraulich und diskret

title: Strategic Account Executive (Eastern Europe)
descriptionHtml:
About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, the Strategic Account Executive is a field-based position with ownership of an assigned territory (Eastern/Central Europe) focused on net new logo and upsell opportunities. You will have the ability to utilize a robust internal resource model, a broad tech stack, and a global partner directory to position yourself for future success. 

We will consider applicants based in the UK or Netherlands.

You will: 

  • Create, implement, measure and review a personal plan that drives achievement of performance goals aligned to the regional sales strategy. 
  • Position and articulate our value proposition to customers to maximize the business opportunity. 
  • Negotiate and close complex contracts with the support of global partners. 
  • Report on sales activity and forecasts to senior management. 
  • Prepare indicative subscription pricing and customer offers, including reviewing broader opportunities such as training and professional services modules, and guides request for proposal responses. 
  • Provides customer feedback to marketing, customer success, product management, and engineering teams. 
  • Work collaboratively to acquire additional/specialist resources as needed.  

You have: 

  • A demonstrable, successful track record of selling enterprise software solutions in the Eastern/Central European region
  • Proven ability to win net new business.
  • Results-oriented with multiple years meeting or exceeding quota within the market. 
  • Sustainable record of signing strategic and large projects, with long and complex sales cycles. 
  • A combination of experience in selling to both public and private sector accounts is preferred.
  • Established sector-related C level contacts. 
  • Successful record dealing with strategic buyers. 
  • Deep knowledge of the relevant key drivers of change in the industry. 
  • Background working with regional/national/global partners and system integrators.
  • Prior training and experience in value selling and account planning methodologies. 
  • Flexibility to travel to the assigned region as required

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations) 

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance.

Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com.

📐 About the role

Join WRITER's sales team as a strategic account executive and help shape the future of work. You'll empower global enterprises (8,000+ employees) to transform their operations through our cutting-edge AI agent platform, enabling organizations to deploy AI at scale and unlock unprecedented productivity. This isn't just about hitting quota – it's about becoming a trusted advisor to some of the world's most influential companies as they navigate their AI transformation journey.

This role is perfect for high performers who thrive in fast-paced, intellectually stimulating environments where you have the autonomy to drive results and build lasting relationships with both clients and teammates. If you're energized by meaningful work, the opportunity to make a real impact, and the challenge of selling category-defining technology, we want to hear from you. You'll be selling solutions that fundamentally change how enterprises operate, working with executive buyers who are making multi-million dollar, multi-year commitments to AI transformation.

This is a hybrid role based out of our London hub. You'll be reporting to our regional vice president.

🦸🏻‍♀️ What you’ll do

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting through close, managing complex deals with 8-18 month sales cycles and navigating multi-stakeholder buying committees across procurement, legal, IT, and business units

  • Drive net-new revenue by identifying, qualifying, and developing strategic opportunities within target verticals and named account lists, consistently building a robust pipeline that exceeds coverage targets

  • Engage C-level executives and senior decision-makers in consultative discovery to understand their business priorities, uncover transformational use cases, and position WRITER as the strategic platform to achieve their AI vision

  • Partner cross-functionally with solutions engineering, product, and customer success teams to architect tailored solutions, run successful pilots, and ensure seamless deployments that deliver measurable business outcomes

  • Lead complex negotiations involving multi-year contracts, custom pricing structures, and enterprise terms, while maintaining deal momentum and driving consensus across diverse stakeholder groups

  • Become a trusted product expert who educates prospects on how to set up and leverage WRITER's AI agent platform, going hands-on during critical evaluation phases to demonstrate value and accelerate time-to-deployment

  • Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene and forecasting accuracy, consistently delivering predictable revenue results while providing leadership with transparent visibility into deal progression and risk factors

⭐️ What you need

  • 7-10+ years of quota-carrying strategic SaaS sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding annual quotas in complex, value-based sales motions targeting Fortune 500 and Global 2000 accounts

  • Demonstrated expertise in managing sophisticated enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders, navigating procurement processes, and orchestrating cross-functional resources to drive deals through technical evaluations and executive approvals

  • Executive presence and communication skills that allow you to credibly engage with C-suite buyers (CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, COOs), translate complex technical concepts into business value, and build authentic relationships based on trust and strategic insight

  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to conduct discovery that uncovers underlying business challenges, connects AI capabilities to measurable outcomes, and creates urgency around transformation initiatives

  • Experience in outbound prospecting, account mapping, and territory planning, with a hunter mentality that drives you to consistently create new opportunities rather than waiting for inbound leads

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for ownership – you thrive in fast-paced environments where you're expected to figure things out, make decisions with incomplete information, and drive your own success with minimal oversight

  • Deep alignment with WRITER's values: you naturally Connect across functions and build collaborative relationships, you Challenge the status quo and aren't afraid to have difficult conversations, and you Own your outcomes with accountability and a commitment to long-term impact

🍩 Benefits & perks (UK full-time employees):

  • Generous PTO, plus company holidays

  • Comprehensive medical and dental insurance

  • Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks)

  • Fertility and family planning support

  • Competitive pension scheme and company contribution

  • Annual work-life stipends for:

    • Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc.

    • Learning and development stipend

  • Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites

  • Competitive compensation and company stock options

title: Strategic Account Manager - Hospitals (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Großer Markt, perfektes Timing: Deine Verantwortung

Viele unserer Krankenhaus- und Klinikverbundkunden arbeiten bereits mit Doctolib. Jetzt geht es darum, gemeinsam die nächsten strategisch relevanten Chancen zu identifizieren: weitere Standorte und Teams einzubinden, neue Anwendungsfälle zu entwickeln und unsere Lösungen so einzusetzen, dass sie im Alltag wirklich helfen.

Als Strategic Account Manager Hospitals (x/f/m) arbeitest Du mit Geschäftsführungen, medizinischen Leitungen, IT und Einkauf an genau diesen Fragen. Dabei liegt Dein Fokus auf der Identifikation, Entwicklung und Steuerung strategisch relevanter Enterprise-Initiativen. Du entwickelst Accounts weiter und übernimmst dort die Führung, wo aus einem Potenzial eine komplexe, skalierbare Lösung für mehrere Standorte oder Häuser wird. So trägst Du täglich dazu bei, dass unsere digitalen Lösungen den Arbeitsalltag von Teams in Krankenhäusern und Kliniken verbessern.

 

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Fokus setzen: Du arbeitest mit einer begrenzten Zahl strategischer Accounts, analysierst ihre Strukturen, Ziele und Entscheidungswege und entscheidest, wo Doctolib den größten Beitrag für unsere Kunden leisten kann.

  • Potenziale erkennen: Du identifizierst Themen, aus denen skalierbare Lösungen für mehrere Häuser oder Standorte entstehen können - etwa zentrale Rahmenverträge, große Enterprise Deals oder Vorhaben mit Relevanz für die Geschäftsführung. 

  • Mehrwert greifbar machen: Du übersetzt die Vorteile von Doctolib in Business Cases, Use Cases und kommerzielle Modelle, die zu den Zielen und Strukturen der jeweiligen Organisation passen.

  • Entscheider:innen verbinden: Du bringst Geschäftsführung, medizinische Leitung, IT und Einkauf zusammen, klärst unterschiedliche Interessen und koordinierst die passenden Doctolib-Teams. So führst Du die Beteiligten zu einer tragfähigen Entscheidung.

  • Wirkung im Blick behalten: Du steuerst Deine Pläne, Vertriebschancen, Verkaufszyklen und die Vertriebsprognose. Dabei trennst Du operative Aufgaben von Themen mit langfristigem Wert und setzt Deine Zeit dort ein, wo sie für Deine Accounts und Doctolib gleichermaßen den Beitrag leistet.

 

Dein Profil:

Wenn Du nicht jeden der folgenden Punkte erfüllst, aber überzeugt bist, dass diese Stelle zu Dir passt – bewirb Dich. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Perspektive!

  • Erfahrung im Key- und Enterprise Account Management: Du kannst nachweisliche Erfolge im B2B-Vertrieb in vielschichtigen Organisationen des Gesundheitswesens vorweisen – idealerweise im Software Sales (SaaS). Dadurch hast Du Erfahrung mit komplexen, strategisch relevanten Initiativen und großen Enterprise Deals. Die Komplexität hochregulierter Sales-Zyklen ist Dir vertraut; Entscheider:innen zu überzeugen ist Deine Stärke.

  • Strategische Account-Entwicklung: Du erkennst skalierbare Potenziale, entwickelst belastbare Account-Pläne und priorisierst die Themen, die über mehrere Standorte und Fachbereiche hinweg den größten langfristigen Business Impact erzielen.

  • Begeisterung für digitale Transformation im Gesundheitswesen: Du kennst das deutsche Gesundheitswesen aus Deiner Praxis und bist überzeugt, dass digitale Lösungen im Krankenhausalltag wirklich helfen können. Idealerweise hattest Du sogar schon mit Themen wie Digital Health oder dem Krankenhauszukunftsgesetz (KHZG) zu tun.

  • Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe: Du drückst Dich verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau oder höher) und sicher auf Englisch (B2+) aus, kannst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringen und  bleibst auch in komplexen Gesprächen klar und fokussiert.

  • Präsenz dort, wo es zählt: Du weißt, wie wichtig der persönliche Kontakt für Deine Arbeit ist – ob mit Deinen Kund:innen oder Deinem Team. Ein Wohnort an einem unserer Office-Standorte Köln, Berlin, München oder Hamburg (oder die Bereitschaft, dorthin umzuziehen), Reisebereitschaft zu Kundenterminen sowie ein Führerschein Klasse B sind dafür die Voraussetzungen. 

 

Was wir Dir bieten:

  • Die Teilnahme an unserem langfristigen Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

  • Einen Firmenwagen mit Tankkarte – natürlich auch privat nutzbar

  • Erstklassige Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote – maßgeschneidert auf Dich und Deine Karriereziele

  • Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Leistungen

  • Einen überdurchschnittlichen Arbeitgeberzuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (bAV) von 40 %

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

  • Unser Doctolib Parent Care Programm

  • Individuelle Angebote für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen – darunter flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung

  • Kostenlose und vertrauliche Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über unseren externen Partner

 

So sieht unser Interviewprozess aus:

  1. Interview mit Talent Acquisition (Video Call – ca. 45 Minuten)

  2. Interview mit dem Fachbereich (Video Call – ca. 45 Minuten)

  3. Case Study Interview (virtuell, ca. 1,5 Stunden)

  4. Eine Referenzprüfung

  5. Unser Angebot an Dich

 

Job Details:

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung

  • Vollzeit (40h / Woche)

  • Hybrid

  • Office: Köln, München, Hamburg oder Berlin

  • Startdatum: so schnell wie möglich

 

Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert.

Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr wird unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern können. Deshalb laden wir Dich ein, Dich zu bewerben, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung.

Um Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten, kannst Du in Deiner Bewerbung auf Angaben wie Fotos, Alter etc. verzichten. Lass uns bitte wissen, welche Vorkehrungen wir treffen können, um Dich bestmöglich zu unterstützen. Wir freuen uns, mit Dir das Gesundheitswesen zu digitalisieren.

Alle bereitgestellten Informationen werden von Doctolib für das Bewerbungsmanagement verarbeitet. Für Details zur Datenverarbeitung klicke bitte hier. 

Bei Fragen oder wenn Du Deine Rechte wahrnehmen möchtest, wende Dich bitte an hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com.

title: Strategic Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
monday.com is building the AI work platform that not only helps manage and orchestrate work, but also does the work for you. Over 250,000 customers across departments worldwide use monday to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform, where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. From work management and CRM to service and dev, every product in our ecosystem runs on the same AI layer, automating tasks, running workflows, and helping teams deliver exponentially more with less effort.

We move fast with big impact, fuelled by a vibrant, ownership-driven culture where you’re empowered to shape how organisations achieve more and outpace their competition.

We're looking for a Strategic Account Manager to join our expanding sales team here in London. There are a few things we take really seriously here at monday: building an amazing product and providing the best possible service to our customers. Our clients love our product, and it's incredibly unique (and fun) to walk our clients to success using our platform.

﻿Please note that this is a hybrid position of 3 days/week in our London office

About the role:

  • Own and grow a portfolio of strategic accounts, with accountability for net revenue retention and expansion targets

  • Build and execute account plans that map the whitespace across each customer’s organisation: new teams, departments, business units, and use cases

  • Proactively identify and create expansion opportunities (up-sell, add-on, cross-sell) and drive them from first signal to closed-won

  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, tying capabilities directly to measurable business outcomes and ROI to build the case for broader investment

  • Challenge leaders on their current processes and champion organisational change, positioning monday as the platform to scale it

  • Develop and run internal advocacy and adoption programmes within customer organisations to build champions, deepen usage, and open doors to new buying groups

  • Maintain deep expertise in the monday platform and use it to shape compelling, value-based commercial conversations

  • Partner closely with Customer Success, Product, and Sales Leadership to protect the base, accelerate growth, and feed customer insights back into the business

 

Requirements

  • 5+ years of B2B SaaS account management or sales experience, with a proven record of exceeding quota and growing large, strategic accounts ($150-500K ACV)

  • Demonstrated success owning the full sales cycle: identifying expansion opportunities, multi-threading across stakeholders, building business cases, negotiating, and closing

  • Experience building and executing account plans and managing a forecastable pipeline

  • Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and influence at the executive level

  • Commercial mindset: comfortable discussing pricing, ROI, and value, and navigating procurement and contracting

What monday.com can offer you:

  • Join a customer-obsessed team where transparency and ownership are how we actually operate - not just things we put on a wall

  • Work on a multi-product suite powered by advanced AI, where what you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide

  • Competitive salary, benefits, bonus potential, and equity eligibility for many roles — we believe people should share in our success

  • Grow fast through a dedicated L&D team, AI workshops, bootcamps, and internal hackathons - the industry moves quick and so do we

  • A collaborative, global culture backed by Employee Resource Groups and workplace teams across New York, Tel Aviv, London, Munich, Warsaw, Tokyo, Sydney, and more

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager - Italian Speaking
descriptionHtml:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The Role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager for our Italian-speaking market, you’ll own a book of enterprise accounts across Europe, acting as a trusted advisor who drives adoption, retention and growth. You’ll partner closely with Sales to deliver a seamless onboarding experience and educate clients on a completely new way to create video content. Engaging stakeholders from day-to-day users through to the C-suite, you’ll make sure customers see clear ROI and become true champions of Synthesia.

What You'll do

  • Reporting to the Director of Customer Success of Southern EMEA and focusing on Italian accounts in Europe - you are energetic, driven, and care deeply about the success of our customers

  • As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will drive Synthesia’s future growth by building relationships with clients and turning them into happy users

  • You will be helping educate clients on a totally new way to create video content, and work very closely with sales to create a cohesive onboarding experience for new users

  • You are capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organisation, including the C-suite

  • Ideal for an individual who wants to expand their career with a fast-growing software company

We’d love to hear from you if you have

  • Customer-facing experience in Customer Success Management / Client Service / Account Management / Technical Account Management / Implementation or similar ideally in B2B SaaS

  • Experience in managing a Book of Business along with KPIs

  • A track record in managing risk, forecasting, and identifying growth opportunities

  • Establishing a trusted advisor relationship with our clients, driving value from Synthesia products and services

  • Successfully onboarding new clients and building key relationships in the first critical months and beyond

  • Coordinating and leading regular client check-ins with clear outcomes on client health and opportunities with senior stakeholder attendance

  • Light video editing using the Synthesia platform

  • Retention and growth of our enterprise clients

  • Ensuring ROI and value is understood by clients, proactively looking for risks and opportunities

  • You need to be fluent in Italian and English

  • You are based in Europe and can sit remote.

We’d be particularly excited if

  • Experience at a fast-growing technology company

  • Familiarity with AI or video tools

Compensation

We offer a competitive salary, equity and benefits. Your offer will reflect your experience, skills and the scope of the role.

title: Strategy & Operations Analyst - Germany 🇩🇪
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France and Europe?

Do you thrive in a trustful, fast-paced environment?

Then Pennylane might be the right place for you — and you, might be the perfect fit for this role 🙂

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of European SMEs.

We help business owners get rid of the time consuming hassle of handling accounting and finance, while giving them access to key information that they can use to make better decisions.

Meanwhile, we’re helping accountants. By using Pennylane, rather than doing manual and repetitive tasks, they can spend more time advising and guiding their clients.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and we're accelerating in Germany 🇩🇪)

In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1200+ happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

About Strategy & Operations at Pennylane:

At Pennylane, being part of the Strategy & Operations team means deeply understanding operational realities. As we launch our German entity, we design and implement efficient, scalable solutions that enable Pennylane to reach and exceed its ambitious expansion targets. Your role will be pivotal in structuring local operations from scratch, scaling existing processes, and tailoring our operating model to the specificities of the German market. To make this launch a success, our Strategy & Operations teams work daily alongside Business teams (Sales, Success Managers), Tech teams (Developers, Product Managers), and Data teams (Data Scientists, Data Analysts).

The Goal

Significantly boost team productivity through better tool utilization, process simplification, and operational structuring to support the launch and expansion of our German entity.

Day-to-Day Impact

You will be the owner, key point of contact, and driver of change within the Business Teams for the German market. You will work closely with operational managers leading Sales, Professional Services, Customer Support, and Account Management.

Your Role

  • Drive transformation and challenge the status quo: Observe, listen, challenge existing setups, and continuously propose optimizations to reduce time spent on manual admin tasks or data searches. You will pave the way for future local growth, structure operations for a new entity, and document all procedural changes.

  • Implement operational improvements: Roll out solution-driven initiatives through new information systems, app modifications, or organizational changes. You will lead projects while leveraging cross-functional capabilities (Data, Sales, Finance, etc.). Your mission will also be to ensure high customer satisfaction, hit delivery deadlines, and monitor roll-out KPIs.

  • Scale and localize processes: Adapt global operational frameworks to German market specificities while remaining aligned with core Pennylane standards.

  • Benchmark and innovate: Observe other departments, take a step back, run benchmarks, and gather insights to refine operational strategies.

  • Enable teams and drive adoption: Implement strong communication and hands-on support for German teams to ensure smooth onboarding onto new methodologies (optimal tooling, training, continuous improvement). You will ensure daily tool adoption and process adherence.

  • Bridge Ops and Corporate strategy: Gain a high-level view of corporate challenges to anticipate their impact on local German operations and provide operational visibility through data-driven insights.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for an ambitious professional with a proven track record in organizational transformation, productivity improvement, project management, and operational structuring in a fast-paced environment.

Key Qualifications & Skills

  • Languages: Fluent in German and English

  • Minimum of 4 years of proven experience in business transformation and operational efficiency through system and tool implementation.

  • First-hand experience or a strong appetite for market launches, entity structuring, or scaling operations.

  • Strong natural curiosity and drive to make a real impact: active listener and sharp observer.

  • End-to-end project management experience: ability to scope problems quickly, execute fast, and iterate without waiting for perfection.

  • Ability to balance granular detail with a high-level strategic perspective.

  • Strong business acumen.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to simplify complex issues.

  • Appetite for or knowledge of AI, No-Code tools, and process automation.

  • Strong analytical skills (proficiency in SQL is a plus).

  • Familiarity with SaaS business operations and tools like Salesforce and Intercom is a plus.

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🏢 This job is based in Berlin with an on-site presence a few days per week at our Berlin office (Rosenthaler Strasse 43–45).

💵 An attractive package (detailed during the screening stage)

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🌴 30 days of paid leave per year.

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your english or your french

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🎉 Regular company events: We value spending time together through events such as our Tech Days, held every three months, our annual company offsite, and team gatherings approximately once a month at our Berlin office (Rosenthaler Strasse 43–45).

🤝 Hiring Process:

  • Intro Call: First exchange with Thomas (Recruiter) - 30 min video call

  • Manager Interview: Interview with Alexandre (Chief of Staff Germany) – 45min video call

  • Case Study:

    • Practical exercise with two Pennylane Strategy & Operations Manager – 60min video call

    • On-site fit: With team members from the Sales or Success Departments.

  • Final Round: Interview with Eric Scaramozzino (VP Strategic Initiatives) and Tobias Janiesch (General Manager) - 45min to 1H video call

We make sure we move fast ; you can expect the recruitment process with us to last between 15 and 25 days in total.

We have tried to give you as much details as we could about the purpose, missions and environment of this role; it is now up to you to tell us if you think this is a position in which you could a) have fun and b) bring value to our company.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply anyway: worst case scenario, you might lose a few minutes, and in the best case, it will be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

We also want to emphasise that we fully embrace diversity and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment. We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

To end with a humble illustration of our commitment, we’ve recently signed the Pacte Parité to set concrete goals in building a better and more inclusive workplace in the years to come.

Encouraging diversity in all its forms, Pennylane strives to offer an inclusive, caring and fulfilling work environment in our offices and remotely. We provide equal opportunities and consideration regardless of background, origin, gender, religion, sexual orientation or handicap.

title: Supervisor Customer Service Team for Japan
descriptionHtml:
About Kuoni Tumlare

At Kuoni Tumlare, we deliver truly inspiring and innovative solutions and experiences that create value both for our Partners and Society at large. Our wide portfolio of products and solutions is built on 100+ years of destination management experience.

Our solutions include series tours, technical visits, educational tours, Japanspecialist travel consulting, as well as meetings, incentives, conferences, and exhibitions. Our product portfolio includes MyBus excursions at destinations as well as guaranteed departure tours devised and delivered by our Seat-in-Coach specialists, Europamundo (EMV) and MyBus Landcruise.

We cater to a wide range of customer needs in close collaboration with our trusted suppliers and powered by our team of destinations experts - enabling us to make a real difference to the world.

About the Business

Our Destination Management services form the core of our business. Together with our destination experts, our sales and account management teams generate business by partnering with our customers (Tour Operators, Travel Agencies) to shape exciting itineraries suited to their traveler’s needs. We take care of everything from ground support, hotel bookings, sightseeing, restaurants, and local guides; all while providing 24/7 customer support so that travelers from over 50 countries can enjoy memorable travel experiences worry free.

About the Role

Our Customer Service Supervisor is responsible for overseeing and leading the Customer Service (CS) team dedicated with delivering exceptional service to customers from Japan travelling into Switzerland. It is a crucial role in the operational management of the CS department, ensuring that quality standards and customer satisfaction goals are met, if not exceeded. The role involves being a leader capable of motivating, training, and guiding the team members to optimize their performance and maintain a high level of service.

Additionally, the role holder will be responsible for managing employee HR-related and operations tasks, organizing staff training and developing relationships with clients. Ideally a motivated leader who is eager to strive for the best customer experience and willing to always expand their knowledge of the travel industry.

Key Activities

The customer service supervisors’ responsibilities include scheduling, task allocation, and workflow management within the team. The role holder intervenes in solving complex problems, providing support and solutions to delicate situations encountered by their team members. The person is also involved in evaluating individual and collective performances while offering constructive feedback and training to enhance your team's skills and knowledge.

The role also involves close communication with other departments to ensure consistency in processes and information shared with customers. It is important that company policies and procedures are kept up-to-date while remaining flexible to adapt to the changing needs of both customers and the company. In summary, our Customer Service Supervisor embodies the essential link between the company and its customers, ensuring that each interaction is a positive and satisfying experience for both parties.

Ad-hoc tasks

  • Supervise daily operations of the Customer Service Team Japan

  • Manage staff to ensure high-quality customer service

  • Manage and operate Premium Ad-hoc tours with fully attention and quality / Handle normal ad-hoc tours according to the given internal guideline

  • Check itineraries in details to make sure clear feasibility in timing and routing, while ensuring that service code/suppliers and conditions are correct and available, depending on each seasonality

  • Conduct appropriate selection of suppliers suitable for the tour grade in quality and price

  • Booking and delivering confirmation of local destination services efficiently and accurately

  • Provide clear and constructive suggestions and proposals to Sales for any critical services

  • Provide support to the business by gathering market trends, new products and local destination information as well as providing feedback and suggestions

  • Attend tours, inspections, or provide onsite inspection/support if required during and outside office hours in Switzerland

  • Pre/Post season analysis, supplier quality review and new opportunities for future business to be discussed/conducted with coordination with Destination Management team and Contracting manager

  • Any other related duties, such as maintenance of masterdata and other administrative or co-ordination tasks as required.

Series

  • Check master tours in detail to ensure clear feasibility in timing and routing and ensuring that service code/suppliers and conditions/ service/route are correct and available depending on each seasonality

  • Create master tours by A to Z for selected Japanese agenda as per internal guideline

  • Process by acting as Sales Office Operator to support Sales in Japan

  • Conduct appropriate selection of suppliers suitable for the tour in quality and price

  • Booking and delivering confirmation of local destination services efficiently and accurately

  • Provide clear and constructive suggestions and proposals to Sales for any critical services

  • Provide support to the business by gathering market trends, new products and local destination information as well as providing feedback and suggestions

  • Attend tours, inspections, or provide onsite inspection/support if required during and outside office hours in Switzerland

title: Systemadministrator Linux (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll?🚀

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz.

Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten.

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden.

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen.

Aufgaben

Als Systemadministrator Linux hältst du nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team die zukünftige IT-Landschaft des Unternehmens.

  • Linux & Infrastruktur: Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur.
  • Open Source: Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrationen von Standardsoftware zu geeigneten Open Source Alternativen.
  • Virtualisierung & Automatisierung: Arbeite mit Technologien wie Proxmox, Docker und vSphere und automatisiere Prozesse beispielsweise mit Python und Ansible.
  • Cyber Security: Entwickle Security und Resilience weiter und beschäftige dich mit technischen Anforderungen rund um NIS 2, DSGVO, CRA und TISAX.
  • KI Infrastruktur: Betreue und erweitere den unternehmenseigenen Linux basierten KI-Server und schaffe eine sichere Infrastruktur für die interne Nutzung künstlicher Intelligenz.
  • Technischer Support: Löse komplexere interne IT-Fragestellungen für überwiegend technisch versierte Anwender mit Schwerpunkt auf dem zweiten und dritten Supportlevel.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker, IT-Systemadministrator, abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Linux Administration nach Abschluss deiner Ausbildung oder deines Studiums.
  • Sehr gute Linux Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest bereits routiniert mit Linux und möchtest dich nicht erst in das Betriebssystem einarbeiten.
  • Solides Verständnis von Netzwerktechnik, Netzwerkprotokollen und IT-Infrastruktur.
  • Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung oder Containertechnologien wie Proxmox, Docker oder vSphere.
  • Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung, beispielsweise mit Python, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Technologien.
  • Begeisterung für Open Source und Interesse daran, eine IT-Landschaft langfristig auf offenen und sicheren Lösungen aufzubauen.
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.
  • Eigenständige, pragmatische Arbeitsweise und Lust darauf, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten und gemeinsam im Team neue Lösungen auszuprobieren.
  • Kenntnisse in Nextcloud, Open Xchange, Nginx, pfSense, OpenVPN, Git oder Ceph sowie Erfahrung mit IT Security sind von Vorteil.

Benefits

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Entscheide aktiv mit, wie sich die interne IT in den Bereichen Linux, Open Source, Cyber Security, Resilience und Automatisierung weiterentwickelt.
  • Spannende Zukunftsprojekte: Arbeite unter anderem an Open Source Migrationen, dem Ausbau der IT Security und einem eigenen internen Linux basierten KI Server.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Freiheit bei technischen Lösungen.

title: Talent Development Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

The Talent Development Specialist is a hands-on operator building the learning experience for an AI-first organization. You’ll design and build learning that people actually use, manage the platform’s daily execution, and run compliance campaigns at scale. You’ll partner with leadership and the AI transformation team to translate how Snyk works into learning that sticks. This is a mix of designing, building, running, and improving—skills you’ll develop across each dimension. You’ll identify where AI workflows remove friction from L&D and People Ops, and you’ll ship them. You’re helping people develop the capabilities they need to thrive as AI reshapes how we build, collaborate, and secure software. This role sits at the intersection of planning and execution, learning and operations, where you own impact from build to outcome.

What You’ll Do:

  • Help draft and deliver the H1 2027 content strategy for SnykU, our learning platform, building engaging learning that people want to use, in an AI-first organisation.

  • Design and build learning assets and hub pages, using AI tools.

  • Build on our HelloSnyk onboarding with product and role-based learning.

  • Run compliance learning campaigns with Security, GRC and Legal (annual cycles, campaign comms, completion tracking), making them easier to complete and report on.

  • Help run SnykU day to day: supporting content creators and working with IT and People Tech on integrations and data.

  • Support the launch of our new career pathways and year-end review enablement.

  • Where time allows, find and build AI workflows that take manual work out of L&D and People Ops.

What you’ll bring:

  • L&D Design Chops: You’ve built learning experiences from the ground up—instructional design, SCORM, authoring tools, the whole stack. Your portfolio shows work that actually landed, not just pretty decks.

  • LMS Operator: You know your way around an LMS admin panel—enrollments, reporting, data, the parts that actually make learning happen. You can troubleshoot without Googling.

  • Cross-Functional Project Leader: You’ve shipped multiple projects and campaigns on deadline while navigating stakeholders who aren’t in L&D. You speak their language and get things done.

  • AI-First Thinker: You’re not waiting to adopt AI—you’re already using it in your work. Claude, ChatGPT, automation tools—you experiment, you iterate, you see where it saves time.

  • Process Fixer: You spot gaps before they become problems. Detail-oriented, yes. But more than that—you fix things proactively, and people trust your deadlines.

  • Clear Communicator: You write in a way non-L&D people actually understand. You can explain a learning strategy to an engineer or a compliance requirement to a CEO.

  • Growth-Minded: You see this role as a place to learn—the product, the org, new technical skills. You’re self-directed. You don’t wait for permission to level up.

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs has grown to over 1,000 in three years, and the rate of growth is not slowing down. As Talent Lead, you will be in charge of one of the most visible and impactful functions in the company: hundreds of hires a quarter across Research, Engineering, GTM and Operations, in one of the most competitive talent markets in history. You’ll move Talent from a high-volume recruiting engine to a strategic partner that tells leaders what is achievable, and you’ll rebuild how we hire using the same AI products we make.

You'll run the entire Talent team (currently 20 - 30 recruiters, sourcers, and talent operations) across verticals, setting the strategy, building the systems, and staying hands-on where it matters. You'll report directly to the Operations Lead and be a close partner to the People team. This isn't a pure executive role - we want someone who still loves the craft of recruiting and can model what great looks like for the team around them.

The right person has done this before at scale - at a company that grew fast and hired harder. Your team will look to you not just for direction, but as someone they can genuinely learn from. This will be an opportunity to shape the direction of Talent at ElevenLabs; where we go, how we get there and who we get there with. If you want to shape the future of the Talent industry by building industry-defining playbooks using the latest technology and AI solutions, whilst building an expert team - this might be your best fit yet.

In this role you will:

  • Lead the full talent function across Research, GTM, Engineering & Product, and G&A hiring - setting strategy, managing team performance, building a recruiter capacity engine, and driving outcomes across all verticals.

  • Responsible for owning the scope of Talent Operations in partnership with the Talent Operations Lead: ATS (Ashby) configuration, headcount tracking, hiring velocity metrics, and recruiter tooling - ensuring the function runs with precision and minimal friction.

  • Identify innovative ways of approaching Talent: design the next-gen Talent org structure, envision how Talent processes can be agentified and work with the team to build ElevenLabs products throughout.

  • Act as a strategic partner to department heads and hiring managers, bringing market intelligence, pipeline health visibility, and honest counsel on what it takes to consistently win the best people in the market.

  • Build and maintain a strong talent brand through thoughtful candidate experience, community engagement, building a Talent events program and creative sourcing strategies.

  • Coach and develop a team of recruiters, establishing clear standards for quality of hire, speed, and candidate experience.

  • Partner with functional leaders across Research, Engineering, GTM, and Operations - acting as a trusted advisor who can challenge, align, and mobilize leaders around talent priorities and workforce strategy.

We’re moving quickly on this search. Applications close on 13 November 2026, and we’ll start reviewing right away, so we’d encourage you to apply early.

Requirements

  • Proven track record leading large TA functions at high-growth companies, with direct experience filling hundreds of roles per year across multiple functions and geographies.

  • Hands-on recruiting instincts - comfortable being in the weeds on critical searches, not just managing from a distance.

  • Strong people leader who builds, develops, and retains recruiting talent.

  • Sharp on process: able to design and iterate on systems, tooling, and workflows that make a team of 20–30 perform at a high level with AI.

  • Close collaborator with People, Finance, and business leaders - comfortable operating at the intersection of headcount planning, compensation, and hiring strategy.

  • Held a high bar for quality of hire while hitting aggressive volume, with the metrics to show it.

  • Advised founders and executive suite on workforce planning, and changed a plan with your judgment.

  • Worked with Finance, People and RevOps on headcount planning, capacity modelling, compensation and offer strategy.

  • Has recruited across the Americas, EMEA and APAC and understands the differences between markets.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere, with the ability to operate from New York or London strongly preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

title: Talent Partner
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

As a Talent Partner at Faculty, you will own the end-to-end recruitment process, attracting and engaging exceptional talent to power our high-growth business goals. Operating within our People team, you will serve as a strategic advisor to hiring managers across all levels while driving an inclusive, world-class candidate experience within the commercial space and across our Central Functions.

This is an opportunity to shape our hiring strategy, solve complex talent challenges, and directly contribute to building a world-leading AI organisation.

What you'll be doing:

  • Owning the recruitment lifecycle from initial scoping through to interviewing, offer management, and candidate onboarding.

  • Sourcing passive talent creatively across platforms like LinkedIn, networking channels, and referrals to build diverse candidate pipelines.

  • Partnering closely with business leaders as a trusted advisor, offering data-backed insights and guiding recruitment strategy.

  • Designing structured interview packs and assessment criteria to ensure objective, high-quality hiring decisions.

  • Driving diversity and inclusion initiatives throughout every step of the hiring funnel.

  • Analysing recruitment data and pipeline metrics to identify bottlenecks and optimize process performance.

  • Amplifying Faculty’s employer brand by representing the company at industry events, conferences, and meetups.

Who we're looking for:

  • You bring experience managing end-to-end talent acquisition processes, ideally within a fast-moving, in-house environment within the commercial and/or GTM space.

  • You possess strong direct-sourcing skills and know how to leverage modern applicant tracking systems to engage top-tier passive candidates.

  • You excel at stakeholder management, building authentic relationships across all levels while balancing support with constructive challenge.

  • You take an agile, problem-solving approach to recruitment, adapting quickly to change while upholding high standards of confidentiality and compliance.

  • You prioritise quality over volume, demonstrating resilience and a dedication to delivering an outstanding, inclusive candidate experience.

  • You are a confident, articulate communicator who thrives as a brand ambassador, passionately sharing our culture and ambition with prospective talent.

Our Interview Process

  1. Initial Talent Screen (30 mins)

  2. Introductory interview with the Hiring Manager (45 mins)

  3. Competency & Scenario based interview (60 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

descriptionHtml:
Du kommst aus der Elektrotechnik, kennst industrielle Instandhaltung nicht nur aus der Theorie und möchtest fachlich wie organisatorisch mehr Verantwortung übernehmen?

Dann könnte diese Position genau der nächste saubere Schritt sein.

Hier geht es nicht um reine Schreibtischverwaltung. Hier geht es um Elektrotechnik, Verlässlichkeit, Sicherheit und ein Team, das eine klare Führung braucht.

Aufgaben

In deiner neuen Rolle übernimmst du die fachliche Verantwortung für die elektrotechnische Instandhaltung im laufenden Betrieb.

Du planst, steuerst und überwachst die täglichen Instandhaltungsarbeiten im Bereich Elektrotechnik und sorgst dafür, dass Aufträge technisch sauber, termingerecht und zuverlässig abgewickelt werden.

Außerdem gehören zu deinen Aufgaben:

  • Planung, Koordination und Überwachung elektrotechnischer Instandhaltungsarbeiten

  • Sicherstellung der termingerechten und fachgerechten

  • Ausführung von Aufträgen

  • Abstimmung technischer Voraussetzungen und Abläufe im Tagesgeschäft

  • Planung und Umsetzung von Sonderprojekten, z. B. im Rahmen von Stillständen

  • Steuerung und Einteilung deines Teams

  • Verantwortung für Qualität, Arbeitssicherheit, Gesundheits- und Umweltschutz

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit angrenzenden Fachbereichen im industriellen Umfeld

  • Mitarbeit an einer stabilen, sauberen und vorausschauenden Arbeitsvorbereitung

Qualifikation

Du musst nicht seit 20 Jahren Führungskraft sein. Wichtiger ist, dass du Elektrotechnik wirklich verstehst, Verantwortung übernehmen willst und im industriellen Umfeld klar und verbindlich auftreten kannst.

Wichtig ist uns:

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik, z. B. als Elektroniker, Elektriker, Mechatroniker oder vergleichbar

  • Weiterbildung zum Meister oder Techniker im Bereich Elektrotechnik

  • Erste bis mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung industrieller Anlagen

  • Erfahrung in Planung, Arbeitsvorbereitung oder Koordination technischer Arbeiten

  • Grundverständnis für Sicherheitsvorschriften, technische Normen und saubere Dokumentation

  • Freude daran, ein Team fachlich zu führen und weiterzuentwickeln

  • Strukturierte, verbindliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Teamfähigkeit, Bodenhaftung und ein klarer Blick für das, was im Betrieb wirklich zählt

Ideal ist, wenn du bereits erste Führungserfahrung gesammelt hast. Entscheidend ist aber vor allem: Du möchtest den nächsten Schritt gehen und bringst das fachliche Fundament dafür mit.

Benefits

Dich erwartet eine langfristige Perspektive in einem stabilen industriellen Umfeld mit guter Struktur, klaren Aufgaben und einem attraktiven Gesamtpaket.

Dazu gehören unter anderem:

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit

  • Attraktives Gehaltspaket im Bereich ca. 65.000–70.000 € p. a.

  • Regelmäßige tarifliche Gehaltserhöhungen

  • Geregelte Arbeitszeiten mit Überstundenausgleich

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Gleitzeitkonto

  • Freitags früher Start ins Wochenende möglich

  • Individuelle Weiterbildungsangebote, E-Learning und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • Shuttle-Service bis zum Werkseingang

  • Hochwertige Arbeitskleidung und persönliche Schutzausrüstung

  • Unterstützung bei betrieblicher Altersvorsorge

  • Corporate Benefits und weitere Vergünstigungen
    Arbeitgeberzuschuss für Kantine bzw. Verpflegung

  • Gesundheitsangebote wie Rückenschule, Yoga oder Massagen

  • Sonderurlaubstage für besondere Lebensereignisse

Diese Position ist spannend für Menschen, die aus der Elektrotechnik kommen und mehr wollen als „nur mitlaufen“.

Du bekommst hier Verantwortung, aber keinen Elfenbeinturm. Du bist nah an der Anlage, nah an den Menschen und nah an den Entscheidungen. Genau dort, wo Technik nicht in PowerPoint-Folien lebt, sondern morgens funktionieren muss.

Wenn du Meister oder Techniker bist, industrielle Instandhaltung kennst und Lust hast, ein Team fachlich zu führen, dann ist das hier kein schlechter nächster Schritt. Eher ein ziemlich guter.

Und keine Sorge: Du musst nicht alles schon perfekt können. Wenn das fachliche Fundament stimmt, die Haltung passt und du bereit bist, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, sprechen wir sehr gerne mit dir.

Klingt interessant?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.
